312874.title: Headland Management
312874.author: Glowins Modschmiede
312874.description:
Headland management for tractors, field sprayers, mowers and harvesters

Description:
Headland management allows functions to be combined in the vehicle and activated together at the touch of a button to simplify turning manoeuvres during field work. All functions can be activated and deactivated individually for each vehicle via a GUI in order to achieve ideal adaptation to the work being carried out.

Headland management must be added to the respective vehicle as a one-off configuration in the shop or in the workshop before use. The cost for this is 3000$.
It can be activated and deactivated in the vehicle. Various buttons can also be configured for activation and deactivation.

Functions included:
- Reduce speed (cruise control) and raise again, reactivate cruise control if it was previously active
- Raise lowered implements and lower them again, optionally raise front implements before raising rear implements
- Turn the plough, single-stage or two-stage (via the centre position)
- Raise and change track markers
- Change sides with crab steering activated
- Switch off PTO shaft(s) and hydraulics and switch on again
- Warning tone when headland mode is activated
- On/off switch: The headland management can be switched on and off. This prevents accidental activation during transfer to the work site and improves road safety.
- Automatic headland management: Automatic activation of headland mode when the headland is reached. Optional return to field mode after completing the 180° turn.
- Option to temporarily deactivate headland automatic headland by pressing a button
- Contour guidance: Automatic control along the field boundary or along the cultivated area
- The configuration is saved and restored for each device type

With existing EnhancedVehicle (FS25_EnhancedVehicle):
- Deactivate and reactivate GPS lane guidance, optionally trigger the turning function
- Release and reset active differential locks
- Use of EV headland detection if it has been activated

Pre-assigned key combinations (can be changed):
- Switch headland management on/off: (left) Shift + (left) Alt + X
- Switch operating mode (field mode / headland mode): (left) Shift + X
- Call up GUI for configuration: (left) Shift + (left) Ctrl + X

Other prepared key combinations (not pre-assigned)
- Temporarily deactivating/reactivating (toggling) the headland automatic function
- Temporarily deactivating the automatic headland automatic function
- Reactivating the automatic automatic
- Activation of the field mode
- Activation of the headland mode

Change Log V3.0.0.1:
- Fixed a bug in the handling of actionEvents, which caused keyboard input to be partially ignored
- Availability in mission vehicles restored

Change Log V3.0.0.2:
- Availability in mission vehicles after loading the game

Change Log V3.0.0.2:
- Logical error fixed in gps configuration

Change Log V3.0.1.0:
- Logic error in GPS configuration corrected
- GPS can now be activated in field mode at any time

Change Log V3.0.2.0:
- Headland management is now compatible with Nexat
- Temporary correction of configuration handling is no longer necessary and has therefore been removed. ATTENTION: When updating to this version, all attached devices will be disconnected once when the game is started!

Description:
Many cultivators from the game can be operated at different working depths in reality, depending on the setting.
In the game, individual cultivators also have the option of being set to “flat cultivator” or “normal cultivator”.

With this modification, all cultivators get this option and can also be set to “deep cultivator”.
They can be configured in the store to a fixed working mode or as a variable cultivator, which can then be switched via the working mode (extra cost: €2,500). If a cultivator is to be used unchanged, this can also be configured in the store.

Soil cultivation with the deep cultivator replaces plowing.

Followed by flat open land where you can see for miles. The biggest change to this semi fictional map is the trees which have been included to provide forestry in game. We don't have trees in real life.
The endless possibilities start here where you can begin as a starting farmer with equipment and fields to start, or you can utilize the open section of the map where there are no fields, just your imagination and trees to start your new farm, ranch, or forrestry life.

Enjoy beautiful scenery, wide open spaces, medium to large fields, and multiple good sized forrest areas.

312938.title: Task List
312938.author: Ozz
312938.description:
Task List

If you find yourself taking notes of what tasks you need to do, or even using external software, then Task List is here to help.

On the main menu, just above Settings, you will find a new menu with a clipboard icon. Use this menu to get started with the following features:

- Create groups to contain related tasks, such as Field 10 or General Farm Tasks.
- Create one-off tasks or tasks that recur daily, monthly, every N months, or every N days.
- Give tasks a priority so you know what to do first.
- Buy a new field and want to copy tasks from an existing field? No problem, you can do this in seconds.
- Got lots of fields and want to manage them as one? Create a template and use that repeatedly.
- View currently due tasks in the menu and mark them complete when you've done them.
- Plan ahead by looking at cumulative effort throughout the year. Also look ahead at the coming 12 months to see what tasks are coming up.
- View currently due tasks without checking the menu by pressing Shift + T
- Automatically track levels for animal food, conditions and production levels.

- Github:
https://github.com/sprkem/FS25_TaskList

Changelog:

1.2.0.1:
- Updated 'Every N month tasks to support 24 and 36 month recurrence. You can also set the start month. This is to better support setting up crop rotation schedules for groups or templates.
- Fixed a display bug where some tasks would incorrectly show as overdue.
- Added Spanish translation, thanks to sharak.

1.2.0.0:
- Fix issue where tasks could not be saved if they had become invalid (e.g. due to missing fill types)

1.1.0.11:

- Some fill type related tasks may need to be re-added after this update

- Add Italian translation, thanks to FirenzeIT

Alongside standard windrow materials such as grass, hay, and straw, this advanced pickup can strip cotton directly from the stem and cut or chop poplar and chaff. An optional front 3-point attachment also enables the use of additional implements for increased working width.

This mod pack includes more than just the AgriFlex SPB: it also comes with a front-mounted mower (compatible with any front 3-point hitch), a dedicated forage cutter head designed specifically for the AgriFlex, and an AI bumper that may enable AI functionality on other equipment.

- Working Width: 4.6m (10-15m Unreal)

Additional Features:
- Unload unfinished bales WITHOUT additional mods/scripts
- Added pre-chamber/buffer
- Custom bale sizes and capacities (see below)
- Optional 3-point attacher (200hp PTO available with baler running)
- Optional silage additive (including support for alfalfa/clover)
- Additional wheel options including crawlers and extra wide floaters

Baler Configurations:
Standard baler configuration contains bales with 1.5x capacity. Additional Unreal baler configurations feature larger capacities (3x/5x/7x/9x), liftable bales and reduced bale net/silage additive consumption.
(NOTE: Unreal bales use custom bale sizes that require modded autoload trailers and wrappers; the basegame equipment will not work on Unreal bales; recommended to use Custom Bale Support Pack or similar)

AI Usage:
AI usage is fully supported when baling with a front attachment (a mower for example) as well as harvesting poplar/cotton/chaff directly. In order for AI to work with loose windrows on the ground, you must attach the AI bumper on the front.

313578.title: Multi Crop Greenhouses
313578.author: GH66Mods
313578.description:
The Multi Crop Greenhouses allow you to grow most base game field crops sorted into crop categories as well as the standard greenhouse products.

The glass & tarp greenhouses need water, if you also supply manure you double the output.
The mushroom greenhouses need water, if you also supply straw or straw + manure to improve the growth substrate you double and quadruple the outputs respectively, straw can be added loose or in bales.

FEATURES:
Once you select a greenhouse in the menu and before actually placing you can use the customize option to select which side the pallets will spawn.
Each glass and tarp greenhouse has a fill pipe added so you can unload the normal field crops produced into a trailer instead of on pallets if you wish.
Each greenhouse has a switch on the pallet spawn side you chose to raise bollards in the pallet spawn area to stop the pallets spawning until required or if you wish to unload into a trailer.
Straw is produced as a byproduct of the grain crops and can only be unloaded via the fill pipe.
All pallets produced are 2000L capacity and can be lifted by hand.

NOTE: The standard greenhouse crops can only be produced on pallets and not emptied through the fill pipe.


WHAT IS INCLUDED:
Fruit & Veg - Glass & Tarp greenhouses with selectable pallet spawn side. (Large, Medium & Small)
Grain and Kharif - Glass & Tarp greenhouses with selectable pallet spawn side. (Large, Medium & Small)
Oil and Taproot - Glass & Tarp greenhouses with selectable pallet spawn side. (Large, Medium & Small)
Mushroom greenhouse with selectable pallet spawn side. (Large, Medium & Small)
Buying Station to bulk buy manure and straw for a 30% discount plus FREE water.

PRICES:
Glass Greenhouses: Large: $50,000, Medium: $25,000, Small: $12,500
Tarp Greenhouses: Large: $32,000, Medium: $16,000, Small: $8,000
Mushroom Greenhouses: Large: $32,000, Medium: $16,000, Small: $8,000
Buying Station: $500

CROP STORAGE CAPACITIES:
Large Glass & Tarp: 100.000L each
Medium Glass & Tarp: 50.000L each
Small Glass & Tarp: 25.000L each
Large Mushroom: 60,000L each
Medium Mushroom: 30,000L each
Small Mushroom: 15,000L each

CROP CATEGORIES:
Fruit & Veg: Chilli, Garlic, Greenbean, Lettuce, Napa Cabbage, Pea, Potato, Spinach, Spring Onion, Strawberry, Tomato
Grain Crops: Barley, Oat, Sorghum, Wheat
Kharif Crops: Corn, Cotton, Soybean, Sugarcane
Oil Crops: Canola, Long Grain Rice, Rice, Sunflower
Taproot Crops: Beetroot, Carrot, Parsnip, Sugarbeet


Changelog 1.2.0.0
- All greenhouses now accept Slurry and Digestate which will be converted to manure at a 1:1 ratio.
- All greenhouses now accept Solid Fertilizer which will be converted to manure at a 1:40 ratio. (1000L Solid Fertilizer converts to 40000L Manure)
- All greenhouses now accept Liquid Fertilizer which will be converted to manure at a 1:30 ratio. (1000L Liquid Fertilizer converts to 30000L Manure)
- Blocked greenhouses from showing in prices menu.
- Doubled the storage capacity of the Mushroom greenhouses.

Changelog 1.1.0.0

- Fixed trigger on Buying Station as wouldn't work with Krampe SKS 30/1050 trailer.

The constant maneuvering of the various equipment and vehicles will leave visible tire tracks on the farm areas over time.

The pack contains different types of tire tracks in straight, curved, narrow and wide variants so that you can adapt them perfectly to your farm.

When placing the tire tracks in the construction menu, you can choose between two modes in the configuration menu (key "F" by default):
- In the first mode, the tire track adapts to the terrain when it is placed. This means that the texture is placed directly on the ground and follows the terrain contour. The terrain can still be edited afterwards (e.g. raised or lowered) and the tire track always aligns itself.
- In the second mode, the tire track is placed horizontally at the height of the mouse cursor so that you can also place the tire tracks inside of buildings and bunker silos.

The tire tracks can also be sold again.

In total, 13 different placeable tire tracks are included.

313960.title: Production Info Hud
313960.author: Achimobil
313960.description:
HUD display for productions and husbandries that require attention.

The productions and husbandries are displayed in a list.
The list is sorted by remaining time.
It shows both the time until a raw material is empty and until an output storage is full.
Feeding robots are not supported, only the husbandries themselves.

General operating instructions with the mouse
- Move window by clicking on the arrow icon in the top left corner
- Open the filter line by clicking on the down arrow in the top left-hand corner.
- Switch filter line to settings via the gear wheel in the bottom left-hand corner
- The font size and line spacing can be set individually in the settings
- Automatically display only when mouse is activated via the lock in the bottom left corner
- Adjust the window size using the arrow icon in the bottom right-hand corner
- Save changes via the disc in the top right-hand corner
- Left-click on a production location or a fill type to filter the list according to this. The filters in the filter line are then ignored. What is filtered is then highlighted in green. Clicking on the filtered item again removes the filter.
- Right-click on the production location to open it in the menu
- Left-click on the 3rd column to switch the display between remaining time, capacity (available capacity for raw materials and used capacity for manufactured goods) and current hourly production quantity.
- If the hourly production quantity is displayed in the third column, the total production quantities are displayed in the last row.

Note: Some of the icons are only displayed when you move the mouse over the corresponding position.

In the upper display next to the current assets, you can right-click on the spanner icon to call up the display system settings
These are the same for all mods that use this display system. Here you can save the settings automatically and much more.
Just have a look.

Uploading to sites other than ModHub is prohibited and therefore illegal, linking only with original download link. NO substitute link!
Modifying and re-uploading in whole or in part is not allowed!

Bugs and suggestions welcome on GitHub.

314089.title: Wood Pellet Factory
314089.author: GWENDAL
314089.description:
Fully animated wood pellet production, this pellet is used to heat homes or other buildings via a boiler or pellet stove. This production facility is housed in 2 wood-clad buildings measuring 48m x 25m x 10m. One version of the building has 3 sliding doors and the other has 2 sliding doors, open on one side.
To produce your wood pellets, the raw material is wood shavings from the game (either by crushing wood or harvesting poplar). You'll also need to buy rolls of bags and empty pallets from the store.
The wood shavings are emptied into a large hopper, and 2 conveyor belts pour the pellets into a 2nd hopper, before they are fed into a cylindrical press which, with its rapid rotation, crushes the wood shavings into sawdust and presses them into pellets. A blower propels them through pipes to the bagging area, where rolls of empty bags, which can be purchased from the store, are placed. Then it's off to the palletizer, where you place empty pallets that can also be bought from the store. The wood pellet chain comes to an end, and the pallets are placed in the storage racks.
You'll now be able to transport your pallets of wood pellets to your pellet drive(s) (which you've purchased beforehand and placed on the map), where residents will be able to come and buy bags of wood pellets 24/7 and earn you money.
This mod also offers the 2 building versions without the factory.

- Price of the 2 factory versions: 195500 $
- Daily maintenance for the 2 factory versions: 35 $.
- Production 8 pallets per day

- Price of a roll of bags (480 bags): 150 $
- Price of 11 empty pallets: 400 $
- Price of point of sale (Drive): 14500 $

- Price of 2 versions of empty building: €55500
- Daily maintenance of the 2 versions of the empty building: 10 $.
The use of this mod as a mod required for a map is fully authorized.

314403.description:

Custom installation for a personal mod:

Custom Vehicle Shader - can be used individually for one mod by manually installing it into the mod you need! Write the path to it in the "mod_name.i3d" file by opening it with any text editor! Instead of the standard filename="$data/shaders/vehicleShader.xml" change to "filename="shaders/customVehicleShader.xml"!
Attention! The registration path is "filename="shaders/customVehicleShader.xml" it depends on which directory of your mod you have placed the downloaded folder "shaders"!

Common installation for all standard equipment:

Custom Vehicle Shader - can also be installed on all standard tractors, combines, cars, equipment, etc. This installation method will only work on a PC!!!
Attention!!! Save the original file before installing Custom Vehicle Shader vehicleShader.xml or rename it to another name so that you can restore the standard one vehicleShader.xml!!!
Installation: move the contents of the downloaded folder "shaders" along the path "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Farming Simulator 25\data\shaders" rename "customVehicleShader.xml" on "vehicleShader.xml".

314906.title: Enhanced Loan System
314906.author: Chissel
314906.description:
This mod makes the credit system a bit more realistic. However, the standard game credits will be deactivated. If a farm still has a loan, it will be transferred to the new system.

With this system it is possible to take annuity loans. For this, a loan with a fixed amount, a term and a loan interest rate is concluded. This calculates the monthly installment, which is debited at the end of each month.
The bank requires collateral here, so the maximum loan amount is calculated from the current sales value of your vehicles, fields (60%), cash and your already current loans.
To make this a bit more realistic the loan rate can go up, down or stay the same each month. This makes it all the more crucial when the loan is taken out. However, you can also change this variable loan interest rate to a fixed loan interest rate in the settings.

There are also various setting options that allow the credit system to be adapted to personal preferences.

How does an annuity loan work? Here is a brief explanation:
An annuity loan has an annuity, the monthly installment, and a loan interest rate. This annuity is made up of the repayment amount and the interest amount. The interest amount is calculated by multiplying the loan interest rate by the remaining amount of the loan. As a result, the interest amount keeps decreasing and the repayment amount keeps increasing.

315017.title: Farms Cleanup
315017.author: FSG Modding - FSG DaVaR
315017.description:
Tired of clutter slowing down your savegame? Farms Cleanup is designed to help maintain performance in both single-player and multiplayer by automatically or manually removing bales, pallets, logs, and stumps. This ensures a cleaner farm and a smoother gameplay experience.

Features
- Auto removes on day change at midnight when enabled
- Pallet removal
- Bale removal
- Log removal
- Stump removal

Each category can be set to:
- Manual Removal Only : Full control over cleanup.
- Auto Removal : Automatically removes items based on configurable settings.

Customization Options
- Cost Settings: Choose whether removal is free or set a price from $0 to $10,000.
- Auto-Delete Buffer: Set a delay (in days) before pallets and bales are automatically removed.
- The system tracks bales and pallets that remain in the same spot overnight.
- If they haven't moved for the set number of days, they will be auto-deleted.
- Ownership-Based Charges
- Bales and pallets charge removal costs to the farm that owns them.
- Logs and stumps charge removal costs to the farmland owner.
- Mission-related bales get an extra two-day grace period to ensure fair play for contract work.

Why Use Farms Cleanup?
- Improves savegame longevity by preventing excessive object accumulation.
- Reduces lag and boosts performance by removing unnecessary clutter.
- Ideal for dedicated servers to keep multiplayer farms running efficiently.
- Compatible with single-player if manual or automatic cleanup is desired.

When set to auto clean, any pallets that are in pallet spawn areas are not removed. Production pallet spawn areas are safe.

When used on multiplayer servers only users logged in as admin may alter settings.

This mod completely removes the selected objects from the game world, reducing the number of active elements the game needs to process. Whether you're managing a busy multiplayer server or just keeping your single-player farm tidy, Farms Cleanup ensures a more optimized Farming Simulator 25 experience.

315685.title: Lizard Calf Huts
315685.author: MrHector
315685.description:
Shelters for calves, group or single with small enclosure.

Calves require a lot of special and daily care. Calf huts are ideal solution for outdoor rearing of calves, easy to work with, easy to clean and they keep them warm during the winter.
Here they can grow up and then must be moved to other cow barn.

Available solutions:
Calf Hut - single
- Price: 500 $
- Daily upkeep: 5 $
- Small hut for 1 single calf.
- Food capacity: 320 l
- Straw capacity: 360 l
- Water capacity: 80 l
- Manure capacity: 600 l (not displayed on info window)
- Food, water and straw inputs all positined in front of the hut so you can place multiple ones side by side.

Calf Hut - group
- Price: 1,500 $
- Daily upkeep: 15 $
- Bigger hut, space for up to 5 calves.
- Food capacity: 1,600 l
- Straw capacity: 1,800 l
- Water capacity: 400 l
- Manure capacity: 3,000 l (not displayed on info window)
- Options for food and water troughs and straw input placed either on the left side or the right side.

Functionality:
These calf huts work just like any other cow husbandry.
Animals can be provided with food, water and straw any way you like to - using trailer, bale, pallet, shovel, straw blower... All input triggers are clearly marked.

For better gameplay experience it is recommended to use small tools such as wheelbarrow or small vehicles such as skid steer loader.

To clean the calf enclosure from manure, you have to first move the fence out of the way and position your shovel (or even trailer) Inside of the fence area and hit hit R - start loading (default keybinding - see your controls menu).

Cows in this enclosure does not produce milk and liquid manure, only manure and they require a lot of manual daily care!

Recommendations / requirements:
Mod "More Animal Enclosures Possible (64)" (by modelleicher / Farming Agency) is recommended to use with this mod, so you are able to build multiple calf huts.

In addition, this pack includes also non-functional decorative variants of each calf hut option to decorate you farm if calf tending is not your thing and instead you may like to use them as decoration.

- Added pallet triggers for straw and water.

315816.title: Quick Selector
315816.author: Quity
315816.description:
----- Quick Selector 1.2 -----
# Update 1.2 brings a major overhaul with additional features and improvements!
- Display and manage the full list of owned or rented equipment (vehicles and attachable).
- To reduce on-screen clutter, attached implements and vehicle info are now displayed only when you hover over a vehicle or an item.
- Clicking on an attachable teleports the player directly to its location.
- To make vehicles easier to identify, the list now shows the design color of each vehicle.
- Attached implement selection has been added above the quick buttons to improve usability.
- Multiple new details have been added to the vehicle/implement info screen, including needed power, fill level/capacity, mass, and working width.

# New buttons (*) added to Quick Buttons list:
- Power On:
- | Change Seed*
- Unload
- | Change Tip Side* | Toggle Trailer Cover*
- Time Scale*
- | Pause* | Realtime* | Increase* | Decrease*
- Open Menu
- | Toggle Help Text* (Top left keybindings menu)
- Shop
- | Sell / Return Vehicle*
----------------------------

The Quick Selector enhances gameplay with an intuitive user interface,
offering additional game functions and quick access to essential vehicle and game controls.
It features the list of personal vehicles and implements, additional vehicle information and
the possibility to operate selected vehicle/implement functions with a click.

By default, the HUD can be opened with a (Double Right Mouse Click) or via configurable keys:
- Keyboard: Right CTRL key
- Gamepad Open HUD: button (Arrow Down + Square) on PS / (Arrow Down + X) on Xbox
- Gamepad Click Item: button (X) on PlayStation / (A) on Xbox

#Key Features:
- Selectable Vehicles: Paginated list of owned or rented vehicles and implements
- Vehicle Controls: Start the engine, enter or exit vehicles, toggle attachments,
operate implements (power on, folding, lowering, unloading), and control cruise speed.
- Vehicle Reordering: Reorganize vehicles in the list, which also updates their tab order.
- Lights Control: Switch vehicle lights, all lights, front/backlights, beacon, and hazard lights.
- AI and Helpers: Open AI screens and hire helpers.
- Game Management: Open menus, access the shop, save the game, adjust settings, and exit.

#Important Notes:
- Controls: When the HUD is open, all controls from (Keyboard, Mouse or Gamepad) are used to
interact with Quick Selector elements (moving the cursor, select vehicle, click buttons).
Only the vehicle's acceleration and brake inputs remain available.
- Gamepads: For quicker access, it's recommended to change the HUD opening input from
(Arrow Down + Square/X) to (Square/X) and remap the default vehicle enter/exit input
from (Square/X) to (Arrow Down + Square/X) to prevent conflicts.
- No multiplayer support for now.

#Contact:
[EN] General Discussion > Mods: https://forum.giants-software.com/viewforum.php?f=1061

Have fun!
Quity - T. Florin

316134.author: w33zl
316134.description:
This mod is intended for those who want a more realistic farming experience in the northern parts of Europe.

With the mod enabled all "exotic" crops not typically grown in the northern part of Europe will be disabled:
- Olive
- Grape
- Cotton
- Sugarcane
- Rice

IMPORTANT! Due to the nature of this mod and how the game is designed, it is -strongly- recommended to start a new savegame when enabling this mod. Enabling this mod on an existing savegame can have unexpected consequences.

Similarly, disabling this mod after doing fieldwork, or when contracts have been generated, can also have negative impact on your gameplay. I.e. it is recommended to keep this mod enabled for the entire playthrough.

CUSTOMIZATION:
If you want to customize which crops are disabled, you can do so by editing the NoExoticCrops.lua file (line 15-22). The file is located in the mod's zip file.

316212.title: Rottumer Island
316212.author: Marnux Mapping
316212.description:
Welcome to Rottumer Island. It is a fictional map based on my imagination. The story behind the island is that it is reclaimed land from the Wadden Sea (Netherlands) to make more room for dairy and arable farming. It also has a production forest for lumber that can be used on the island or be turned into products. The dairy farms you find on the island are based on farms on the mainland in the northern part of the Netherlands. The island consists of several lakes and waterways that connect them. You can use those waterways and lakes to get water for your animals and/or greenhouses for example, but not from the smaller ditches!

The biggest part of the island is flat so you will be able to build your own farm or productions where ever you like. You can also fill in the ditches to combine fields or farmlands if you enjoy bigger fields.
You start out with 1 dairy farm and the arable farm. Which have most of the equipment and supplies you need to get started.

By buying farmland/field 1 you will get access to the 'unbuyable' land. So you can for example mow the sides of the road and combine fields together.

Fences can be removed in multiplayer by FarmID 1.

The equipment that is recommended for the map is small to medium.

What you can find on the map:
- Soilmap for Precision Farming
- 3 Dairy Farms
- 1 Arable Farm
- 1 Farmhouse with 3 Greenhouses
- 1 Small Contractor Yard in the main town
- 1 Horse Farm
- 1 BGA that has been boosted (also accepts straw and sugarbeets)
- Several productions like: a Grainmill, Dairy, BGA and a Sawmill
- 87 Fields
- 98 Farmlands (including the fields)
- 2 Production Forests
- 2 Sheepbarns, with one that has a Spinnery nearby
- 1 Small Cow Pasture
- 1 Forest, that can you cut down but where do the animals have to live?!
- 1 small building plot near the docks
- Serveral Sellpoints acrosss the map

No collectibles (yet)

Have fun starting your adventure on Rottumer Island and enjoy the scenery when you have the spare time!

316753.title: Adjust Working Speed
316753.author: PeterAH (Modding-Welt)
316753.description:
With this Script-Mod the working speed of attachments can be adjusted when buying them in the store. The setting range is up to 10 kph (or 6.2 miles) more or less in 1 kph (or 0.62 miles) increments, starting from the default value of the attachment.

Realistic players can use this to slow down their attachments, which is especially useful for youngtimer and oldtimer attachments. But the working speed can also be increased.

Another criterion for setting the working speed can be the existing farm tractor. If your own tractor has hardly any reserves in relation to the attachment (e.g. cultivator or plow), then the working speed should be selected lower.

In the multiplayer, each player can buy an attachment with his or her preferred working speed, i.e. there may be the same attachment with different working speeds in the game.

Adjusting the working speed works with all attachments, whether from the main game, a DLC or mods.

There are a few mods, where the working speed does not correspond to the usual default values, this can now be adjusted in the store configuration.

317121.title: Manual Tipping
317121.author: Let me cook
317121.description:
This mod adds manual control over trailer, semi-trailer and tipper hydraulics.

In the base game, trailers can be unloaded manually, but they always lift to the maximum position. This can cause issues in low garages or confined spaces.
With this mod, you can stop the lifting process at any desired position.

If the trailer supports separate animations for the rear door or side panels, you can raise the trailer without unloading its contents. The material will only unload once the doors or panels are opened.

The mod includes full multiplayer support — all animations are fully synchronized on the server.

Default Controls
- Select lift/lower direction – Left ALT
- Activate hydraulics (hold to lift/lower) – Right CTRL
- Open/unlock rear door or flap – O

All key bindings can be changed in the game settings.

If you encounter any issues, please report them by repo: github.com/letmecook401/FS25_ManualTipping

317386.title: Traditional Finnish Farmhouses
317386.author: Agrogaatti
317386.description:
A selection of old Finnish rural buildings for building a farm.
The package includes two versions of the Finnish type-planned-house in its original appearance, as well as one expanded version. Almost 300,000 of these almost identical houses were built across Finland in the 1940s and 50s.
In addition, the package includes older houses that were built in Finland and neighboring countries around the turn of the 19th and 20th centuries.
The package also contains old-style garages and barns. Some of them can be used as garages and for storing hand tools, some are decorative buildings.
Also included are dozens of decorative placeables, featuring over 50 completely unique objects with numerous configuration options iconic to the northern countryside. For example, you’ll find traditional roundpole fences, old milk churn stands, and a variety of mailboxes to decorate the entrance to your property. Garden decorations include wells, swings, gazebos and iconic wooden bear statues, among other things. In addition, you can also find Nordic flags and pennants, as well as much more.
The pack includes firewood sheds that double as a sales point for firewood that you can make with my Firewood Production mod. For example, you can place those around your map, and sell firewood to neighbors.

Jenz BA 725 D

Price: 102000 €

This biomass processor can be used in many different agricultural applications, for example, in the production of wood chips from tree trunks, the production of sugar beet pulp,
for breaking up all types of bales, or for chopping straw and grass, for example, to prepare them for fermentation. In this case, it is used in the game to produce chaff.

Functions/Tutorial:

Pipe:
0th mode = transport position
1st mode = chopping bulk material (sugarbeets, straw, grass)
2nd mode = chopping logs
3rd mode = breaking up bales
If the pipe mode is not set to the correct application it will not unload despite being turned on.

Table:
1st position: transport position
2nd position: bulk material/round bale position (will automatically be selected if bulk material is poured on conveyor)
3rd position: square bale/log position
(can also be used for round bales if preffered)
Once unfolded, you will have to switch the tipside to unfold into the next position, e.g. switch from 1st to 2nd -> switch tipside -> unfold to 3rd position, and vice versa for folding again, otherwise you will fold back into the original position.

317571.title: Tramline Shop Filter
317571.author: Farmsim Tim (timmeey86)
317571.description:
Description: This mod allows filtering the shop for work widths which are compatible with a target tramline (or strip) width.
This is intended for players who are playing with tramlines/CTF and especially players who are practicing strip cropping, alley cropping (agroforestry) or similar.

By default, only tools with a work width which are an odd factor of the sprayer width are shown. For example, a 3m seeder would not be shown for a 12m sprayer width since the tramline would not be in the center. A 4m seeder would fit, however (no tramline + tramline + no tramline = 12m).
It is however possible to also allow even factors, which is useful for finding implements like mulchers or rollers for a strip cropping system.

The filter dialog can only be opened while in the main shop menu, and closing the shop or cancelling the filter dialog will reset the filter.

This mod is compatible with the "Enhanced Shop Sorting" and "Store Search" mods.

Hotkeys: [T] opens the filter dialog while in the main page of the shop.

GitHub link: https://github.com/Timmeey86/FS25_TramlineShopFilter

317864.title: Old Brick Cow Barns
317864.author: Agrogaatti
317864.description:
This package contains old tie-stall dairy barns. Barns of this style were built in Finland in the mid-20th century and are an inseparable part of the Finnish countryside. Fewer and fewer of them are still in their original use today as agricultural demands increase, but like these, some still serve the needs of the animals thanks to upgrades made towards the end of the last century.

All barns have space for food and/or equipment, so if you don't want to keep animals, you can use them as a garage to decorate your yard. The color of the roof and the wooden wall sections can be selected separately.

The outdoor pasture has no visual fences at all, but you can still define the size of the animals’ grazing area just as you would when setting up any other barn, and fence off the pasture with a separate fence afterward. This way, you can use the fence of your choice, add gates to the pasture, or leave out the fencing entirely if you don’t want to use the building for keeping animals.

The package also includes a selection of manure pits suitable for barns. Some manure pits can only be placed in certain orientations, while others can be freely adjusted. Please note that if you place a manure pit in an orientation other than the perpendicular to the map that the game prefers, it is possible that manure will spill through the walls.

Old barns like these typically cannot collect liquid manure, but you can obtain slurry if you wish by placing a liquid manure tank and an extension near the barn.

-Animal capacity: 10

Option 2
-Price: $32,000
-Animal capacity: 16

Option 3
-Price: $50,000
-Animal capacity: 28

v1.1.0.0
- Visual pasture fences have been removed. If you have already set up a barn, there have been no changes to the NavMesh i.e. the area used by the animals. Simply add your preferred fence to the pasture again if you wish. Please see above for more information.

318102.description:
With this mod you can tow vehicles by towing chain. You can also mount a towing hook to vehicles that have no attacher and then attach the towing chain to this hook.
- 3 sizes available: 1.5m, 2.5m and 3.5m
- Attach the red end to your vehicle and then attach the second end to the towed vehicle
- You can attach a towing chain to itself when no vehicle is in range (can be used for transport)

- You can take the towing chain to the hands and attach it manually
- Multiple attaching of chains supported
- You can turn on the towed vehicle's throttle if necessary
- You can set the steering mode of the towed vehicle to auto or manual
- In F1 help menu you can see all chains available in your range with info about the chain (range can be set in the menu)
- You can switch between chains when you are on foot
- You can move the mounted hook in all directions so it will fit any vehicle
- Id of the chain is shown in the middle of each chain to help (can be turned off in the menu)
- All controls can be set in your Inputbindings

-price: 1.5m - 500 $, 2.5m - 600 $, 3.5m - 700 $

Controls:
KEY_lshift KEY_t - Open settings menu
KEY_x - attach / detach towing chain to vehicle (vehicle, onfoot)
KEY_y - switch to next chain (onfoot)
KEY_z - mount towing hook (onfoot)
KEY_b - turn on / off towed vehicle throttle (vehicle)
KEY_y - switch between steering mode of towed vehicle (vehicle)
KEY_comma, KEY_period - turn the towed vehicle left / right (vehicle)
KEY_lalt KEY_b - change towed vehicle driving direction (vehicle)
KEY_lalt KEY_KP_4 / 6 - move mounted hook left / right (onfoot)
KEY_lalt KEY_KP_8 / 5 - move mounted hook forward / backward (onfoot)
KEY_lalt KEY_KP_7 / 9 - move mounted hook up / down (onfoot)

318267.title: Real GPS Mod
318267.author: BayernGamers, [LSFM] RepiGaming
318267.description:
Real GPS Mod

This mod does not include any GPS functionality, it is used to display the minimap and GPS track inside a vehicle without the need of using the HUD.

The user can choose to rotate the minimap around the current location or display it statically. To better recognize smaller details on the map, it can be zoomed in.
The mod adds the map to existing vehicles from the base game, so you can start using it right away with available vehicles. Mod vehicles that are properly prepared can also use RealGPS. A guide for integration can be found in the Readme.pdf in the mod directory.

The functions are controlled using the following key bindings:
-Enable/disable settings mode: Right Shift key + L
-Toggle rotation mode: Y key
-Zoom: Left Ctrl key + Page Up/Page Down
-Select next map: End key (only available if multiple maps are present in the vehicle)

Please note that rotation mode and zoom can only be changed when settings mode is enabled. This prevents accidental changes to the settings while working.

Changelog 1.1.0.0:
- Added display of GPS track inside the vehicle
- Fixed double binding of the Y key
- Now supports multiple PDAs
- RealGPS can now also be used in Dashboard Compounds

Changelog 1.2.0.0:
- Added several vehicles to the default supported vehicles list
- Added support for Assets

Changelog 1.3.0.0:
- Extended the default supported vehicles list
- Preparation for compatibility with Dashboard Live (upcoming Version 2.1.0.0)
- When multiple maps are installed in the vehicle, the currently selected map can now be displayed for a period of 5 seconds by pressing lShift + End.

318291.title: Major Service
318291.author: twproductions
318291.description:
Are those equipment repair costs starting to hurt the bank balance? Then it's time to give your equipment a Major Service.

Damage on new equipment starts slow but increases to a peak normally at 50 hours. For example, harvesting a 43 ha (106 ac) field (4 hours of work) with a brand-new combine causes 10% damage, while harvesting the same field with a combine that has 50 hours of use results in 37% damage.

Giving the combine with 50 hours on it a Major Service will make it act like new again. The Major Service costs 5% of the price paid for the equipment and can be done from as early as 25 hours but will be needed again in another 25 - 50 hours. Nothing bad will happen if you do not do a Major Service.

NOTES:
10% damage costs the same to repair at 1 hour or 50 hours of use.
Works with "Repair and Paint Settings"

318936.title: Precision Farming
318936.author: GIANTS Software
318936.description:
Farming Simulator 25 gets a substantial boost in realism with new features and in-depth gameplay mechanics.
With Precision Farming 3.0, the continuation of an initially EU-financed project to promote sustainable farming technology, we add even more features and machines.
Precision Farming 3.0 also includes all the features of previous versions.

Tramlines & Subsidies

Tramlines help you to guide machinery along predetermined tracks on the ground for more precise field management and crop growth.
When planting catch crops like oilseed radish, Precision Farming 3.0 rewards you with subsidies to make nitrogen-saving planting more attractive than conventional fertilizing - just like in real farming.

Pulse Width Modulation & Section Control

Fine-tune sprayer settings using Pulse Width Modulation (PWM), which adjusts fertilizer output for smoother application, greater efficiency, and reduced environmental impact.

More Machines & Retro-Fit Sensors

Six machines are featured in Precision Farming 3.0.
New additions include the John Deere R975i trailed field sprayer and the HAWE body swap system to use with the Wienhoff 25.200 PTW Profi Line slurry tanker.
Additionally, existing sprayers can be retrofitted with Trimble WeedSeeker2 sensors for smart spot spraying of weeds.

Changelog: 1.2.1.0

Various improvements and bug fixes

Custom key bindings for the AdBlue display can now be defined in the configuration file.

Changelog: 1.2.0.0

AdBlue consumption system reworked
- Consumption now scales realistically with engine load and is fully synchronized in multiplayer.

New in-game AdBlue settings
- Choose between Low, Normal, High, or Custom usage levels.
- Custom value can be entered directly and takes effect instantly – synced across all clients.

Improved engine power limitation
- When AdBlue is empty, engine power is automatically limited to 10 %.
- A clear HUD warning is displayed to the player.

New HUD visuals and designs
- Multiple AdBlue display styles added (Classic, Modern, ExtraBar, Detailed etc.).
- Includes blinking warning when the tank is empty, and improved percentage / fill-level display.

Remaining range calculation
- Diesel and AdBlue remaining hours are now calculated and shown in real time, synchronized in multiplayer.

Fixed tank saving behavior
- Removed automatic 10 % refill – tanks now save and load exact fill levels.

Added idle engine load
- Engines now maintain a slight fluctuating load (4–5 %) at idle for more realistic behavior.

General stability and performance improvements
- Optimized event handling, reduced overhead, and cleaned up debug output.

319635.title: Production Watcher
319635.author: Temmmych
319635.description:
This mod adds a notification system for production facilities.

Alerts are triggered in the following cases:
- Input materials drop below 5% or run out.
- Output storage exceeds 95% or becomes full (with direct selling disabled).

Each production can send only one active notification for raw materials and one for output storage to avoid spam. Priority is always given to more critical alerts.
This helps prevent production downtime or product loss.

Default keys:
- Hide/Show all notifications: Shift+Q
- Cursor Hide/Show: MMB

This mod is a placeable object developed for players who wish to play in the style of stacking logs on forest roads and sawmills.
This log piling area has an invisible wall to prevent the stacked logs from collapsing due to the fluctuations of the physics engine in the game.
This invisible wall collides only with the logs and not with vehicles or cranes.
The height of the invisible wall is 3 meters. (Same height as the supports and poles.)

Metal and log supports have their own collision, but thin poles do not.
The “with area guide pole" version is an alternative for players who only want to use the anti-collapse feature of the logs.
The width of the pole matches the width of the invisible wall.

320162.title: Lizard Bulk-Liquid Silo & Trailer Pack
320162.author: Scandinavian Vikings Mod-Rebuilds Team
320162.description:
This pack from Lizard Motors, Storage, Goods and Logistics combined, brings you some essential tools for your farm.
- The silosystem is top of the line with capacity to store grains, liquids and methane, the liquid and methane silos is tested and trusted
thanks to the solid build with both carbon steel and 304 grade stainless steel followed by back welding interior seems and comprehensive pressure testing.
The grain Silo offers optimal performance with high quality galvanized steel sheets with fireproof screw connections. It is stable, robust and
durable, resistant protected against corrosion and it is waterproof. The silo is made with inner walls without scracks that is self cleaning upon
releasing, therefor requires little to no maintenance.
The unloading/loading gates has been widened to allow entrance for extra large vehicles eg. tractors with wide wheels or double axles. This silo-system
has the capacity to store most grains and liquids offered from the local farms.
The silo has a built in conversion-technology to create compost materials such as; straw, hay, silage, forage etc. into Digestate. So instead of using
expensive liquidfertilisers you can dump all your organic materials in the silo and convert it to Digestate which is a more sustainable solution for agriculture
and has various benefits to your crops; Nutrient-rich soil amendment, Organic matter and soil structure improvement, Reduced environmental impact,
Closing the nutrient loop, Enhanced resilience and climate adaptation. This silo system is especially beneficial since youy have most of your harvest and
products storage all in one place which is space saving and cost effective.

Our liquid bulk trailers are driving silos that are able to transport a wide range of different liquids; chemicals, ADR and Non-ADR bulk goods such as foodgrade liquids in our sanitary tanks.
They are equipped with air compressors and hydraulics that allow for easier unloading up to 30m high silos.

320252.title: Future Tech Production
320252.author: (KaiGo Modding) emproLoop
320252.description:
Future Tech Production

The gold rush was just the beginning—now the future begins.
With Future Tech Production, your farm becomes an industrial hub for high-tech materials and electronic end products.
What started as a simple universal crusher has evolved into a modular production network with nine independent buildings.
Each production unit fulfills a specific role within a well-structured supply chain—from raw material extraction to refined components and finally to gaming hardware.

The journey begins with the Universal Crusher, which transforms stone and wood into valuable base materials.
Thanks to advanced processing techniques, stones are crushed multiple times, reducing consumption and producing fine sand ready for further processing.
Additionally, the crusher processes wood into woodchips—ideal for anyone needing organic material or looking to sell woodchips.

With placeable extraction units for sand, iron ore, and coal, you’ll have a steady supply of raw materials for your factories.
The Iron Furnace refines iron ore into metal and further into refined metal, which is then used in the Tool Forge to produce hammers, shovels, and spades.

In parallel, the Silicon & Ore Processing facility extracts silicon, gold, and copper from quartz sand and ores.
Silicon is then processed into semiconductors—an essential component for the GamingTech factory, where gaming PCs and graphics cards are assembled.

The final stage is the NextGen Hardware Plant, where copper, gold, semiconductors, bioplastic, and refined metal are used to manufacture circuit boards and case parts—the core components of your high-tech products.

The mod also includes a freely placeable selling station where all end products can be sold directly.

320516.description:

Changelog: 1.1.0.1

Fix for Patch 1.14.0.0:

Fixed a bug that caused all gates and doors to disappear after loading a save game. This was particularly noticeable with fences.

Changelog: 1.1.0.0

Distance check added
- Gates and doors now open earlier as soon as a vehicle gets close.

Ownership check implemented
- Checks whether the player or the vehicle belongs to the same farm as the land owner.
- Can be enabled or disabled in the game settings.

Ownership rules:
- If the player or vehicle belongs to the same farm → the gate opens.
- If the land has no owner → nobody can open the gate.
- If the player/vehicle is not the owner or a member of the farm → the gate stays closed.
- If the ownership check is disabled → all gates open automatically as soon as you are in front of them.

New options in the “General Settings” menu:
- Adjustable close delay (time before the gate closes automatically).
- Enable/disable ownership check.
- Manual open/close is possible again.

Fixes
- Fence gates are now also detected and will open automatically when a vehicle approaches.

320829.title: Nordkirchen
320829.author: FrechDachs93
320829.description:
Nordkirchen is an idyllic map built according to the original terrain.
The area reflects the agricultural region of Nordkirchen, north of Dortmund.
It is not a 1 to 1 replica, but close to the original area.

Key data:
• Standard area for building and farming
• 63 fields (287 ha / Ø 4.56 ha)
• 7 meadows/pastures
• 8 forest areas with 10,383 trees
• Realistic ground deformation
• Precision Farming 3.0 compatible
• Permanently integrated productions: seed, fertilizer, lime & feed production, composter, separator & water disposal
• 9 buying points and 13 selling points
• 4 production facilities
• One permanently installed 1 MW biogas plant (BGA)
• 50 collectibles
• 9 additional crops: rye, triticale, spelt, green rye, vetch rye, field grass, silage maize, humus activator, and mustard
• Stubble destruction for: barley, canola, maize, oats, sorghum, soybeans, sunflowers, wheat, rye, triticale, spelt, green rye, and vetch rye
• For map design, 84 ground textures and 77 trees are available, as well as decorative grass (meadow)

Info:
• For players who start the game without a starting farm, three fully designed farms are available.
• For better clarity, decorative grass can be enabled or disabled in the crop overview.
• Additional productions can be placed freely.
• Decorative grass (meadow) is paintable and can be enabled or disabled via crops.
• The base production pack is not required, as all relevant productions are already integrated.
• Compost can be used as fertilizer.
• Manure spreaders support both manure and compost, including correct spreading patterns for compost.
• All functions are fully compatible with Precision Farming.
• Under Settings → Help you will find basic information about the map.
• Using the arrows next to “Base Game” you can browse through additional hints.

With version 1.3.0.0, you'll need a new save file.

321344.description:
No more worrying about water! Progress has come and now there are water pipes on your farm. Install this pump near a stable or greenhouse and you will no longer have to worry about water,
as this pump will connect the existing water pipes on your farm to the animal drinking troughs and greenhouses.

- Category: Silo extensions
- Price $5,000
- Daily maintenance $5

WARNING: Some custom stables (third-party mods) are programmed to reject silo extensions. If installed near one of these stables, water may appear visually in the menu, but the animals'
health will not improve. If this happens, it means the stable is incompatible with the game's native extension system.

CRITICAL NOTE: This piping and water pump is a silo extension already filled with water. If you sell it, the water inside will also be sold, granting you a large amount of money.
To avoid this when reinstalling or removing the mod, use one of these methods:
1. (PC Only): Sell the pump normally and use the "Easy Development Controls" mod to remove the extra money.
2. (All Platforms / Consoles): Save your game, exit to the main menu, disable this mod, reload your save, save again, and exit. When you re-enable the mod and enter the game,
the pump will have disappeared safely without adding any money to your account.

321509.title: Corteva Circular Pivot Irrigation
321509.author: Hispano
321509.description:
Corteva Pivot Circular Irrigation
Category: Yield Improvements / Sprayers

ATTENTION: For the correct operation of this mod, read carefully everything in this description, otherwise the mod may not work properly, waste a little of your time reading and so you can fully enjoy the mod.

Circular pivot systems irrigate large areas in a circular fashion.
They are used in places where water is a strong limiting factor.
Pivot irrigation efficiency is 85% to 90%.
Liquid fertilizers and herbicides can also be added to the irrigation.

For the pivots to work, I have had to integrate them into a vehicle with a motor.
This way it can work without the need to be attached to a motor vehicle.
We can also leave them working without the need to be on the vehicle.
For this we need to have the automatic start disabled in the vehicle options.
Even so, the vehicles turn off after 3 minutes if we move away from it more than 300 meters.

Now let's see the features and its operation.

Features (In order in the store)
- Base price: 45.800 $.
- Working widths: 68 meters, 124 meters, 180 meters and 236 meters.
- Field contour guides: (Yes or No)
- Coupler configuration: Low coupler (Ball) or Normal coupler (Pin)
- Number of sessions: 1 Section (68 meters radius), 2 Sections (124 meters radius),3 Sections (180 meters radius) or 4 Sections (236 meters radius)
- Rotation and duration configuration: Full lap, 3/4 lap, 1/2 lap and 1/4 lap, durations 3, 5, 10, 20 and 30 minutes.
- Note: The short durations (3 and 5 minutes) make the pivot turn very fast and at the beginning and end it hits.
- Color configurations.
- Tank capacity: 4000 liters of liquid fertilizer or herbicide.
- Consumption of liquid fertilizer or herbicide: 500 liters in the complete turn and duration of 30 minutes.

Operation.
- Warnings: The pivot can only be unfolded and folded in the initial pivot position. Never rotate the pivot if it is not unfolded.
- Take the trailer to the field where we want to install it.
- Note: Although the pivot adapts well to sloping terrain, it works best and has the least vibration on flat terrain.
- If we select the guides in the store, we can make them visible with the left mouse button and see if it fits where we want to place it, these guides are also useful for drawing the fields.
- It is necessary to smooth the area where we are going to place the pivot and remove the layer of soil, otherwise the base will have vibrations.
- We place the trailer in the direction we want the pivot to go out, the pivot is deployed towards the back of the trailer.
- Once placed in the place we want, we uncouple it from the vehicle with which we transport it, we approach the trailer and we get on it, as if it were a normal vehicle (E key).
- Now we deploy the pivot with the Z key (open cover), the more sessions the pivot has the more difficult it is to deploy, until the red rotating lights go out it is not fully deployed.
- Now we fill the tanks with liquid fertilizer or herbicide.
- Note: Diesel should never be filled as it has 0 consumption.
- Once deployed and filled the tanks, we turn on the sprayer with the B key and give the turn with the X key.
- Now we can get off the pivot and let it work.
- The pivot stops automatically when it reaches the end, but the sprayers do not turn off, you have to turn them off manually.

321793.title: Use Up Your Tyres
321793.author: 50keda
321793.description:
Use-up-Your-Tyres takes your driving experience and vehicle maintenance to another level.

Did you ever wonder what happens when tyres get old and used?
This mod gives you perfect chance to experience tyres usage progression (visual and physical) and manage their replacement.

Tyres will get used with the traveled distance. By default tyre with diameter of 2m,
will get fully worn at around 38km of traveled ground distance,
which at normal vehicle usage should last around 1 in-game year.

Possible settings for tyre usage:
* 0.1x - tyre with diameter 2m will last for 3.8km
* 1x (DEFAULT) - tyre with diameter 2m will last for 38km
* 2x - tyre with diameter 2m will last for 76km
* 5x - tyre with diameter 2m will last for 190km
* 10x - tyre with diameter 2m will last for 380km
* 20x - tyre with diameter 2m will last for 760km
* 50x - tyre with diameter 2m will last for 1900km

Functions:
* Tyre thread gets visually used and resized with traveled distance
* Each bought tyre set has persistent wear value, changing between sets will restore previous wear instead of resetting it to zero
* Grip reduced on loose surface when tyre gets visually used
* Replacement mechanics added to the workshop screens
* Ability to change tyre wear rate trough settings: Game Settings -> Use Your Tyres -> Tyre Usage Rate

322424.title: Hardcore Balance Mod
322424.author: ALXXA
322424.description:
This mod makes the gameplay more difficult, making it more interesting and balanced. For a improve the game, it is recommended to start a new game.

Gameplay changes:

Disabling time acceleration. Time acceleration only during sleep. It's necessary for you to construct a farmhouse.
Removed sleep and wardrobe triggers from all farmhouses except of those that need to be constructed.
Price the field reduction after purchase by 50% (after the sale the price is restored).
No Fast Travel (player position is remembered).
Removed vehicles from contracts.
Added a penalty for canceling a contract in the amount of 50% of the reward.
The emergence of new contracts has been improved. Missions to rocks removal, deadwood, and wood transport are now generated once per hour.
Interest rate on the loan 15% per month. The initial credit limit is zero (credit limit increases as purchasing farmlands and buildings).
The output mode of production cannot be changed (default is Storing).
The price of decorational trees has increased by 10 times.
Fixed incorrect operation of wood chippers, now the mass of outgoing wood chips is equal to the mass of loaded woods (less wood chips).
The maximum pick up mass by hands has been reduced to 50 kg.
The fermentation time of silage is 1 month, regardless of the economic difficulty.

Changelog Version 1.0.0.6:
Added support for French and Polish languages.
All productions has been accelerated by 10 times. Except for the Wagon Builder, Playground Maker Hall (RIVERBEND SPRINGS), and Piano Manufacture (ZIELONKA).

322705.title: Wampsville, NY
322705.author: DTAPGAMING/StarSpangledModz
322705.description:
Category: Maps
++++++++++

VERY IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT - This map pack includes more fillTypes than standard maps, letting you grow more crops and do more activities. However, this also means it conflicts with any production Mod that adds any new products or materials as well as mods that add fillTypes like "additional FillTypes" for now until I can get them to update their mods. Issues can include things like “scooping iron but getting barley,”. If you accidentally Save with these mods in the map, it may require a new save to get full functionality back. NOTE: The DLC "Straw Harvest" conflicts with this map as well, it sounds like they are aware of the issue and may be coming out with a fix for it!

We apologize for this and understand it may steer many away from playing this map until a fix is implemented.

We also know you can not sell to the Market Place on farmland 35 unless you own the land, this is because you can sell it so you must be able to "own it" to sell it.

++++++++++

Wampsville is Calling — Will You Rise to the Challenge?
The land is waiting. The opportunity is yours. Do you have what it takes to conquer Wampsville and build your legacy in agriculture?

You find yourself in New York, standing at the crossroads of three vastly different paths—each one a unique test of your skills, strategy, and ambition. Will you thrive in the modern farming world, battle against untamed nature, or shape the land from the ground up?


Wampsville, NY - Forestry Edition (NPC Story Line 1)
Travel back in time before modern agriculture took over. Towering forests and untouched wilderness stand between you and your dreams. Will you carve out a homestead, create sprawling farmlands, or dominate the logging industry? The wild is yours to tame.
NOTE: This map has increased chances of severe weather events like tornadoes and storms, so be prepared!

Wampsville, NY - DIY Edition (NPC Story Line 2)
The loggers have left, and now the land is yours to shape from scratch. No forests to clear, no fields require to be maintained — just pure creative freedom. Design roads, neighborhoods, and farmlands exactly how YOU see fit. Will you build the ultimate farming empire, plant some forests, or make a city to just maintain yards and roleplay?

Wampsville, NY - Homestead Edition (NPC Story Line 3)
The fields are prepped, the land is ready—this is farming at its finest. With a realistic rural layout and plenty of room for expansion, the only question is: Can you turn this land into an agricultural powerhouse?

The choice is yours, but one thing is certain… only the strongest will thrive in Wampsville. Which path will you take?

Key Features:
Precision Farming Compatible!
RolePlay Friendly!
Mining and forestry opportunities.
Custom Tall Grass, & Tall Mixed Meadow type for a more American style vibe (produces more yield and taller then the height of base game grass).
Three unique map editions to choose from.
Custom Non-Player Characters (NPCs) with voices, (Mouths can not move as we dont have access to base game NPCs, so we can not Keyframe the mouth movement to our conversations).
Ability to move most NPCs around to different predefined locations like their new houses once you build them (the preplaced ones). Stand just outside the start conversation trigger to see the prompt, (controller users may need to use both bumpers to see the prompt) Keybinded to (Switch Vehicle Seat in your keybinds).
Ability to remove ALMOST all NPCs from the map enitirely so you can make use of the land they occupy (can not remove the ones that are on nonbuyable land) see "Tell The NPCs To Take A Train To Somewhere Else" on the map (Train Icon).
Custom production chains and factories.
Unique placeables and buildings including custom houses for NPCs without spawning points.
Custom sell point with NPC that will explain how to use it (buys anything with a price in the commodity list from players).
Anything on buyable land should be able to be sold or cut down once purchased including but not limited to ponds.
In Each Map Kenneths Conversation Changes a little bit to fit the "predeffined" development of the map you are playing on.
You can Paint over the Quarrys to delete the product if Mining is not your thing and you would rather utilize the space in another way.
The Store does contain the NPC Houses so you may purchase them and place them where you see fit (just know the NPCs will not spawn by them unless you place them in the Location the NPCs already move to).
Purchasable placeables in the shop in the following categories: SHEDS, CONSTRUCTABLES, CONTAINERS, TOOLS, FACTORIES, and DECORATION.
Purchasable vehicles in the shop in the following categories: Wheel Loader Tools, and Cotton Harvesters.
Custom multistory Collectable Museum (sellable and purchasable [LIMIT 1 per map]) to show off the collectibles you find on the map.
The Terraforming soil map is implemented for PC players (does not support crossplay)

Forestry Edition - Unique farmland Layout (55), 1 Field, 25 Collectables to find, 2 Quarries, 1 Pile of relocated stone on your starting land, Opening Story Line from Kenneth, Multiple Factories (purchase some to buy the land they sit on sell them off to keep the land, these lands are unsellable once obtained).

DIY Edition - Unique farmland Layout (98), 1 Field, 25 Collectables to find, 2 Quarries, Kenneth Rants about Big Machinery, Multiple Factories (purchase some to buy the land they sit on sell them off to keep the land, these lands are unsellable once obtained).

Homestead Edition - Unique farmland Layout (74), 33 Fields, 25 Collectables to find, 2 Quarries, Kenneth explains how the layout of the land came to be, Multiple Factories (purchase some to buy the land they sit on sell them off to keep the land, these lands are unsellable once obtained).

Multiple crop types including: Alfalfa, Clover, Rye, Triticale, Millet, Spelt, Mustard, Buckwheat, Poppy, Lentils, Flax. (Thank you Iron Thunder for the custom crops!) - rework of Icons by Dtapgaming.
Custom Animal Dealer - Truck and trailer to Truck and Trailer - Brought to you by FarmHub Modding!
American Tall Grass, Location Choice, initial map development, road mapping, and map: HOMESTEAD EDITION, and more Brought to you by StarSpangledModz!
NPCs, Conversations, Movable NPCs, Lizard Inc, Custom Iron Stone and Sand Productions & products, a lot of the Custom Crop Productions, Simplified NPC Constructables, license plates, Custom Shop Purchase Buildings for each map, and map: FORESTRY EDITION, & more Brought To you by Dtapgaming!
DIY Edition is a collaboration between both of us for the layout and design choices made!
Thank you to our Alpha and Beta Testers for helping us find bugs and issues with the map! We appreciate you So much!

323135.title: Interactive Control
323135.author: Vertex Dezign
323135.description:
'Interactive Control' is a global script mod for Farming Simulator 25. While this mod is active, you are able to use many other mods that support Interactive Control. With IC you get the possibility to control many parts of several (prepared) vehicles interacitvly.

'IC' provides different possibilities to interact with your vehicles. You can use click icons that appear when you turn on IC or when you are nearby. Another way for interactive handling is a key binding event. The controls are able to be used as switch or to force a state. All interactions are generally possible to use from the inside and the outside of a vehicle.

Using the controls you can steer different things:

- Play animations (e.g. to open/close windows, fold/unfold warning signs, ...)
- Call specific functions (e.g. Start/Stop Motor, TurnOn/Off tool, Lift/Lower attacher joints, ...)
- ObjectChanges (to change translation/rotation/visibility/...)

A few vehicles are already equipped with IC

For further informations: README on Github.

323354.title: Stoll Frontloader Pack
323354.author: ASSASSINTV2, Dean_Blacky
323354.description:
Included in this pack are the Stoll FZ30 and FZ60. These are also available from Case as LRZ120 and LRZ150 and from New Holland as TL750|FZ30 and TL750|FZ60.
(In reality, New Holland only has the maximum size of the FZ30.)
Fits best with my Stoll consoles that are available as prefabs.

Top Class. Made in Germany.
Experience the full power of the STOLL ProfiLine. The impressive top values in all areas ensure the highest quality in lifting capacity and height, stability, and loading speed. On top of that, the individually selectable accessories of the entire ProfiLine perfectly match your needs as a farmer or contractor. True professionals for professionals.

Full Power – Slim Design
- The ProfiLine FZ front loaders are made from fine-grained steel. Advantage: High stability and torsional rigidity combined with a slim and lightweight design.
- The loader boom is bent from a single piece of steel. Control rods are built inside the boom. All hydraulic lines are well protected but remain easily accessible underneath the boom.
- The front loader has low own weight but immense performance strength. The reduced weight minimizes strain on the tractor’s front axle, significantly extending its lifespan.
- To avoid the regular replacement of hose lines within the booms as required by DIN 20066, we use wear-free steel hydraulic pipes in this area.

Z-Kinematics – Best Visibility and High Performance
- The mechanical parallel guidance linkage is inside the loader booms—the foundation of Z-kinematics.
- This allows for clear visibility for the driver. No parts obstruct the view above the loader. Another plus: The front loader can be mounted closer to the driver’s cab, reducing the strain on the tractor due to optimally placed mounting parts.
- No loss of lifting power. Front loaders with Z-kinematics have even greater lifting and breakout forces.

Generational Marvel – Drive-in System
For over three decades, STOLL front loaders have been easy to mount on your tractor—thanks to the Drive-in function. STOLL has continuously refined and optimized the system for your convenience. The good news: Despite all improvements, one thing has remained unchanged for 30 years—the mounting principle.
We believe this consistency works in your favor. Your new front loader fits perfectly with our proven console. This system is now a fundamental standard for front loaders.

Slim Solution. Clear View.
Slim design thanks to Z-kinematics and fine-grained steel. Hop in, start driving—with a clear view! Keep an eye on the entire field or the rooftops of cars. Because the loader boom is made of lighter fine-grained steel, it results in an exceptionally slim design. Additionally, all pipes and lines are positioned so that they do not obstruct the driver’s field of vision. The mechanical parallel guidance linkage is inside the loader boom, thanks to Z-kinematics. The hydraulic accumulator of Comfort-Drive is placed optimally within a crossbar.
Perfect visibility for the driver comes with smart advantages: They see everything happening around the tractor, allowing for even more precise and effortless work. Precision through safety.

- FZ30
Price: 5.400$
PS: 90-120

- FZ60
Price: 8.000$
PS: 150-230

323407.title: CLAAS Jaguar 800 Series
323407.author: EED123
323407.description:
The JAGUAR 800 model series had an advance premiere with a small preproduction run in 1993.
From the 1994 season, the new forage harvester generation was then available to all customers. The new series was fitted with engines delivering 228 kW (310 hp) to 354 kW (481 hp).
Installed behind the steering axle crosswise to the direction of travel, simple direct-drive systems provided an optimum supply of cooling air and easy access to the inside of the machine.
In preparation for harvesting grass silage, for example, the CORN CRACKER could simply be rolled to the rear and replaced with a grass shaft.
This innovative configuration has set the trend for the state-of-the-art forage harvesters on the market today.
Thanks to the favourable drive axle loading, it became possible for the first time to attach eight-row maize headers. The exceptional visual design of the new CLAAS forage harvesters inspired confidence at first glance.
The spacious cab featured a curved front windscreen and sloping roof, for the first time providing two seats, for the driver and a passenger when required. Central lubrication was also included.
An accelerator was placed directly behind the CORN CRACKER to speed up the forage crop flow.
A significant power milestone was passed in 2001, with 445 kW (605 hp) under the bonnet of the JAGUAR 900.
Even the smallest model in the family delivered a highly impressive 236 kW (321 hp).
The proven basic structure and visual design were taken over essentially unchanged from the predecessor family, with some new features such as mudguards above the wheels steering the machine, and the contemporary tailgate design.
The driver workstation was completely redesigned, however. All functions were easily set and monitored from the terminal. For example, the cutting cylinder sharpening process could be controlled from the driver’s seat, and the optimum shear bar setting could be selected.
To ensure that the JAGUAR could be on the spot, ready to start work, at the same time as the tractor and transport vehicles, as from the 2003 season, there was a fast travel SPEEDSTAR version available by request, with a top speed of 40 km/h.

324019.title: Split Brakes
324019.author: ChristophK
324019.description:
Description:
This mod adds split brakes to each tractor, allowing the rear wheels to be braked independently. In reality, many old as well as modern tractors have such brakes.

The use of split brakes is particularly helpful when transporting heavy loads, when the tractor becomes too light on the front axle and is difficult to steer over the front wheels. In such cases, the tractor can be turned around the blocked wheel by selectively braking a rear wheel.

This mod is a real must-have, especially for short manoeuvring work or forestry work. The split brake can be used up to a speed of 15 km/h. For an even better and more realistic driving experience, we recommend setting the gear shift mode to manual.

Hotkeys:
- Left split brake: Alt + Numpad 1
- Right split brake: Alt + Numpad 3

Changelog 1.1.0.0:
- Fixed an issue where the vehicle would not move when Split Brakes were applied
- Fixed an issue where the RPM would not drop
- Enabled smoother braking
- Optimized parameters for realistic physics

324487.title: Easy Development Controls
324487.author: GtX
324487.description:
Easy Development Controls is designed as a testing tool for modders, mappers and content creators. It can also assist with gameplay setups or however you wish to play the game.

It includes some features available already through the game console commands but now easily accessible and also the addition of many new custom features.

Most features support use in Multiplayer and permission levels of some commands can be adjusted. This now also includes existing console commands that previously only worked for the host.

Some quality of life features include:

- Teleport: Quickly move yourself or vehicles around the map by selecting a location on the map, by field number or x/z coordinates.
- Flip Vehicles: Allows a user to easily correct upright rotation of a vehicle.
- Super Strength: Increases a players carrying capacity and pickup range.
- Hud Visibility: Shows and hides the whole hud, you can also activate a key binding for faster access.
- Show Bale Locations: This will display all farm owned bales on the map.
- Show Pallet Locations: This will display all farm owned pallets on the map.
- Advance Growth: Advances all crops to the next growth stage.

With the extended number of features plus many new features planned, Easy Development Controls has something for everyone.

For further information please see the README on the Github repository.
https://github.com/GtX-Andy/FS25_EasyDevelopmentControls

Inputs:
- Open Menu: F12


Changelog 1.2.0.0:
- The current location of the 'defaultUserSettings.xml' is now displayed in the 'ABOUT' section of the EDC Help page.

- It is now possible to close the menu using the 'Open Menu' key binding. This feature can be disabled in the 'defaultUserSettings.xml' under 'toggleMenuMode' if required.
- Some general improvements and bug fixes are included along with the following.

- [General] Feature 'Stop Time' now allows restarting of time also, time state is displayed on button using a play and pause icons.
- [General] Feature 'Set Quality' now restores 'User Default Settings' when exiting the game to the main menu to avoid potential issues.
- [General] Fermenting bales in Object Storage buildings are no longer displayed when 'Show Bale Locations' is enabled.
- [Objects] Fermenting bales in Object Storage buildings are no longer deleted when using 'Remove Bales' feature.
- [Objects] Fermenting bales in Object Storage buildings are no longer displayed in the bales counter when there is no game limit.
- [Objects] Correct ground height is now used on slopes when using the 'Plant Tree' feature.
- [Objects] Feature 'Add Log' now supports Highlands Fishing Expansion log types where possible.
- [Objects] Box pallets for crops spawned using the 'Add Pallet' feature now includes a discharge node for use at tip points.
- [Vehicles] Added 'Vehicle Selection' feature, allowing implement selection change when vehicle is entered without leaving menu, useful when refilling multiple trailers etc.
- [Vehicles] Added 'Wetness Debug' feature as requested.
- [Permissions] Save changes popup is now shown when pressing ESC input or back button if required.

- Chinese Simplified (cs) translations added.
- Italian (it) translations updated.
- Spanish (es) translations updated.


Changelog 1.1.0.0:
- [General] Fixed bug where some POI icons would remain hidden after using teleport screen.
- [General] Fixed bug where setting 'Show Collectables' above 70% would be incorrectly displayed when re-opening menu.
- [General] Removed outdated help information for 'Delete Objects Key'.
- [Player] Fixed incorrect setting allowing 'Super Strength' state to be saved on dedicated servers.
- [Vehicles] It is now possible to set operating hours to 0 or 2 decimal places.
- [Vehicles] Fixed 'Condition' incorrectly applying selected state type.
- [Placeables] Fixed 'Tip To Trigger' text box not always enabling/disabling when opening menu.

- Ukrainian (uk) translations added.
- Brazilian Portuguese (br) translations updated.
- Czech (cz) translations updated.
- French (fr) translations updated.
- Polish / Polski (pl) translations updated.
- German (de) translations updated.

- Adjusted some default user settings to the 'off' state and prevent them from saving with the game to avoid user confusion.

Note: Due to mod changes the defaultUserSettings.xml file will be updated to the new mod defaults. As with previous releases these settings can be adjusted allowing them to be automatically applied when joining a multiplayer game or starting a new local save.

Release 1.0.0.0:
