324518.description:
First, let's start with a little time travel. The building was built around the year 1820. At that time, both the farmer's family and the servants (maid and servant) were on the farm. Any work was done by hand or with animals.
In 1902, the property included 12.3 hectares of meadow and 5.8 hectares of arable land. It is recorded that around 1938 one horse, six cows, two oxen, four to six calves, five to six sheep, one to two pigs and around 20 poultry were kept on the farm.
So you can see, it was never a big farm. The barn was converted into a tethered barn in 1940. In 1990 the barn was rebuilt again and now has space for 15-20 cows, which are free to choose whether they want to be inside or outside. The calves are also placed in the barn.
The hayloft can be driven on to store equipment or straw.

To distribute the products produced by the animals to the production factories, i.e bakery, dairy, spinnery etc.

324914.title: Realistic Animal Losses
324914.author: Fetty42
324914.description:
More Realistic Animal Management – Finally Real Consequences for Neglect!

In the standard version of Farming Simulator 25, you hardly need to worry as an animal keeper – your animals simply continue living, no matter how well (or poorly) you take care of them. This mod changes that fundamentally!
From now on, your actions will have a direct impact on the well-being of your animals. If feed, water, or straw are missing – or if the feed isn’t effective enough – you risk losing animals. This makes animal management not only more realistic but also more challenging and exciting.

These factors can lead to a decline in your animal population:

Age:
Once animals reach a certain age, there is a 10% risk they won’t be in the barn the next evening.
Horses: from 60 months
Pigs: from 40 months
Cows & Buffalo: from 50 months
Sheep & Goats: from 30 months
Chickens & Roosters: from 30 months
(Note: These age thresholds are intentionally set somewhat unrealistically to make the mechanic noticeable.)

Care:
If the overall feed effectiveness is too low, or if water or straw are missing, the risk can increase to up to 100%.
You can adjust the threshold for feed effectiveness in the mod menu to control the risk. By default, it’s set to 90% – below that, the risk of animal loss increases.

Daily Check at 6 PM:
Every evening, an automatic check assesses the state of your animals. If problems are detected, you’ll receive a warning message – giving you one last chance to act before it’s too late.

Multiplayer Compatible:
Even if a player is absent in multiplayer mode, their barns will still be checked – animal welfare doesn’t take breaks!

Changelog 1.1.0.0:
- Settings are now stored in the savegame directory and the multiplayer usage has been corrected.
- Warning messages about the age and supply of your animals have been adjusted.

For error reports or suggestions, please visit: https://github.com/Fetty42/FS25_RealisticAnimalLosses/issues or https://forum.giants-software.com/viewtopic.php?t=208708

325232.title: Longer Lasting Mud
325232.author: RichOPick
325232.description:
Longer Lasting Mud.

This mod adds a game option which allows you to control how long mud should remain visible on wheels, using a linear multiplier.

I've always loved the look of muddy tires, and felt the game cleaned them up too quickly when driving off the field. This mod
keeps the tires muddy for more time (or less, depending on your configuration).

In the 'General Settings' tab you will find the 'Mud length multiplier' setting. This option sets the multiplier for how long mud
should remain on the wheels after driving off a field. Larger numbers make the mud last longer. The mod's value default is 5.0. The
game's default value is 1.0.

Under-the-hood, this mod divides the off-field multiple for cleaning wheels (a negative value) by the multiple provided in the settings.

Please leave bug reports, feedback, or suggestions on my GitHub: https://github.com/richpet9/longer-lasting-mud.

325700.title: Courtright Line
325700.author: FSG Modding - DaVaR
325700.description:
Courtright Line – A Canadian-Inspired Farming Experience

Welcome to Courtright Line, a 4x map for Farming Simulator 25, inspired by the vast, open farmland of southern Ontario, Canada. Built for those who demand space and efficiency, Courtright Line features massive, flat fields designed for the biggest machinery and long hours of uninterrupted work. A carefully designed industrial park with a fully functional train silo adds logistical depth, offering streamlined storage and transport options. Every element of the landscape has been crafted to reflect the scale and character of real Canadian farming, delivering a true large-scale agricultural experience.

Key Features:
- 68 expansive fields, perfect for large-scale farming
- Start from scratch — no prebuilt farms or starting equipment
- Multiple farm-ready plots available, carefully paired with select fields
- Fully functional train system with additional grain cars for efficient transport
- Small animal dealer for livestock operations
- Two conveniently located fuel stations
- Sawmill for wood production needs
- Limited but purposeful forestry areas
- Handful of strategically placed sell points within a dedicated industrial park
- Farmers Market offering diverse selling opportunities
- And much more to discover as you build your farming empire

Perfect for multiplayer! Happy Farming!

Changelog 1.1.0.0
- Reworked all oversized weight maps to improve overall performance.
- Enlarged a handful of farmlands to enable more field combination options.
- New Savegame Required.

325794.title: Fill Level Limiter
325794.author: GtX
325794.description:
This global vehicle specialisation is added to most fillable vehicles such as trailers, trains and seeders.
The user is then free to set the maximum fill limit they wish the trailer to stop filling at. Very useful if you only want to collect a set amount from a silo or buy point.

Limits are saved for each vehicle and can be reset whenever required in the GUI.

Input:
- Open Menu: R-ALT + L

Important:
- This mod by design will not allow the maximum capacity to be increased above the default level.
- Access to the menu is only available when a supported vehicle is entered and selected.
- Due to limited button combinations no Input is set for controllers however this can easily be configured via the Controls screen.


Changelog 1.0.1.0:

The whole map area is mostly flat so you are able to start your own farm on any field or open area. The total size of the map is 1 by 1 km. When you buy Farmland 60 you will get the "Unbuyable" land between the fields and around certain productions. That way you can merge fields into bigger fields if you want to. And it is free to buy!

You can get water from the canals, 2 smaller ponds but NOT from the ditches that seperate the fields!

No collectibles

I hope you have a lot of fun on Klein Friesland!

326297.title: Stoll Frontloader GTA Xylon Pack
326297.author: ASSASSINTV2,Dean_Blacky
326297.description:
Stoll Frontloader for the Fendt GTA and the Fendt Xylon

Top Class. Made in Germany.
Experience the full power of the STOLL ProfiLine. The impressive top values in all areas ensure the highest quality in lifting capacity and height, stability, and loading speed. On top of that, the individually selectable accessories of the entire ProfiLine perfectly match your needs as a farmer or contractor. True professionals for professionals.

Full Power – Slim Design
- The ProfiLine FZ front loaders are made from fine-grained steel. Advantage: High stability and torsional rigidity combined with a slim and lightweight design.
- The loader boom is bent from a single piece of steel. Control rods are built inside the boom. All hydraulic lines are well protected but remain easily accessible underneath the boom.
- The front loader has low own weight but immense performance strength. The reduced weight minimizes strain on the tractor’s front axle, significantly extending its lifespan.
- To avoid the regular replacement of hose lines within the booms as required by DIN 20066, we use wear-free steel hydraulic pipes in this area.

Z-Kinematics – Best Visibility and High Performance
- The mechanical parallel guidance linkage is inside the loader booms—the foundation of Z-kinematics.
- This allows for clear visibility for the driver. No parts obstruct the view above the loader. Another plus: The front loader can be mounted closer to the driver’s cab, reducing the strain on the tractor due to optimally placed mounting parts.
- No loss of lifting power. Front loaders with Z-kinematics have even greater lifting and breakout forces.

Generational Marvel – Drive-in System
For over three decades, STOLL front loaders have been easy to mount on your tractor—thanks to the Drive-in function. STOLL has continuously refined and optimized the system for your convenience. The good news: Despite all improvements, one thing has remained unchanged for 30 years—the mounting principle.
We believe this consistency works in your favor. Your new front loader fits perfectly with our proven console. This system is now a fundamental standard for front loaders.

Slim Solution. Clear View.
Slim design thanks to Z-kinematics and fine-grained steel. Hop in, start driving—with a clear view! Keep an eye on the entire field or the rooftops of cars. Because the loader boom is made of lighter fine-grained steel, it results in an exceptionally slim design. Additionally, all pipes and lines are positioned so that they do not obstruct the driver’s field of vision. The mechanical parallel guidance linkage is inside the loader boom, thanks to Z-kinematics. The hydraulic accumulator of Comfort-Drive is placed optimally within a crossbar.
Perfect visibility for the driver comes with smart advantages: They see everything happening around the tractor, allowing for even more precise and effortless work. Precision through safety.


The FZ30 is for the Fendt GTA
Price: 5.400 $

The FZ60 is for the Fendt Xylon
Price: 8.000 $

The FarmCon24 - Fendt Pack is required

326424.title: 4 Bridges
326424.author: Bastian2103
326424.description:
Welcome to 4 Bridges, a small, idyllic island somewhere in the middle of the sea.
It is a fictional map, packed with little excursion spots that invite you to linger.
The four bridges connect the north and south of the island and, through their construction, have ended the decades-long conflict between North and South 4 Bridges.
This year, 1. FC 4Brücken is also hosting the annual Island Cup, where neighboring islands compete in a tournament.
A lighthouse guides visitors from afar to the island, even in the dark, where they are welcome to stay at the local hotel.
A freight port allows locally produced goods to be shipped all over the world.
Numerous hiking trails—especially near the waterfall—offer a great opportunity to unwind and recharge, making work in the fields more effective.
The island offers:
A starting farm with vehicles to kick off your farming operations
47 purchasable fields
Including 4 forest areas and 2 pastures
Various selling points, including a farmer’s market and a farm kiosk
Multiple production facilities to keep the island’s economy running
Naturally, there's also a BGA (biogas plant) for power generation
Cotton and rice have been removed due to regional conditions.
The map was hand-drawn to provide a clear PDA.

Field prices adjusted
Lime station added

Front yards and gardens of individual houses now have decorative grass instead of meadow.

326435.title: Crop-Dependent Rolling
326435.author: Sandmann
326435.description:
Crop-Dependent Rolling gives you control over which crops need a rolling pass after sowing.

Every supported crop on the currently loaded map is detected automatically and shown clearly in an in-game menu. For each crop you can choose individually between "Rolling required" and "No rolling". By default, the mod adopts the values given by the game or the map. This means additional crops on modded maps are supported as well. The settings apply immediately and area-precisely: areas already sown keep their state, while areas sown afterwards use the current setting.

In real farming, whether to roll a field does not depend on the crop alone. Soil type, moisture, seedbed condition, sowing method and weather all play a role. This mod's settings apply to the game's rolling mechanic and can be adjusted as you see fit - background on this is in the Information view of the menu.

2.0.0.0 - Major rework:
Version 1 used a fixed list of crops that needed no rolling (maize, sunflowers, cotton, sorghum, poplar, oilseed radish). That fixed list has been fully replaced with individual configuration.
- Every seedable crop on the map is detected automatically, including modded crops
- Configurable directly in an in-game menu instead of the Lua script
- Defaults to the values given by the game/map
- Settings are saved per savegame
- Multiplayer: server is authoritative, only admins can change settings
- NOTE: your previous manual edits to the script no longer apply

326754.title: Test Drive
326754.author: RichOPick
326754.description:
Test Drive.

This mod lets you test drive a vehicle free of charge for a very limited length of time. This is useful if you want to check the size or weight of a particular vehicle (for example, to see if it will be compatible with your implements) prior to purchasing.

By default, the test drive is free of charge for vehicles below $100,000, and lasts 2 minutes in real-time. If the vehicle is over $100,000, then the dealer will charge an insurance fee of 0.3% the value of the vehicle. Only drivable vehicles can be test driven.

This mod creates a "testDriveSettings.xml" file in the modSettings directory which can be used to configure:
- duration: the real-time length of the test drive, in minutes (default=2)
- insuranceThreshold: the price threshold for charging insurance (default=100000)
- insuranceRatio: the cost for insurance (when required) as a percent of total vehicle cost (default=0.003)
- onlyDrivables: if false, all vehicles can be test driven (default=true)

NOTE: This mod in not compatible with other mods which use the "MENU_EXTRA_2" key on the shop screen (by default the 'C' key).

Please leave bug reports, feedback, or suggestions on my GitHub: https://github.com/richpet9/test-drive.

327354.title: Welcome To Lehndorf
327354.author: FrankenPower
327354.description:
Welcome to Lehndorf! The East German map Lehndorf for Farming Simulator in the Bautzen district is a detailed and authentic game world that reflects the typical landscape and atmosphere of the region.
It offers a realistic recreation of rural life in Bautzen, with picturesque fields, forests, and small villages. The center is the town of Passditz, which is designed with traditional farms, agricultural buildings, and regional features.
The map is ideal for players who want to experience the East German flair and offers a variety of agricultural opportunities, from field work to animal husbandry, in an environment that reflects typical East German culture and nature.

Features:

- 20 fields, including 3 meadows, with a total area of 358 hectares. Ranging from 2.5 hectares to 61 hectares, there's something for everyone
- Various sales points for all the products that can be produced on the map
- Various locations to purchase products such as liquid manure, dung, seeds, lime, and fertilizer
- Production facilities for lime, seeds, mixed feed, and a bottling plant for roots
- The map offers a BGA, a large cow farm, a pig farm and a small side farm, perfect for those who want to start small or want to get started in multiplayer
- Extended soil angles for greater precision in tillage
- Real license plates installed
- Stubble destruction in lanes
- Multifruits from PfalzAgrar
- Animals: cows, pigs, sheep
- Car dealer with workshop
- Precision Farming compatible
- Missions: No wood transport, felling of dead trees and smashing of rocks possible
- You can get water from the 2 wells but they cost money
- All triggers are described with appropriate signs
- In order to use all functions at the ACZ site, this must be purchased.
- The gas station on the LPG site, as well as ACZ and the cow yard, must first be filled up.
- The filling plant on the LPG site and the lime production plant on the BGA site can only be filled using a front loader or telehandler.

Have fun farming in Lehndorf.

327848.title: Farm Pack - Tirschner
327848.author: Farmerfivetom
327848.description:
A farm, from the heart of Bavaria. The original is located near Tirschenreuth, a town in the Upper Palatinate.
The courtyard has been built in an L-shape. Attached to the house is the old stable, which today only serves as a garage.
The house was completely renovated only a few years ago, the rest of the courtyard shows slight signs of age, which do not stand in the way of the appearance.
The house is walkable and is therefore also great for role-playing.On the upper floor you will find the trigger to fade in or out of the wall of the house. More on that later.
Directly adjacent to the old barn is the L-shaped farm wing of the farm.
There you will find the hayloft, which also has a bulk silo for hay bales, as well as the hayloft, which offers space for many bales or equipment.
Directly behind it is the open machine hall. It has the ideal lenght for parking a tractor with a trailer.

In order to be able to build both buildings together and independently of each other, a trigger is installed that displays the missing components.
The one for the apartment building is located on the upper floor of the house.
The one for the stable inside on the left as soon as you enter the high driveway.

Farm building:
Purchase price: 140.000$
Daily maintenance 50$ / day
Cowshed:
Capacity: 30 cows
- Shop Category: Cows
- Feeding trough: Inside the building

327932.title: CVT Addon
327932.author: SbSh
327932.description:
This script adds a real CVT, hydrostatic, or HST transmission to all vehicles with continuously variable transmissions.
Configuration is done in the shop via a simple yes/no selection.
If you select "Yes," you can open a graphical user interface (GUI) in the game
to select the desired transmission variants and additional functions.

- Automatic rear work light when reversing and afterglow duration.
- High beam/high beam flasher can be controlled via a dedicated button.
- Drivetrains completely redesigned.
- Percentage-based accelerator pedals for HST, hydrostatic, electric, and continuously variable transmissions.
- HST and hydrostatic now with 2 pedals – the clutch is used to shift to reverse.
- Engine preheating depends on the outside temperature – the colder it is, the longer the preheating time.
Compatible with the Giants ignition switch – only works when the ignition is on.
- Engine start depends on temperature – influenced by the environment or weather.
- New harvester configuration with optimized handling
for field and road modes.
In fieldmode you can use the clutchpedal as inching function.

Important:
The buttons for the CVT-Addon must first be assigned,
as it can be set up for many setup variations.
The GUI is preset with [lShift + lAlt + C].
And the switch for the automatic taillight is on
[lShift + lAlt + A].
All settings in the LS should be set to manual.
Manual gearshift and clutch.
No automatic controls should be active.
If you want to drive realistically, you're already doing that.
The CVT add-on should be actively played
and not just a "running in the background" mod.
(Adapt for the respective application)
The vehicle XML value "rotInertia" (flywheel) must not be specified
or must be precisely adjusted.
And remember: the engines must warm up first.
If in doubt, please watch the tutorials.

Setting options:

General CVT:
- 0 to 5 acceleration ramps can be set.
- Braking ramps can also be set.
- TMS pedal mode can be deactivated.
- Automatic differential lock can be activated or preselected.
(FS25_VehicleControlAddon or FS25_EnhancedVehicle required)
- Efficient operation of the machine at maximum performance.
- The clutch must be engaged to start the engine.

Classic CVT:
- Number of drive ranges can be configured.
- Drive ranges are shifted manually.

Modern CVT:
- Two drive ranges shift automatically – you hardly notice it.
- The parking brake is activated as soon as you leave the driver's seat.
(FS25_VehicleControlAddon or FS25_EnhancedVehicle required)
- Low-speed concept for efficient operation.
- Convenient operation thanks to fewer settings required.
- Pull-in turn possible.

Hydrostatic and HST drive:
- Two basic variants can be selected via the GUI.
- In this configuration, acceleration ramps are used as speed steps.
- Both drives use a percentage-based accelerator pedal.
- With the hydrostatic drive (older version):
Hand throttle required for
A. Top speed
B. Increased pump power (e.g., for front loaders)
- The newer version regulates many things automatically,
but hand throttle remains helpful.
- If FS25_VehicleControlAddon is active:
Parking brake must be applied to start the engine.

Heat, overheating, and wear:
- Engines must warm up, otherwise increased wear occurs.
- Improper use/incorrect adjustment can cause transmission damage.
- High oil pressure can trigger overheating and wear.
- Engine temperatures are only synchronized with FS25_DashboardLive in multiplayer.
(DBL must be active)

Influence on functions and influencing factors:

Engine braking effect:
- Dynamically calculated based on:

Weight, speed, wind,

Incline, decline, engine speed, power, ramp selection, etc.

Starting the engine:
- Continuously variable: Clutch must be depressed.
- Hydrostatic:
- Parking brake active (with VCA)
- Hand throttle to 0

Drive ranges:
- Two standard ranges (I / II), expandable for classic mode.
- Level II: Road, light work
- Level I: Field work, heavy load
- Torque and maximum speed adjusted
- Key assignment per level or switchable possible.
- Only change when stationary (to avoid damage)
- Modern configuration: automatic control

Acceleration ramps:
- 0 to 5 levels
- Influence acceleration and deceleration
- High pressure for heavy equipment - at high ramps
- Ramps 4–5 are more suitable for empty runs
- For light field work: ramp selection depends on the equipment

Further detailed explanations and tutorials:
in the Wiki on GitHub.

Virtually all values/settings are available and usable with FS25_DashboardLive.
Likewise, telemetry output for telemetry from Upsidedown.
e.g., automatic work lights currently active.
Further information in the Wiki.

Feedback and bug reports (and Wiki) are welcome at: https://github.com/SbSh-DNA-ModDing/FS25_CVT_Addon_Dev please.

- Changelog: 2.1.0.0
- Glow plug notification was visible to all clients.
- Fixed HST sync error in multiplayer.
- HST/hydrostat can now change direction via keybind, which some real-life vehicles have.
- Requirement to press clutch for starting is now configurable.
- Removed EV support due to multiplayer incompatibilities.
- Added differential keybindings for VCA.
- Added DLC vehicles to the shop.
- Separate keybinding for pipe light.
- Keybinding to manually switch between top and bottom lights.
- Shop config is enabled by default but configuration remains inactive, allowing mission vehicles to be set.

- Added PT and ES community translations.

- Expanded and optimized DBL telemetry output.

A space inside a building is naturally more valuable than one in an open area.

In addition to this, I recommend using the “free placement” mode for indoor rentals.
For outdoor rentals, however, I recommend leaving this mode on, as it adjusts the ground.
To do justice to the economy of the farming simulator, I also calculate 1 day = 1 month here.

328619.title: Dashboard Live
328619.author: Glowins Modschmiede
328619.description:
Dashboard Live (DBL for short) allows you to display all kinds of information in your board computers and/or dashboards in all kinds of tractors, regardless of brand.

A zoom function is included to make it easier to view displays:
- Left Shift key - Space bar: Short zoom
- Both shift keys - space bar: Permanent zoom on/off

If supported in the vehicle, the right Alt key and left/right/up/down arrow can be used to scroll through displays.

In the MultiPlayer game, DBL synchronizes the engine temperature, fuel and air consumption from the server to the clients.

What can be displayed?

Basic game:
- Status of the front and rear linkage
- Status of attached devices and trailers
- Filling levels
- Compass heading
- PTOs
- Display of the currently active implement
- Status of the folding/unfolding process
- Tipping status
- Tipping side
- Course display (N/E/S/W, N/NE/E/SE/S/SW/SW/W/NE or degrees)
- Field number
- Weight of the loaded filling quantity
- Real-time clock
- Radio: On/Off, station and volume
- Radio volume adjustable via buttons

Minimap:
- Display of the surrounding map in the dashboard

Thresher:
- Filling indicator
- Status of straw chopper/swath delivery
- Cutting height
- Position of the transfer tube
- Overloading process active

Bale press / Bale wrapper:
- Bale size
- Bale counter

Front loader:
- Tool position

Further functions:
- Dark mode
- Acoustic signals


Supported mods (optional):

VehicleControlAddon:
- Status of the differential locks
- Status of the all-wheel drive
- Hold speed
- GPS status
- Slip of the drive wheels

Enhanced Vehicle:
- Status of the differential locks
- Status of the all-wheel drive

Headland Management:
- Status
- Field/pre-turn mode

CombineXP:
- Tonnes per hour
- Engine load
- Yield
- High moisture warning

CVTaddon:
- Speed steps
- Acceleration ramps
- Braking ramps
- Various warning states

Changelog:

V2.0.1.0:
- Zoom function improved and adapted to patch 1.10
- Radio display and controls added
- Improved support for FS25_interactiveControl (IC)
- Compatibility with FS25_Rhoenplateu_crossplay
- Fixed div/0 condition with fillLevel
- Fixed audio path for mod vehicles

V2.0.2.0:
- FillLevel of overload target added
- Color of crosshair (IC support) can be changed by file crosshair.xml in modSettings directory

V2.1.0.0:
- ISOBUS: Trailer and implements can bring their own terminals or screens for DashboardLive integration.
- Fixes for fonts GENERIC and GENERIC_BOLD
- Syntax checks for dashboard entries
- Conditions now support comparing strings
- Conditions are now supported by valueType="dbl.cc"
- Integration of realGPS
- Items can be active on multiple pages
- HeadingText expanded
- Added a fix for the “nil” condition in AISteering's server synchronization
- Engine temperature will be saved
- Engine will heat up and cool down without being entered
- Compatibility with realismAddonGearBox (parking brake)
- Added a button to release all engaged parking brakes
- Added support for animations
- Added the ability to temporarily store dashboard values and combine them with other dashboard values

V2.1.0.1:
- Fixed a bug that caused the terminals to keep dark in multiplayer after another client joined the game
- Fixed a duplicate factor 100 in slip calculation, triggering the slip alert in John Deere terminals to often
- Fixed incorrect return values, causing multiple warnings in the log
- Warnings regarding DBL implementations have been moved to devWarnings to avoid confusion.

Important: Vehicles must be prepared for DashboardLive in advance in order to be able to use the functions and displays.
An installation guide and documentation are included, and video tutorials are also available.

Further ideas or requests are welcome at GitHub: FS25_DashboardLive

328861.title: Back Roads County 4x

328861.description:
Back Roads County 4x
A True Countryside Farming Adventure

Welcome to Back Roads County 4x, a fictional North American-inspired map that captures the charm and character of life off the beaten path. Influenced by both American and Canadian rural landscapes, this 4x map offers a mix of rolling fields, rugged terrain, and classic country roads built for immersive farming. Whether you’re a solo player looking for room to grow or a multiplayer crew ready to divide and conquer, Back Roads County is designed to support your next big farming operation.

A large, fully equipped starter farm is available to jumpstart your journey, complete with spacious barns, essential machinery, and room to expand. Additional farmland options provide plenty of opportunities to establish your own custom farm.

With enhanced train capabilities, a custom loading ramp system, and multiple specialized sell points, logistics and production flow smoothly. The layout is designed to make Back Roads County as functional as it is beautiful.

Key Features:

84 uniquely shaped fields across 142 farmlands
One large starter farm with equipment and expansion space
Custom train loading ramp and added train cars for increased hauling capacity
CASE IH dealership and repair shop
Johnson & Sons Flour Mill for production
Grain West silo with rail support
General Store sell-all point and Farmers Market-style diversity
Sawmill for wood production
Lime station and two fuel stations for operational support
Dedicated Animal Dealer for livestock needs
Wide variety of field sizes to suit all playstyles
Designed to evoke the feel of real country backroads

Whether you’re exploring solo or managing a large team, Back Roads County 4x invites you to build, grow, and thrive in the heart of fictional rural North America.

329561.title: Irish License Plates (Prefab*)
329561.author: Dylan.C, GlengarBoy - Eire Agri Modding
329561.description:
Irish license plates for your map.

Install Instructions:
1) Extract your map and the license plates zip files.
2) Copy the "licensePlates" folder into your maps zip file.
Depending on your maps folder structure you may need to adjust the filename paths in the "licensePlates.xml" file to suit your folder structure.
The paths are currently setup to have the "licensePlates" folder inside the "maps" folder within the maps zip file.
3) Modify the licensePlates filename path in your "map.xml" file to point to the "licensePlates.xml" file from the "licensePlates" folder.
The file path to enter here is "maps/licensePlates/licensePlates.xml", however this may differ depending on your maps folder structure as stated previously.
4 - OPTIONAL) To install the ai plates, modify the licensePlates filename path in your "trafficSystem.xml" file to point to the "aiLicensePlatesIE.i3d" file from the "licensePlates" folder.
Note: If your map does not have its own "trafficSystem.xml" file, you will need to copy the one from the basegame files it is currently using and re-adjust the file paths in the "map.i3d" file accordingly.
5) Re-zip your map

To use the License Plates with the FS25_useYourOwnLicensePlates mod, copy the files from the "FS25_useYourOwnLicensePlates" folder into
"C:\Users\xxxx\Documents\My Games\FarmingSimulator2025\modSettings\FS25_useYourOwnLicensePlates" and select Overwrite files when prompted

Description of the different plate types:
- Type 1/Type 3: (2013 --> Present Day): yy#-cc-xxxxxx, where,
y = year of registration, e.g. 21 = 2021, 13 = 2013 etc., # = 1 or 2, 1 = vehicle registered in 1st half of the year (January to June) and 2 = vehicle registered in 2nd half of the year (July to December).
c = county code. This can two letters or one letter depending on the county. e.g. LM = Vehicle registered in County Leitrim, T = Vehicle registered in County Tipperary.
x = Vehicle registration number, i.e. 1 = This is the 1st vehicle registered in that county in that year, 213 = This is the 213th vehicle registered in that county in that year.

- Type 2/Type 4: (1987 --> 2012): yy-cc-xxxxxx, where,
y = year of registration, e.g. 93 = 1993, 09 = 2009 etc.
c = county code. This can two letters or one letter depending on the county. e.g. LM = Vehicle registered in County Leitrim, T = Vehicle registered in County Tipperary.
x = Vehicle registration number, i.e. 1 = This is the 1st vehicle registered in that county in that year, 213 = This is the 213th vehicle registered in that county in that year.

- Types 5 through 9: (Pre 1987): Vintage Plates with different background colours
Format can be either xxxx #### or #### xxxx, where x = Letter & # = Number
Formats can vary from one letter to three letters and one number to four numbers.
Reference the following Wikipedia page for the different county formats through the years.

- Types 10 through 13: Fantasy License Plate. You can let your imagination flow with this plate option as it is not a real life format. Purely just for the players that want to have a custom number plate :).

329730.title: Realistic Mulching
329730.author: Piersi
329730.description:
Disables the need for mulching crop stubble for crops that realistically don't require it.
With this mod, you will NOT need to mulch stubble after harvesting: wheat, barley, oat, soybeans, grass, carrots, beets, parsnips, sugar beets, potatoes, spinach, green beans, peas, and/or oilseed radish.

However, mulching will still be required after harvesting: canola, corn, sunflowers, sorghum, cotton, sugarcane, rice, and long grain rice.

The mod only affects crops harvested after the mod is added, and you will still receive the corresponding yield bonus.

The yield bonus will NOT be applied if the crop stubble is NOT mulched on crops that require it (example 1); if they are mulched, it will be applied (example 2).
For crops that no longer require mulching crop stubble, the yield bonus is applied as if mulching had been done (example 3).

330261.title: Trigger Greenhouse
330261.author: Piersi
330261.description:
This mod contains a trigger only greenhouse for all the vegetables crops in the game, like the default one, with the addons of mushrooms, grape and olive; all in one single production.

But the eye also wants its part, so you can find ONLY DECORATIVE crops rows of the different greenhouse products (except mushrooms), to simulate you coltivate it on open field.
This are only decorative objects, so you don't increase greenhouse performance with this; but you can do it if you use fertilizer products in the production.

The greenhouse convert manure, liquid manure, digestate and liquid fertilizer into solid fertilizer, so you can use what you want to improve the production.
Using natural fertilizers (manure, liquid manure and digestate) will give you a 1:2 conversion, meaning the fertilizer will increase by 2 units for every single unit of natural fertilizer added. Using chemical fertilizers (fertilizer and liquid fertilizer) will only increase the fertilizer section by 1 unit.

For mushrooms, instead, you can improve the production using straw.

All productions recipes also have a variant with only water for those who want a more arcade and simplified use, with half the production speed.

The mod include:
Decorative crops rows:
- Category: placeable -> decorations
- Price: free
- Monthly maintenance: $0
- Configuration: 3 different growth stages.

Greenhouse trigger:
- Category: placeable -> productions -> greenhouses
- Price: $10,000
- Monthly maintenance: $10


Greenhouse recipes:
- Input: Water
- Output: Tomato | Lettuce | Strawberry | Spring Onions | Napa Cabbage | Chilli | Garlic | Grape | Olive

- Input: Water | Fertilizer (Solid Fertilizer, Liquid Fertilizer, Manure, Liquid Manure and Digestate)
- Output: Tomato | Lettuce | Strawberry | Spring Onions | Napa Cabbage | Chilli | Garlic | Grape | Olive

330342.title: Farmlands
330342.author: Farmer Rabbit
330342.description:
Farmlands, endless fields, endless possibilities.
Have you ever dreamed of working vast, open plains with minimal obstacles in your way? A place where you can roll out your biggest, most powerful tractors and implements and get straight to work? Farmlands makes that dream a reality, at least for the most part.
The map is split by a canal into two distinct regions: the northern area, featuring more hills and dense forests, and the southern area, a mostly flat, pancake-like expanse except for its western edge, where a prominent ridge adds some variation to the landscape.

- 42 Farmlands (19 farmlands are flat as a pancake, the rest of the farmlands are in a forest area or on rolling hills). Each farmland size varies between 4-12 ha.
- 3 Fields (5, 22 & 40)
- Farmland 5: Two constructible plots (farmhouse & garage) that you can build or sell. Note that removing them via the construction menu will incur a cost. Comes with a field.
- Farmland 22: The starter farm when starting on “New Farmer” gameplay.
- Farmland 40: Purchasable BGA when buying the farmland, and comes with 2x Silobunkers and 1x EasyShed, which can be removed for a cost. A grass field is also part of farmland 40. If you want to sell the BGA, you need to sell the farmland.
- Three forest areas, two to the north of the canal, and one to the west, south of the canal.
- Free to use: Electric forklift located at the farmers market.
- Root crop pallets can also be sold at the train export root crops sellpoint.
- Custom soil map for precision farming.
- Custom license plates.
- Mission: Deadwood, Transport and Rock
- There are 7405 Trees on the map. The tree limit for the map is 14000 trees, so plenty of room if you want to plant more trees.
- Collectables: 50 Golden apples to be found throughout the map. Each golden apple found will be hung from the trees in the shop area. Each found golden apple pays out 5000 monies.
- There is a train running on the eastern side of the map, which is only for lookie-loos. You can sell your products at the train export point for overall better prices.

- Buy points:
- Lime & stone
- Seeds & fertiliizer
- 3x Water buying points (Water tower, Lake (ramp), & Train export water point)
- Manure
- Liquidmanure

- Selling points:
- Farmers market (takes everything)
- Animal trader
- Debris crusher
- Bale selling point
- Wood selling point
- Manure
- Liquidmanure
- Gas and Biogas Station
- Sawmill (production point) can be purchased, but not sold
- Cement factory (production point) can be purchased, but not sold
- BGA (production point) can be purchased with farmland 40 and sold by selling farmland 40 again.

- Train export point: (Higher selling prices)
- Bale's selling point
- Products selling point
- Grain selling point
- Root crops' selling point (takes pallets & bulk)
- Wood & woodchips

That’s all, make sure to have fun!

- Changelog:

1.0.2.0:
- Fixed floating trees on farmland 19 and 25.
- Moved the vehicle spawn point at the shop further back to allow for easier hitching on.
- A small area of farmland 98 had a patch of farmland 7 painted on it (under the sawmill). It has been repainted to farmland 98.
- Animated chickens have been added to the outside pen at the animal trader.
- This map update shouldn’t require a new save.

1.0.1.0:
- A new savegame is required for this update
- Train Export Sellpoints has been completely redone, and the belt system and auger are no longer needed.
- The plant menu in-game has been fixed, and US and EU plants have been added.
- Some golden apple collectables have been repositioned so they can be picked up. Some of them were unattainable.
- Borders between farmlands have been repainted to resemble a more natural landscape.
- Sawmill farmland is now available for purchase, separate from the sawmill itself. Deco items cannot be sold or removed.
- The blue fertiliser overlay on farmland 1 was visible on the in-game map and has been removed as no fields are on farmland 1.

330368.title: Iowa Plains View
330368.author: celobuki
330368.description:
Inspired by the rolling landscapes of the U.S. state of Iowa, this map offers a customized terrain designed for gameplay and does not represent any specific real-world location or town.
This is a standard-size map where you have the freedom to build your farm the way you want — focus on arable farming, dive into production chains, explore forestry, or combine them all.
Your journey begins on the main farm, fully equipped with pre-placed buildings including a Cow Barn, Chicken Coop, Pigsty, and a set of starter machinery to help you get going.

Key features include:
-30 fields in various sizes, from small to large
-2 forestry sites available for logging
-Biogas Plant processes silage into digestate and produces methane gas — a valuable resource that can be collected and sold for profit
-Traffic and pedestrians enhance the map’s realism
-Multiple paintable terrain textures for detailed landscaping
-Custom sowing calendar for soybeans and wheat included in the seasonal growth plan
-Local Case IH dealership available for purchasing, selling, or customizing machinery and equipment
-Alfalfa is available on the map and can be used just like grass — for mowing, baling, feeding, or silage production
-Soybeans produce usable straw after harvest, which can be collected and used like regular straw
-Two farms are available: the main farm features a grain silo, grain dryer, hog confinement, cow barn, and starter equipment, while the second farm includes a horse stable and sheep/goat pasture that unlock once you buy the farmland
-Small creek with waterfalls and a scenic rest area perfect for taking a break
-Iowa License Plates
-10 collectable golden Apples

Production features include:
-Cedar Creek Juice Co. produces orange juice, lemonade, blueberry juice, apple juice, pear juice and plum juice using fresh fruits
-Pancake House creates fluffy pancakes using flour, eggs, milk, and syrup
-Popcorn Production turns dry corn into a crunchy movie-time snack
-Two-step maple syrup production chain: collect maple sap in the forest, then refine it into sweet maple syrup at the syrup house
-Pizzeria bakes hot, ready-to-serve pizzas using various local ingredients
-Ketchup Production transforms tomatoes into bottled ketchup
-Water Mill grinds all cereal crops into flour, including wheat, barley, oat, sorghum, and rice. It also processes corn into corn flour, and dry corn into fine corn flour
-Dairy expands with new products including condensed milk, strawberry yogurt, blueberry yogurt, cream, kefir, and chocolate milk
-Greenhouse grows fruits and vegetables like oranges, lemons, apples, blueberries, pumpkins, garlic, and more
-Oil Mill
-Tailor Shop
-Carpenter
-Sawmill produces firewood used to fuel the maple syrup production process, but it can also be sold at the local selling station
-Grain Dryer allows grain to be dried before storage or sale
-Fermenter processes grass, chaff, and alfalfa into silage and digestate

Selling stations include:
-Grain Sell Point accepts standard grains
-Jackson Farm offers another location for selling grains
-Supermarket accepts various food products and processed goods
-Alma Train Station allows bulk selling via train and pays a 15% bonus for shipped goods
-Propane Station provides propane for grain dryer and other equipment
-Animal Dealer is available for buying and selling livestock
-Bale Selling Point accepts hay, straw, silage, and other baled materials
-Iowa Plains Logistic serves as a supply store where you can purchase all materials required for constructable placeables and production chains

Changelog 1.0.0.1
-Fixed slurry trigger on hog confinement
-Added more paintable textures
-Added option to remove roads and paths on the main farm that could cause issues when placing new placeables,(to remove them, sell/remove the decorative wagon on the main farm — the roads and paths are now linked to it)
-Once removed, farm roads and paths cannot be restored

Savegame Requirement:
-No new savegame is required for these changes
-When loading an old savegame:
-If you already removed the decorative wagon earlier, the roads and paths will no longer be present on the farm
-If you did not remove the wagon, the roads and paths will still be present
-Exception: a new savegame is only required if you want the roads and paths to remain on the farm but you already removed the decorative wagon

330727.title: Rainwater And Snow Harvesting Pit
330727.author: ALXXA
330727.description:
This mod adds a Rainwater And Snow Harvesting Pit to the game. During rain, the pit gradually fills with water (depending on the intensity of the rain). At sub-zero temperatures, the water in the pit gradually freezes, transforming into ice.
When snow falls, the pit is also filled with a layer of snow. Loading/unloading snow from the pit is done using a bucket, conveyor belts, etc. At above zero temperatures, snow and ice begin to gradually melt, transforming into water.
Snow in the pit is transforming into water in a ratio of 4 to 1 (4 liters of snow = 1 liter of water).
The pit can store water, loading/unloading water can be done from either side of the pit (AI loads/unloads water at the point indicated by the water marker).
For correct visualization, it is recommended to place the pit on a flat surface.

330807.description:

330828.title: Lizard Auger Master
330828.author: Mantrid
330828.description:
The Lizard Auger Master has the unique advantage of a rear-mounted auger, allowing easy access to load and unload vehicles and trailers. The unique fill light feature lets you see from a distance, how full the storage is, so you can swing buy and unload from the auger, without even needing to interrupt your worker. Just make sure to unfold the pipe and set its position in advance, and the rest is automatic.

Features
- Supports all bulk category fill types
- Rear-mounted auger, for easier access to load and unload
- Supports ball, pin-hitch, or semi attachment
- Boom-mounted spotlight (attached to reverse worklight switch) to light up unload destination
- Optional fill-level light, to easily see how full the storage is from a distance (off for empty, green for less than 50%, yellow until 1,000L left, then red). Useful for AI-driven tasks.
- AI not allowed to reverse trailer, since they're not very good at it, so they'll do U-turns instead
- Steering axles for better turning
- Multiple different tyre choices, including twin field-safe narrow tyre options
- Large range of colour options
- Beacon light!

331420.title: Starbuck, MN
331420.author: Freeze
331420.description:
Starbuck is a rich slice of Minnesota farmland reimagined for Farming Simulator 25, blending small‑town charm with practical, gameplay‑focused design. The landscape features rolling Midwestern terrain, authentic field shapes, and a clean layout built for smooth progression in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

The map includes 44 farmlands, offering a wide range of field sizes and ownership paths. A scenic lakeside area adds visual character and anchors the map’s rural atmosphere, giving players a natural landmark to build around.

Key Features
- 44 farmlands with varied field sizes, shapes, and ownership options
- Scenic lake integrated into the terrain for added atmosphere
- Dynamic terrain designed for immersive machinery operation
- Production chains including dairy, grain mill, carpentry, and more
- Custom crops integrated into the economy and Precision Farming
- Custom PDA with a clean, readable layout and accurate road network
- Fictional farms tailored for both solo play and multiplayer starts
- Forestry, arable farming, and animal husbandry supported from day one

Whether you're managing a quiet solo farm or building a cooperative operation with friends, Starbuck delivers a grounded, productive, and distinctly Minnesotan farming experience.

331434.title: Owendale Michigan
331434.author: Northern Michigan Mapping
331434.description:
Welcome to Owendale Michigan. In 1882, as three new rail began to lay track in Huron County two cousins from Saginaw Michigan , John G. and John S. Owen. bought land in the Columbia Swamp. The following year, they opened a sawmill to harvest the native oak. John G Owen hired Quincy Thomas; a civil engineer, to survey a town site in 1887, The streets, alleys and parks were dedicated to the public for their perpetual use, and the village was Owendale. The sawmill burned in 1896, and the Owendale area turned from lumbering to agriculture.
Alfalfa crop added and implemented with the animals. Thier is 32 fields small to medium and large fields and thier is not much forestry But there is a sawmill if you would like to create a forest. Thier is 7 productions in town and their is a grain dryer on the main farm as well. You can buy seed lime and fertilizer at the pioneer dealer as well. When it rains the drain ditches will fill up with water. Their is also Percesion Farming implemented in the map by default as well. The area is based from Saginaw Michigan. So more farming than logging. There is also white tail deer that come out in the fall as well as wild turkeys.

331515.description:
Courseplay FS25
Courseplay for Farming Simulator 25 is a long-standing and powerful automation mod that has been a staple in the Farming Simulator community for nearly 15 years.

It also integrates seamlessly with other mods like AutoDrive, making it ideal for managing large-scale farms.
Despite improvements to the in-game AI over the years, Courseplay remains the gold standard for automation in Farming Simulator, thanks to its flexibility, reliability, and active development community.

For a link to our latest release, Help page and GitHub page where you can find more information, help, and report issues please visit Courseplay Website

331592.author: Kaymara, NrA
331592.description:
Construction Site Traffic Light is a temporary signaling device used to safely regulate traffic, just like in real life where it is used on roadworks to organize alternating traffic and protect workers and road users.

In the game, it is available in the Misc category of the shop or as a placeable in miscellaneous tools. It can be moved by hand and is strappable for easy transport.

- Price: 2,455$
- Weight: 110 kg
- Maximum speed: 7 kph
- Realistic color configuration

Operation:
The light must be unfolded to turn on. If folded, activation has no effect.

It only works if the engine remains on. If the engine is turned off, the cycle automatically pauses and must be reactivated after restarting.

The cycle is automatic and infinite: 1 minute of red light with timer, followed by 1 minute of flashing amber without timer, then repetition. AI vehicles stop at the red light.

To turn it off, simply fold it.

Practical and realistic, this light provides authentic traffic management for your work zones.

331693.title: Poettinger Impress 200VCPro Multi Baler
331693.author: Kastor [d-s-agrarservice]
331693.description:
Pöttinger Impress 200VCPro Multibale Baler-Wrapper Combination.
This enhanced baler-wrapper combination was specially developed for the direct baling of chaff (maize) and beet pulp.
An integrated pre-bunker allows the baler to be filled directly by the forage harvester when the adapter is attached, producing seamlessly wrapped silage round bales.

The included Multi-Adapter can be precisely configured for the 5 base-game forage harvesters. This prevents the baler from lifting pumpkins or tilting unintentionally when unloading a bale.
In addition, the Multi-Adapter can be used on any vehicle with a trailer hitch or ball coupling to provide a required PTO shaft that is missing on the vehicle.

Thanks to automatic detection, the Multibaler does not only bale classic straw, hay, and grass. It also accepts all other materials accepted at the standard bale selling stations on the map being played (e.g., clover, alfalfa).
The bunker allows non-stop baling with switchable automatic bale unloading.
Important: In non-stop operation, the driving speed must be adjusted to the wrapping speed, otherwise the bunker may overflow.
Alternatively, the machine can also be used as a stationary farm baler. For this purpose, the bunker can be comfortably filled using a wheel loader bucket or a conveyor belt.
For stationary operation, only a tractor or an external PTO generator is required as a drive.

All materials accepted at the regular standard bale selling stations on the respective map can now be baled fully automatically (including mod crops like clover, alfalfa, etc.).

331799.title: Crude Oil Production
331799.author: BartsoNv3
331799.description:
I present to you a modification that allows you to extract crude oil in FS25 and then process it into several derivative products.
Using an oil well pump and empty barrels, you will extract crude oil to the surface and then transport it on pallets to one of two refineries.
You can also sell the crude oil directly at a dedicated purchase point.
The big oil pump does not require empty barrels to be supplied; it only needs fuel and water for powering and cooling the pumps. You can collect the ready crude oil using a tanker or a small barrel, which is also included in this mod.
After delivering crude oil to one of the two refineries, you can refine it into diesel fuel, gasoline, LPG gas, engine oil, kerosene, paraffin, and bearing grease.
Once you have produced the finished pallets, you can transport them to three dedicated purchase points that you can set up.
At the small stall, you will sell smaller amounts of oil but at a higher price; in the other two purchase points, you can sell large quantities of pallets.
In picture number 2, you can see the entire oil production chain.
Fuel, gasoline, and LPG from the refinery can be transported in tankers, sold at the purchase points, and used to refuel vehicles.
Note! The oil well pump produces oil in pallets, whereas the big oil pump produces crude oil that you transport using tankers.

331962.title: Memphis, New York
331962.author: WillyBoy10102
331962.description:
Returning from Farming Simulator 22 with countless revisions beyond just game conversion, welcome to Memphis, New York

Memphis, New york, is a rural community in central New York with hot summers, wet springs, and harsh winters. Despite these relative extremes, life finds a way.

In Memphis, if you choose to begin your farming journey as a "new farmer," you will have all necessary equipment and a few fields to produce wheat, with a small chicken coop tucked in the forest for some additional income. In the event that your vehicles need repair, or you desire to purchase new ones, there is a shop located just down the road. If you choose to expand your farm and find yourself needing water for animals, there is a spring located on Whiskey Hollow Road, which is the road that leads into the forest. When it comes time to sell, there are numerous productions and sellpoints located around the map, and a warehouse if you choose to undertake and construction project, which there is one in the form of a ruined barn located on farmland 55. A sawmill is also located on the aforementioned Whiskey Hollow Road, accessible by a short, wide trail off the main road. If you choose to invest in dairy farming, be advised, that in addition to total mixed ration, silage will now allow cows to reach 100% production as well.

Scattered around the map are a total of 22 fields, some requiring access roads, but with 4.5 miles of rural road to drive down, and even more miles of offroad trails, you can easily access every corner of the map. The offroad trails will allow you to explore the map to its fullest extent, whether for recreation or logging.

Compared to the Farming Simulator 22 version, many properties are more immersive, with usable garages, farmhouses, and even numerous animal pens scattered around the map to be purchased with their respective land. Farmland 44 is a large area with some preplaced buildings, but all of those can be deleted to morph the area into any large farm of your choosing. Farmland 32 is also left intentionally blank to allow for the player to create a home specifically to their liking.

332533.title: Realistic First Person
332533.author: Sandmann
332533.description:
People are not all the same height, so everyone experiences their surroundings from a different eye level. This makes a noticeable difference when viewing large vehicles and machines and affects how their size is perceived.

With this mod, you can set your own body height under "General Settings". The first-person camera is then moved to a matching eye height. The first version of the mod lowered the camera by a fixed 5 cm. This update replaces that fixed value with a personal setting.

Body height can be set between 1.50 m and 2.10 m in steps of 1 cm. The adjustment works on foot and, optionally, inside vehicle cabs. While seated, the height is adjusted less strongly. Upward movement is also limited to prevent the camera from clipping through the roof of low cabs.

At the default setting of 1.87 m, the original camera height remains unchanged. Settings are stored globally and apply to all savegames. No multiplayer synchronization is required because the mod only changes the local camera.

Version 2.0.0.0:
- Replaced the fixed 5 cm camera offset with an adjustable body height from 1.50 m to 2.10 m
- Added configuration under the general game settings
- Added optional adjustment of vehicle interior cameras with a separate seated offset
- Added global storage of settings

The Kirchner 2500 slurry tanker is a compact and robust machine designed for agricultural operations with medium-scale requirements.
With a capacity of around 2,500 liters, it is particularly well-suited for smaller farms, grassland areas, or operations with limited access routes.

332838.description:
Increases the amount of dust in your game. This will alter all:
Plows, Spaders, Subsoilers, Cultivators, Disc Harrows, Power Harrows,
Rollers, Planters, Seeders, Mulchers, Balers, Windrowers, Mowers,
Cutter Heads, and Combines.

It also increases the amount of dust your wheels kick up.

Dust production is based on the amount of time passed since it last rained or snowed.

For full customization, you can increase or decrease the scale of all effects, or check
the game menu to customize each class of implement.

332840.title: Advanced Farm Manager
332840.author: FSG Modding
332840.description:
Advanced Farm Manager is a toggle-able GUI that will allow you to quickly manage your vehicles, implements, fields, and placeables.

- Jump into, park, sell, clean, repair, repaint, and refuel (diesel only) enterable vehicles.
- Warp near, sell, clean, repair, and repaint implements. Never lose an implement again.
- Warp near, tag, and sell placeables.
- Warp directly to or tag fields (pre-defined only)
- Pricing for Sales, Repair, and Repainting is the same as any mobile shop.
- Pricing for cleaning is based on how dirty the vehicle or implement is.
- Set hotkeys on vehicles using 1-9 keyboard or number pad keys in the menu
- Set nicknames on enterable, motorized vehicles.
- Set vehicle switching (tabbing) to be all enterable vehicles, or just hotkey vehicles
- Parking status for vehicles is saved in single player, but local to your user session on multiplayer (it will only affect your tabbing, and not save between game session)

Key Bindings:

Left_Shift + Key_Slash (/) - Open Menu
Mouse Button 4 - Open Menu
Right_Alt + Number Pad 0 - Toggle between limited vehicle switching and all vehicle switching
Right_Alt + Number Pad 1-9 - Jump to hotkey marked vehicle #

333030.title: Phiber Dash Chemical Mixing
333030.author: Bcbuhler
333030.description:
The Phiber Dash system is one of the most effecient ways to mix chemicals and refill a sprayer. The Dash automates chemical mixing and cleaning, reducing the possibility for human error, decreasing the time needed to fill a sprayer, and increasing overall sprayer productivity. The Dash has two pumps; a high-volume water pump with a 13hp motor rated at 430 GPM, and an air-diaphragm pump capable of 40 GPM used for auto rinsing and agitating dry products. Separate inductors allow operators to load multiple products in advance of a fresh sprayer load while maintaining chemical separation. Once chemicals are loaded into their respective inductors and the sprayer is attached, the fill and rinse process can be operated from one central ground-level location beside the trailer. Chemicals can be delivered to the sprayer individually by activating the control handle corresponding to their respective inductor. As the control handle is activated two valves are opened. One valve at the bottom of the inductor is opened unloading chemicals, under suction, into the main water stream. A second valve opens to activate the inductor rinse head, rinsing and unloading the inductor simultaneously. Each inductor can unload in approximately 15 seconds; including a rinse cycle that ensures complete chemical delivery and the elimination of chemical residue buildup.

Be sure to check out the ingame help menu for info on how to use this mod.

The virtual version of the Dash takes some of the unique features of the real equipment and brings them to the game. The Dash 4.4 and Dash 1.4 are capable of mixing Herbicide from Unmixed Herbicide and water or Liquid Fertilizer from Water Soluble Fertilizer and water. The trailers can either be bought preassembled or you can buy the components you like to assemble your own.

333119.author: nop82, pat7575
333119.description:
Hello, this is a test map for Farming Simulator.

On this map, you can test and try out your vehicles, machines, attachments, and buildings.

On this map, you have a dealer for purchasing and reconfiguring vehicles, a sales point for liquid fertilizers and herbicides, as well as water, and a multi-buy station.

There are 10 production units to test your goods for further production and 8 sales stations, one of which also accepts liquids for emptying your barrels.

All animal types also have stables. There you can test your equipment and animal machinery.

There are 20 fields ready for harvest that you can harvest immediately, 2 meadows, 1 harvested meadow with swaths of grass and hay, 1 corn field for chopping, 1 field for spraying and tilling, and one field each with grapes, olives, and rice.

There's a forest with various tree species to clear.

A BGA with 5 bunker silos.

Next to the merchant, you also have an open area for testing buildings.

You can fetch water from the river.

You also have a small parkour course, which offers:
An area for jumping and circular rides.
A course for test drives on the hill and performance driving.
A small bank.
For further fun, there's a small mountain track.

There's a test track with ramps and bollards in the road for testing the suspension, as well as a slalom.

A point for setting up the navigation system, for example, Dashboard Live, is also included.

When selecting, all fields and land areas are your own on an easy save; on a medium or high save, you must first acquire them.

We hope you have fun with this map and trying it out.

333555.title: Enhanced Animal System
333555.author: Chissel
333555.description:
This mod adjusts the animal system and expands it with the following features:

- Animals have both male and female offspring (In the base game, this only applies to chickens)
- The number of offspring is breed-specific
- Reproduction is not dependent on health
- Reproduction can be started manually or automatically
- Male animals can start reproduction automatically
- Reproduction that is not triggered by male animals costs a fee per animal (prices depend on the breed)
- Reproduction can fail depending on how long ago the last birth was and how old the animal is.
- Milk production and feed consumption of cows has been adjusted to the lactation curve. Cows consume more feed after giving birth, but also produce more milk. Both decrease over time. Milk production even stops completely if a cow has not had offspring for a long time.
- Cows are dry for 2 months before giving birth. This means they do not produce any milk during this time.
- Animals can live longer than 60 months.
- Animals become less healthy when they are in poor health.
- Animals become less healthy when they reach their maximum age.
- Stables can hold more animals than specified due to reproduction. The health of the animals decreases depending on the overcrowding.

Exact values:

Lactation curve:
Month after birth: 0 Feed factor: 0.9 Milk factor: 1.0
Month after birth: 1 Feed factor: 1.02 Milk factor: 1.1
Month after birth: 2 Feed factor: 1.08 Milk factor: 1.2
Month after birth: 3 Feed factor: 1.06 Milk factor: 1.15
Month after birth: 4 Feed factor: 1.02 Milk factor: 1.1
Month after birth: 5 Feed factor: 1.01 Milk factor: 1.05
Month after birth: 6 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 1.0
Month after birth: 7 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.95
Month after birth: 8 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.9
Month after birth: 9 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.85
Month after birth: 10 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.8
Month after birth: 11 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.75
Month after birth: 12 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.7
Month after birth: 13 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.6
Month after birth: 14 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.5
Month after birth: 15 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.4
Month after birth: 16 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.3
Month after birth: 17 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.2
Month after birth: 18 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.1
Month after birth: >=19 Feed factor: 1.0 Milk factor: 0.0

Offspring with probabilities:

Cows:
Number of offspring: 0 Probability: 1%
Number of offspring: 1 Probability: 98%
Number of offspring: 2 Probability: 1%

Pigs:
Number of offspring: 8 Probability: 20%
Number of offspring: 9 Probability: 20%
Number of offspring: 10 Probability: 20%
Number of offspring: 11 Probability: 20%
Number of offspring: 12 Probability: 20%

Sheep:
Number of offspring: 0 Probability: 1%
Number of offspring: 1 Probability: 59%
Number of offspring: 2 Probability: 30%
Number of offspring: 3 Probability: 20%

Horses:
Number of offspring: 0 Probability: 1%
Number of offspring: 1 Probability: 98%
Number of offspring: 2 Probability: 1%

Chickens:
Number of offspring: 0 Probability: 10%
Number of offspring: 1 Probability: 50%
Number of offspring: 2 Probability: 30%
Number of offspring: 3 Probability: 10%

Probability of success for starting reproduction:

Months after last birth: 0 Probability: 0%
Months after last birth: 1 Probability: 40%
Months after last birth: 2 Probability: 80%
Months after last birth: >2 Probability: 100%

Probability of success for starting reproduction decreases by 1% from a certain age:

Cows: 72 months Steps: 7 months
Pigs: 48 months Steps: 4 months
Sheep: 72 months Steps: 7 months
Horses: 180 months Steps: 8 months
Chickens: 36 months Steps: 3 months

Example: A cow gave birth for the last time 5 months ago. This means that the probability is 100%. However, she is already 80 months old. She is therefore 8 months over the maximum limit of 72 months (80 - 72 = 8). The probability for cows increases every 7 months. This results in a penalty of 2% for this cow (8/7 rounded up to 2). This cow therefore still has a 98% probability of successfully starting reproduction.

Maximum age of animals:

Cows: 300 months
Pigs: 180 months
Sheep: 144 months
Horses: 360 months
Chickens: 180 months

Probability of an animal disappearing when it reaches maximum age: 5%
Probability of an animal disappearing when its health is at 0%: 10%


Please report any errors here: https://github.com/Chissel/FS25_EnhancedAnimalSystem

333576.title: Hazelnut Farms

333576.description:
[Welcome to Hazelnut Farms, nestled in the rolling hills of Western Kentucky, a tranquil paradise where farming dreams come to life. This map is designed with beginners and laid-back farmers in mind, offering a relaxing environment to enjoy the rhythm of farm life without the stress of complex tasks or harsh landscapes.

Hazelnut Farms features vast, open fields surrounded by the serene beauty of the Kentucky countryside. The landscape is dotted with gently sloping hills, picturesque forests, and expansive pastures, perfect for both crop cultivation and livestock farming. With its vibrant seasonal changes, you can experience the joys of planting and harvesting as the seasons turn—without feeling rushed.

The main farm area is equipped with all the essentials to get started, including a cozy farmhouse, a spacious barn, and a small workshop. A collection of well-maintained equipment and a John Deere tractor is ready for you to use, but you’ll also have plenty of room to expand your operation at your own pace.

Hazelnut Farms boasts a variety of fields with different soil types and sizes, offering options for those who want to experiment with crops like corn, wheat, soybeans, and oats, or simply enjoy the challenge of caring for a few animals—whether it’s cows, sheep, or chickens. The well-balanced design ensures there's always something to do, but never too much to overwhelm you.

The nearby town offers a friendly community with easy access to a market where you can sell your crops, animals, or handmade goods. Take a leisurely stroll through town, chat with the locals, and enjoy the slower pace of life that makes Hazelnut Farms feel like home.

Whether you’re tending to your crops, relaxing by the farm pond, or just enjoying the peaceful sounds of the countryside, Hazelnut Farms offers a perfect escape for anyone looking to chill and unwind while still embracing the simple joys of farming.

333997.description:
Bring more life and optical realism to your farm!
This mod introduces new models for cattle, pigs, sheep, goats, and chickens — including male animals and additional growth stages.
In the Vanilla Edition, all of the above-mentioned animals found in the base game are covered. Horses, buffalo, and chickens are currently only partially affected or not yet included.

- Realistic ear tags on livestock
- Greater variety in coat and spot patterns

334607.title: Persistent Wrap Colors
334607.author: CrankyAnt
334607.description:

Ever wondered why all your wrapped bales in Object Storage turn into the same plain equal color?
This mod makes sure every bale keeps its original wrap color - exactly as you made it.

Just like in the field:
- black bales stay black
- pink bales stay pink
- yellow, blue, red, green… all remain visible

No more confusion about which silage is which. Each bale retains its unique wrap color while stored, and shows correctly when taken back out again.

Works globally with all Object Storages using GIANTS Object Storage.
Also supports modded storages that use the same specialization.
Pure script implementation - lightweight, hardly any performance impact (even with very large numbers of bales)
PC only, because it is a script mod.

Report issues on GitHub: https://github.com/CrankyAnt/FS25_PersistentWrapColors/issues

334960.title: Take Single Objects
334960.author: Lism
334960.description:
Allows taking single items from pallets (default: right mouse button).
Taken items can be returned to pallets (default: N).

On pallets with configurable brands you can mix different single items on the same pallet.
Taken objects inherit the same farm ID as the source pallet; adding is limited to that same farm ID.

Works with the following base game pallets:
- Pioneer Seed (bags)
- Lizard Mineral Feed (bags)
- Rani Wrap Bale Wrap (rolls)
- Bale Net (rolls)
- Bale Twine (rolls)
- Rice Seedlings (pieces)

For modders: custom pallets from mods can be added via the API. The mod must include a `tso_mappings.xml` and the respective single-item XMLs. You can copy `tso_mappings.xml` from this mod.

Console commands:
tsoList – lists all loaded mappings
tsoReload – reloads mappings from all mods

335155.title: East Frisian Coast
335155.author: Tor Ben
335155.description:
Welcome to the East Frisian Coast.

This is a map based on the small village of Dornumergrode, located in the East Frisian coastal landscape. We are away from the major tourist destinations and can concentrate on agriculture here.
There are 5 farms on the map, each with different tasks and equipment.

The starting farm is located near the main road and includes a small chicken coop.

Key data:
- 25 meadows of varying sizes
- 51 small to medium-sized fields
- 3 small forest areas

- Various small or medium-sized production facilities
- Various selling points

The fields directly on the coast are freely available. In real life, they cannot be cultivated, but I don't want to waste the space. So you can decide whether you want to cultivate the areas or build a coastal farm.

One more thing: the farm buildings are for sale, and the decorations are too. If you want to build elsewhere, you have many options. If you want to build new animal stables, buy the free-standing pastures, sell them, and you will fall below the animal stable limit.

So, enough talk. Have fun on the East Frisian coast!

335217.description:
Welcome to the humble Haut Beyleron in the 2025 version.

The map was converted from the 22 version and provided with new elements.

Existing productions:

-Sawmill
-Spinning mill
-Can factory
-Cement works
-Carpentry shop

Existing sales points:

-Restaurant
-Dairy
-Farmers market
-Livestock dealer
-Hardware store

There are a total of 56 farmlands, including forest areas.

There are a total of 25 objects that can be found spread out across the map.
The railway line was removed and replaced by an adapted gravel path. The BGA was also replaced by a new one and an additional field was added.

A starting farm including starting vehicles was deliberately kept minimal to offer the possibility of building your own farm. But everything you need for a good start was provided.

There are a total of 56 fields that can be bought, including 1 forest.
There are a few corners that have changed slightly from the original. But great importance was still placed on preserving the charm of the original map.

Water can be obtained from all water sources.

Have fun in this beautiful part of France.

335349.title: Mediterranean Italy
335349.author: JonnyXPRO MikiMapper
335349.description:
Welcome to Mediterranean Italy!
Discover the charming landscape of central and southern Italy with this map for Farming Simulator 25.
Here, the sun shines all year long over wheat fields, sunflowers, olive groves, and vineyards spread across rolling hills and fertile plains.
Choose your tractor, plan your crops, and live an authentic Mediterranean farming experience.

The map offers a hillside farm complete with barns, stables, garages, and wide operational areas.
A picturesque Italian village is surrounded by cultivated fields, forests, production areas, and service stations.

Fields and Land
- 62 cultivable fields of various sizes, suitable for all types of farms.
- Forest plots and unused areas ready for customization.
- Fields numbered from 1 to 100, with zones for forestry, livestock, and seasonal crops.
- The main farm is equipped with storage areas, barns, and animal facilities.

Additional Crops
Beyond the base game crops, Mediterranean Italy adds:
- Alfalfa
- Silage maize
- Rye
- Triticale
- Spelt
- Green rye
- Hay grass
- Forage mix
- Green manure crop

These crops expand your production potential for feed, grains, and crop rotations.

Productions and Industries
- Dairy
- 1 MW biogas plant
- Grain mill
- Quicklime production
- Bread and pastry factory
- Oil production
- Grape juice production (2 facilities)
- Sawmill
- Large greenhouse with cover

With these facilities, you can build a complete agricultural chain — from field to finished product, including renewable energy.

Environment and Gameplay Tips
- Detailed Italian village with residential and craft areas.
- Realistic hilly roads, trails, and Mediterranean scenery.
- Medium-sized vehicles and tools up to 8 meters wide are recommended.
- For optimal helper performance, work manually around the field twice before proceeding in parallel lines.

Mediterranean Italy awaits you!
Build your own farm, develop local productions, and enjoy an authentic southern farming experience.

CHANGELOG 1.0.0.1
fixed fields, vines and olive trees that were not providing information
fixed problem with fertilisation not being displayed
fixed spawn field 100

335370.title: Brazilian Planting (Prefab*)
335370.author: Andre Schauren
335370.description:
Brazilian Planting Prefab — A complete and customizable planting calendar system designed for Farming Simulator 25.
This prefab provides realistic Brazilian-style growth patterns for eight major crops: Barley, Canola, Cotton, Maize, Oat, Sorghum, Sunflower, and Wheat.
Each crop features unique sowing and harvesting periods based on tropical and subtropical climate zones of Brazil.

Each crop has unique sowing and harvesting times based on Brazil’s tropical and subtropical climate zones.
Corn features two harvests per year, reflecting the traditional cultivation of summer corn and Safrinha corn, as practiced in Brazilian agricultural regions.

Ideal for map creators who wish to integrate regional agriculture into their projects, bringing authentic Brazilian farming seasons to the game.
The system ensures compatibility with Precision Farming and other seasonal mods, offering smooth integration and accurate visual representation in the growth calendar.

Perfect for players seeking realism and diversity in crop management, with balanced cycles that reflect real-world agricultural practices used across Brazil.

- Realistic Brazilian crop growth calendar
- Covers 8 major crops (Barley, Canola, Cotton, Maize, Oat, Sorghum, Sunflower, Wheat)
- Optimized for map integration and customization
- Compatible with Precision Farming
- Seasonal support with visual crop cycle alignment
- Lightweight prefab — easy to integrate and edit
- Corn with two annual harvests (summer corn and Safrinha corn)
- Designed for Farming Simulator 25

Barehaven is a fictitious map located far off the southern seaboard of New England. Once a modest haven for weary fishermen, now a forgotten island left to the tide and time.
What was once sustained by small fields and scattered livestock has long since been reclaimed by the sea breeze and wildflowers.
When the trade routes shifted and the harbor grew silent, Barehaven’s people vanished, leaving behind only untamed meadows, dense forests, and echoes of a life that once was.

335893.author: Agrogaatti
335893.description:
Weckman WS 130G is a versatile tipping trailer designed for everyday farming tasks. Built by the Finnish manufacturer Weckman Steel, the WS 130G offers a practical design, and can be easily adapted for bulk transports as well as for moving pallets and bales.

This mod offers three capacities from 5.6 m³ to 18.4 m³. On some configurations sides can be opened for bale and pallet loading. You can also choose not to have sides at all, or a handy frame for easy and safe transport for 125 cm round bales. In addition, you can equip the tipper with a filling auger from Jussi-Tuote to make filling the seeder easier and faster. Both seeds and fertilizer can be filled from the same trailer thanks to the partition wall included in the auger package. Other optional accessories include different cover options and a trailer hitch.

In addition, you can choose from numerous sticker options from different years throughout the production period of the trailer model in question. A Tuhti option is also available, as the trailer was sold domestically under the Tuhti brand until 2022.

This mod supports Vertex Design's Interactive Control for opening the sides and cover, folding, etc. However, the IC is not necessary and all functions can also be controlled with default keyboard commands.

Price: $15,000 (Default)
Capacity: 5,600 - 18,400 liters

335994.title: Upgrade Your Factory
335994.author: Lisek
335994.description:
Upgrade your factories! This mod allows you to increase production speed and storage capacity, so you don’t need to place multiple identical factories.
