- Upgrading a factory costs slightly more per level than building a new one.
- Upgrade costs are compensated by the increased production speed.
- Higher production speed means larger storage capacity.
- Since you don’t need to build a new factory, you save on production costs.
- The value of the factory increases with upgrades, allowing you to recover your investment when selling it.

Additional information:
- The following factories are excluded from the upgrade: Playground maker hall, Wagon builder (Riverbend Springs) and Piano manufacture (Zielonka)

- Currently, the mod does not support multiplayer mode.

336009.title: Castile And Leon
336009.author: CyLModdingStudio
336009.description:
Description:

Hello farmer, and welcome to Castile and Leon!

In this virtual environment, you'll find many immersive features and details. You can wander through the streets of a Castilian village and admire its houses, squares, shops, bars, restaurants, pedestrians, traffic, and more.
The entire virtual environment includes several farms, each dedicated to livestock or horticultural production (in the case of greenhouses).
You'll also find several pastures for raising animals in the countryside.
You'll have access to three industrial parks.
One is located within the village, and the other two are on the outskirts, with a total of 27 production companies that you can purchase (if you have enough capital, of course).

Compatibility:
- Castile and Leon has a total of 251 registered items (crops and products).
- Currently, no more than 254 items (crops and products) can be added to a virtual environment.
If you have mods or DLCs enabled that add new crops or new production methods, and they exceed the limit, the map will not load. Disable them in your game.

- If you want to enjoy this environment and all its content, keep in mind that there are mods that change behavior or replace objects.

- Compatible with precision agriculture:
Note: Castile and Leon has a custom, realistic soil map.
All integrated crops, including fruit trees, are fully registered for precision agriculture.

Languages:
Castile and Leon is fully translated into: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Dutch, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, Swedish, Czech, Portuguese, and Russian.

If you like Castile and Leon and its features, and would like it translated into your language, let me know on my social media.

Agriculture:
A total of 91 fields/terrains.

In addition to the original crops, you can cultivate rye, alfalfa, forage teff, forage poplar, lavender, mint, thyme, and rosemary in these fields.

You can also work with fruit trees such as:
-Apple
-Orange
-Cherry
-Lemon
-Quince
-Holm oak
-Chestnut
-Almond

You can produce juice, jam, and other products from the fruit trees. You'll find machinery for them in the shop.

Resin pines and stone pines:
- You can dedicate yourself to resin production with resin pines and pine nuts with stone pines.

Animals:
Regarding livestock, you'll have new breeds, with new feeds and production levels, and new, modified barns.

You can also make your own animal feed with the crops you cultivate or buy it in the shop.
Note: The use of the integrated stables, marked on the map with the logo, is recommended. These stables have an integrated manure bunker.

Aquaculture:
The aquaculture system I developed in FS22 will not be available in FS25.
The reason is that FS25 comes integrated with many items (crops and productions) and limits development.
Furthermore, Giants Software will release an aquaculture DLC, and adding it could cause confusion in the game since the aquaculture system I developed in FS22 has the same items as the DLC.
Therefore, I had no choice but to remove aquaculture.

IMPORTANT PHASE 2!!:
Phase 2 already includes the aquaculture system I developed in FS22 with changes for FS25.

Production:
On the other side of the town, across the river, is the old industrial park. There you'll find factories to produce several of the available products.
In the town, there are other businesses such as a bakery, cheese factory, tailor shop, pastry shop, and many shops marked as retail outlets.

The second modern industrial park is located on the outskirts, where the following are concentrated: an animal feed factory and products such as perfumes and natural medicines.
And in this new version for FS25, new factories and retail outlets have been added to this industrial park.
Note: (Modern factories have very high prices.)

The third modern industrial park is located northeast of the town. It houses the sawmill, a cardboard factory, a distillery, and a clothing factory.
Notable additions in this new version for FS25 include the new products of: peppermint oil, lavender oil, ethanol, and others.

Greenhouse:
Regarding greenhouse crops, I have added: cauliflower, peppers, cucumbers, and zucchini, and modified some of the original ones.
This greenhouse operates using compost, water, and herbicide, which you can purchase in the shop or produce yourself at the organic waste treatment plant (BGA).
Note: Herbicide is required in the greenhouse, for stone pines, and for maritime pines.

Shop:
In the shop, you'll find machinery and other add-on items, with options for color and other features.

Landscaping:
You'll find new modifications such as silos, animal stables, storage tanks, walls, gates, etc.
You can paint 25 different textures, lages, shrubs.

336486.title: Pallet Silo With Autoload Trailers
336486.author: ChrisS and RileyS
336486.description:
Do those pallets have you frustrated? We have a solution for you!
This mod includes a silo to place in your pallet spawn points that will temporarily hold your pallets. When you are ready to transport them, use one of the included trailers to load up your products and transport them to sell.

First, place the silo within your pallet spawn point of your production. As your pallets spawn, they will drop directly into your silo.
Second, bring your trailer over and load up your pallets just like you would at any other grain type silo. No more loading up pallets one by one!

If you do not want to use the silo, the trailers have been setup to automatically load pallets into them.

***Liftable Pallets and Bales from Jos is not required for the mod to function, but is needed for trailers to "Autoload" pallets not inside the silo***

If a selling station or production isn't setup correctly, you can still unload regular pallets. Pallets will be unloaded at the rear of the trailers.
You have configurable options to load 1 or multiple product types into the trailers.
If autoloading isn't your thing, you can still load the pallets onto the highly customizable trailers if you configure them into a standard or bale trailer configuration.
Please note that tension belts will NOT work if the trailers are configured in the Autoload setup. Tension belts do work in the standard and bale trailer configurations.

336735.title: Autoloading Wood Pack
336735.author: Lets be having moo
336735.description:
Two autoload wood trailers which can autoload any tree or log (apart from mission trees).
The trailer can then unload the wood onto a pallet which can be sold, stored or used in a production which accepts wood on a pallet (shipping container locations).
Any size log can be loaded but it is best to use the size you configured when buying the trailer to not lose volume due to incorrect size logs.
Once the wood is on the trailer it is no longer classified as wood so can not be cut anymore but now is a wood pallet.
Wood can be unloaded right side, left side or at the rear. Wood pallets can be reloaded back on to the trailer using the filltrigger button.

Configuration is where you choose which size the visual logs on the trailer will be and the capacity of how much the trailer can hold.
Length of log configuration is where you choose which size logs you wish to autoload so you don't get penalized.

-

Two sheds to store wood from shipping containers, logs or wood pallets.
Wood can be stored in object storage to use at a later date or distribute to other factories which accept wood.
Helpful storage if you use shipping containers or autoloading wood trailers and want to use that wood in factories which don't accept shipping containers or wood pallets.

To distribute set the production chain to distribute.
To store in object storage set the production chain to Storage.
If you want a pallet to spawn, use the pallet blocker to stop pallets going back in to storage.
If you want a pallet to come out of storage to be distributed, have the pallet blocker off but set the production chain to distribute and use the spawn pallet trigger.
Once in the shed logs are no long classifed as wood (can not be cut or sold/used as normal wood) but a wood pallet which is accept at places which accept wood pallets (Shipping container locations).
Pallets are 22,000L and liftable or can be lifted with a pallet folk.

336940.title: Hall Configurator
336940.author: farmerfivetom
336940.description:
Well, who among you hasn’t always wanted to build your own hall in the game? What if you could not only design it, but also construct it entirely yourself – using building materials from your own farm? With this package, both are possible!
Since the whole thing can be a bit complex, I recommend trying it out in a test savegame first to avoid losing money on your main farm. Please activate Free Mode before placing anything, otherwise you might damage the construction site!
To make all building parts fit as precisely as possible, they were created without terrain adaptation. To still level the ground, there are four different “Leveler” blocks that serve solely to flatten the terrain. These have no base cost or maintenance and should be removed after placement.
How to proceed:
After leveling, place the gable walls first
Then the roof
Finally, the side walls – this prevents gaps
I also recommend using Grid Mode only and placing buildings at a 90° angle to the map. Other angles may cause overlaps.
When placing, make sure not to target the previous module, as this would cause them to be placed on top of each other.
For wider construction projects, the Leveler modules should be placed with some overlap to better visualize height differences. Unfortunately, these have to be hidden after a certain distance to preserve performance – a requirement from ModHub.
It’s also required by ModHub that Test Areas and Level Areas are included in the mod. So: activate Free Mode before placing anything!

General tips and notes:
- Be careful when placing the Modules. Placing them too fast can cause problems with the ingame physics.
- Level the ground with the Levelers first, then sell them
- Activate Free Mode when placing
- You cannot tip materials inside the halls
- Roofs only show visual snow, no mesh
- AI should not be started inside or near the halls
- AI cannot drive into them
- The triggers for manual building are intentionally small – precise driving is required
- Each module can be built manually. One construction phase takes about 8 hours to complete

Every module has the same basic structure
Price: $3,000 – $10,000 depending on the module
Price: $30 – $100 depending on the module when self-built
Maintenance: $1/day
Dimensions: 5m x 5m
Color selection for wooden walls and gates
The Models can be found in the buildings tab, or if you want to build them yourself, in the constructibles tab.
Almost every module can be configured in 5 different heights → Note: Some modules were not built in all heights if it didn’t make structural sense
Modules are divided into 4 groups:

Walls:
- Open side (also extended version)
- Closed side (also extended version)
- Window (also extended version)
- Door
- Segment gate
- Double width for segment gates and open walls -> Coming Soon

Roofs:
- Gable roof
- Flat roof
- Sloping canopy
- Rising canopy
- Roof corners, also inverted version
- With skylight/roof window and hall lighting -> Coming Soon
- Roof Edge - ! Only this can't be constructed. Just placed

Gable walls:
In 3 sizes, configurable with gate, window, or none

Variable gable walls:
- Outer parts
- Inner parts
- Flat roof
- Flat roof with gate
- Gable roof
- Gable roof with gate -> Coming Soon

There are also additional free modules:
- Workshop (find it in the "tools" tab)
- Bale storage (find it in the "silos" tab)
- Pallet storage (find it in the "silos" tab)

336952.title: Hand Plant Saplings

336952.description:
Have you ever wanted to plant just one tree, or do you long to plant trees in random locations to replenish the forests?

Usage:
- The shovel and backpack can be removed from storage or returned using the default 'Use Object (R)' key binding
- To fill your backpack select the shovel from the players hand tools, look directly at a valid sapling pallet and press the 'Remove from pallet' key binding.
- To plant a sapling approach the required area and position the marker, pressing and holding the 'Activate hand tool' key binding will start the planting sequence.
- To store saplings in the storage box, select the shovel from the players hand tools and press the 'Add to Storage' key binding.
- To return saplings to a pallet of the same tree type, select the shovel from the players hand tools and press the 'Add to Pallet' key binding.
- To remove saplings from storage, select the shovel from the players hand tools and press the 'Remove from storage' key binding.

Important:

Game settings
Mode: Start from scratch HC
Presets: Start from scratch
Starting capital: $500.000
Starting credit: $500.000
Economy: Hard
The farmland must be purchased from the starting capital.
Vehicles: None (vehicle map only)

Mode: Farm Manager
Presets: Start from Zero
Starting capital: €1,000,000
Starting credit: €0
Economy: Normal - Hard
The farmland must be purchased from the starting capital.
Vehicles: None (vehicle map only)

Mods:
Each team can choose 2 additional mods.
Excessive productions and vehicles/attachments are excluded.

DLCs are excluded with the agreement of the teams.

Rules:

Game speed:
From 6 a.m. to 7 p.m. x1 / x5
From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. x30
Upon agreement between the teams, the night may be skipped or the time adjusted.

Mission:
Each team may only accept one mission.
Missions may be accepted on all fields.

Helpers:
Each team may only use one helper.

Fields – Properties:
Each team may only purchase fields – properties on the team's island.
Once all fields/plots on the team's island have been purchased, it is permitted to purchase additional fields/plots on other islands.
Forest plots may not be cleared and resold without reforestation.
At least 100 new trees must be planted before the sale.

Construction:
Shops and sales outlets may not be built on the team's island.
Production facilities and stables... may be built.

Bridges:
Illegal crossing of the bridge when the barrier is closed. €10,000 must be transferred to each team. In the event of a repeat offense, the amount is doubled.
Bridge hours are from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Farmland:
Farmland 77 may only be purchased for emergencies and must be returned immediately after the problem has been resolved. Changes to the map (Farmland 77) have not been initiated and may only be made with the agreement of the teams.

Soccer
The game lasts 2 x 2 minutes.
The winner of the game receives €10,000 from the loser.
The prize money can be adjusted in consultation with the other teams.

Vehicles:
Each team has 1 tractor, 1 trailer, and 1 quad bike at its disposal.
These vehicles cannot be sold.

Have fun at the courtyard duel

337612.title: Animalic Food
337612.author: [FD]Aekzl
337612.description:
Customizable animal food via mod.
The consumption ratios (eatWeight) and production coefficients (productionWeight) can be individually adjusted in the animalicFood.xml file.
TotalMixRatio is now also considered a "real" <mixture>, and it fills the individual feed categories <foodGroup> according to the <recipe>.

The production coefficient for grazing can now be configured separately from grass—so your cows will no longer lose health or productivity during summer pasture grazing (grazingProductivity: default is OFF at 50% to prevent losses, and ON at 75% for intensive grazing systems).

Food and Production quantity numbers (inputs and outputs in liters) are base game values and modification IS NOT possible with this mod!
This mod also CANNOT add additional registered feed types to the feed mixers!

Screenshots created with the use of the FS25_AnimalFoodOverview mod by Fetty42 for better understanding.

Food Overview and Calculator: For detailed overview of animals and food groups, as well as an interactive feedmixer calculator visit: https://sashaman.github.io/links/fs25_animalic_food.html

changelog:
1.0.0.1 Added a script to allow independent adjustment of pastry (grazing) productionWeight from grass. The incorrect description has been corrected: silage is a component, while TMR is the mixture.

1.0.0.2 Customization: Place a custom animalicFood.xml in your modSettings folder (modSettings/animalicFood.xml) to override the default. Fixed script error.

338159.title: Animal Food Calculator
338159.author: [Weekend Farmers]
338159.description:
The Animal Food Calculator (AFC) enhances animal husbandry in FS25 by providing significantly greater clarity and control.
In the animal menu, the mod not only displays estimated daily and annual consumption but can also depending on the settings
adjust the actual in-game values to the selected reference and scaling.
It supports food, water, and straw, as well as output values such as milk, manure, slurry, and pallet output.

In the EnhancedAnimalSystem, AFC takes lactation factors into account for supported animals so that the display and calculations better align with the enhanced animal systems.

AFC can read its values from various sources:
- from the base game,
- from the map, if a custom animals.xml is built in,
- from the FS25_AnimalPackage_vanillaEdition by BavarianRedneck
- from a custom animals.xml within the mod.

Easily switch modes ingame in the game settings under Animal Food Calculator

The modes explained:

1. Reference Source

The reference source determines which animal data AFC uses as a basis.
So the question is: Which values should apply?

- Basegame: AFC uses the animal values from the base game. Good for players who want to stay as close as possible to the standard LS.
- Map: AFC uses the animal values from the currently selected map, provided the map includes its own animals.xml file. Good for mod maps with their own animal balancing.
- AnimalPackage: AFC uses the values from the installed FS25_AnimalPackage_vanillaEdition. If the mod is active, it takes precedence and may override other sources.
- Custom: AFC uses the mod’s own animals.xml as a reference. This is the right choice for custom balancing or adjusted values.

2. Scaling Mode

The scaling mode determines how much the input and output are additionally adjusted.
So the question is: Should the values simply be adopted, or should they be scaled as well?

- Basegame: Scaling is off. AFC displays values and operates without additional scaling. The multiplier is effectively set to 1.0, and the number of days is not factored in separately.
- Auto: AFC scales automatically based on the set number of days per month, but without an additional multiplier. This is useful if you want the values to grow automatically with your time system.
- Manual: AFC scales only using your set multiplier. The number of days per month is not automatically factored in here. Good if you want full manual control.
- Hybrid: AFC combines both, scaling based on days per month plus an additional custom multiplier. This is the most flexible mode for balancing and gameplay.

3. Multiplier

The multiplier is an additional factor for AFC scaling. The menu offers fixed levels ranging from 0.25x to 10.00x. It is only active in Manual and Hybrid modes.

**CHANGELOG 1.1.0.0**
- All animalbarn inputs and outputs are now displayed
- New modes for selecting the data source
- Consumption values can now be read and set from different sources depending on the mode
- Improved support for additional animal subtypes from mods

338487.title: Oil And Diesel Production Plant
338487.author: MrDexxx
338487.description:
Oil Factories produce a lot of high quality oil from the grains provided to them, however, some oil is just not to the same high quality standard. This value oil can still be consumed, however, with a small amount of further processing it makes for a better fuel source as BioDiesel.

This production will make all the regular oils as well as an additional new Blended Oil!

- Rice (1:1) & Long Grain Rice (1:0.5) can be used to produce Rice Oil.
- Canola, Sunflower, Olive & Rice Oil can all be added back into the production which converts it into Blended Oil.
- Corn will produce Blended Oil as standard.
- Sugar Beet can be put directly into the production and converted to sugar, however, be warned, whilst the staff are highly capable, this is not their expertise and you will only achieve a 5:1 ratio (A sugar mill will give 5:3).

-This production benefits from not having shared output. You can produce all items at their respective cycles per month!

- Note; the (Fast) version requires "Refined Wood Chips, Sawdust Factory And Fuel Production Pack" to produce briquettes.

338935.title: Monteriggioni
338935.author: HornFarmerModding
338935.description:
Surrounded by gentle hills, cypress-lined roads, and historic stone walls, this map offers authentic farming in one of the most picturesque regions of Italy. Experience the charm of the Tuscan countryside with a map inspired by the area around the medieval town of Monteriggioni.

The map is not a 1:1 recreation of the region, but it is strongly inspired by it. Some areas have been faithfully reproduced, while others are fictional. To reflect the typical Tuscan landscape, most fields are planted with grain and grass at the start of a new game — but you can grow any crop you like on your own land.

There are 129 purchasable plots, divided into:
- 8 farms (partially removable, including a small oil press or a farm dairy)
- 78 fields (0.5 – 7 ha)
- 15 meadows
- 10 forests
- 6 empty plots
- 5 olive groves
- 7 vineyards

What awaits you on this map:
- Multifruit (including Spelt, Triticale, Rye, Grain maize, Green rye, Vetch rye, Field grass, Silage maize, Humus activator, and Mustard as a cover crop)
- Cypress trees added to the construction menu
- More terrain/soil angles
- Custom environment data for the Monteriggioni region (snow, rain, temperatures, etc.)
- Customized greenhouses
- Customized productions
- Customized animal barns (horses and sheep/goats produce manure)

CHANGELOG Version 1.0.0.3:
- The bakery's unloading trigger has been repaired.
- The ability to unload olive crates at the oil mill, the small oil mill and the Consorzio Agrario silos has been added. This ensures compatibility with the "Olive Harvest Trailer" mod.
- Added the option to feed chickens triticale, rye and spelt.
- Added the option to feed pigs triticale and spelt.

CHANGELOG Version 1.0.0.2:

- The dairy's unloading trigger has been repaired. (Unloading was not possible.)
- Problems with the bunker silos on Farm 2 have been resolved. Unloading of chopped material was not possible.
- Faulty triggers for the object storage at the horse stable and the nursery have been fixed.
- A few log warnings and errors that sometimes occurred during the harvest of corn and the additional fruits have been fixed.

CHANGELOG Version 1.0.0.1:
- Trigger for slurry fixed at the cowshed on Farm 6.
- Farm dairy removed from build mode
- BGA (biogas plant) price increased and some buildings are now sellable.
- Machine spawn areas at the shop have been adjusted to accommodate more machines.
- A second version of the cowshed has been added to the building menu, without an integrated manure heap (the manure heap must be placed manually).

339475.title: Net Worth Tracker
339475.author: Evan Kirsch
339475.description:
Adds menu screen with a tab to sumarize your farms total value in a balance sheet and a history tab to summaries the history of your farms value.

Farm Value:
This is the summary of the current day's farm value. Each line item in the balance sheet contains a name, catagory, additional details and a value and are sortable by name, catagory and value.
The line items are summaized into four subtotals:
- Cash: cash and loans
- Equipment
- Property: land and buildings
- Inventory: fill and livestock

Farm Value History:
This is a history of farm values recorded at the end of each day. Each line item notes a day and the value of the farm at the end of the day. It is sortable by date.

Dev Console Commands:
- `nwtBuildHistory` - rebuilds fake value history from previous day
- `nwtToggleDebug` - toggles debug mode for the mod
- `nwtGetFarmValue` - calculates the current farm value
- `nwtFarmValueToCSV ` - exports the farms current value to CSV. Optional param of the absolute file location of the file to be saved. The defualt save location is `/nwt_farm_value.csv`
- `nwtFarmValueHistoryToCSV ` - exports the farms value history to CSV. Optional param of the absolute file location of the file to be saved. The defualt save location is `/nwt_famr_value_history.csv`

GitHub link: https://github.com/EvanKirsch/fs25_nwt

339611.title: Fuel Consumption HUD
339611.author: Jansgi
339611.description:
Displays fuel usage in l/h for combustion engine vehicles and instantaneous power in kW for electric vehicles. Anchored to the bottom-right HUD corner and scales with the UI. Hidden for other vehicle types.

Changelog Version 1.1.0.0:
Significant internal improvements
- Robust consumption estimator:
* Exponential Moving Average (EMA) smoothing and adaptive smoothing for ECU "lastFuel" readings and electric power estimates.
* Event-driven fill-level delta estimator with anti-spike measures (median + trimmed-mean + stability check).
* Plausibility filtering (ignores unreliable readings)

- Electric behaviour improvements:
* Shows instantaneous power (kW) while the electric motor is ON even when stationary.
* Shows 0.0 when the motor is OFF to avoid confusing residual values.
* Improved consumer-based fallback estimation for electric power usage.

- Faster, more responsive internal sampling while keeping the on-screen display stable.
- HUD appears instantly when you enter a vehicle (placeholder shown immediately; accurate values follow shortly).
- Smoother, more plausible readings with reduced spikes and erratic values.
- UI scaling fixes: HUD position and size stay consistent across UI scales (including small scales such as 50%).
- Respects in-game HUD visibility (won't show when the in‑game UI is hidden).
- Stability fixes: added runtime guards to avoid rare "attempt to call a nil value" crashes.

339747.description:
An easy to use addon for the construction screen that brings a new custom field feature along with a number of quality of life improvements.

Are you looking to quickly join two fields together or repair a field edge after a landscaping mishap? Configure Existing Placeables:
Short of cash when you placed that barn and left wishing you could change the configuration to include solar panels now you have the money? This is now possible from the construction screen by highlighting a configurable building and pressing the 'Configure' input binding.

Quick Copy:
Are you sick of searching through the construction screen looking for the same building that you placed on the map? Well look no longer, simply highlight any building already placed on the map and press the 'Quick copy' input binding.

Angle Display:
Take the guess work out of rotating your new buildings. The current building rotation is now displayed as degrees in the controls area of the construction screen when you are placing a new building.

Price Fix:
Are you left wondering where that extra money went after configuring and placing a new building? This is no longer a problem as the total construction cost including all configurations will now be displayed at the cursor before completing the purchase, keeping you and your bank manager happy.

340475.title: Submerged Sanctuary
340475.author: Creatiefus
340475.description:
This is Submerged Sanctuary, a standard-sized flooded fantasy map with a warm climate, overall sunny weather, and temperatures around 20–30 degrees all year long.
When you start your game, there is only one piece of land and one selling point available for you to use.
You need to use the trigger at the water pump on your land to lower the water level and unlock more selling points, production, and farmlands.
The water level takes 24 in-game hours to reach its endpoint. The costs will be $1000 credits per in-game minute; this amount increases to $2000 when you unlock the fourth checkpoint on normal difficulty.
You can set the difficulty level with left shift + z or change the controls in the settings menu.
When you activate the pump, you can just let it run until it reaches its checkpoints or shut it off whenever you need to.
The waterplane will respond to in-game time — the faster your time, the faster the water level goes down.
There is a grain transport system on the map for when your machines can't make it up the hills fully loaded.

- Number of purchasable fields: 21
- Average acre size: medium – large
- Number of purchasable forestry land: 3
- Seasonal growth plan: due to the warm climate, grass, cotton, grape, maize, olive, rice, sorghum, soybean, sugarcane and sunflowers have a 25% yield increase and grass can be planted all year long.
- Water retrieval sources: most farmlands have some source of water, like a puddle or pond, where you can get water; the flood waterplane can also be used to refill your tanks.
- Environment: no snow, mist reduced around steep cliffs, overall warm and sunny weather; playing with fixed visual month advised.
- No traffic, no pedestrians — just you and the beautiful view of nature.
- All contracts are blocked by a script because most of the map is underwater.
- Multiple field angles.
- Custom Precision Farming soil map.
- Added more paintable textures and plants.
- Water plants will grow in increments in all ponds over a period of 75 in-game days.
- Custom production: lime, fertilizer, silage, TMR, and pig food can also be produced and sold.
- Multiple in-game heavy tractors and trucks have been modified with a hillclimber engine and fine-tuned to manage the steep hills.
- Supports multiplayer, even dedicated servers.

- Number of water level checkpoints: 6
- Checkpoint 1: farmland 2, 3, 4. Costs: $112000

340627.title: Manual Attach
340627.author: Wopster
340627.description:
This mod enforces you to attach/detach tools and trailers manually.

Attach/Detach implements:
When attaching an implement the script forces the implement to stay at it's lowered state. There are some exceptions made for frontloaders, skidsteers, shovels, telehandlers, combines and hooklift implements. You're still able to attach and detach those implements without having to leave your vehicle.
Note: The connection hoses and power take off still require to be attached manually for those implements.*
In order to detach, the implement needs to be lowered first! Also make sure that the power take off and connection hoses are detached before detaching the implement.

The mod disables attaching and detaching from inside the vehicle (exceptions are mentioned above). Like the mod title already suggests it’s not possible anymore to do the quick switches between implements.. get out that vehicle for real this time!

Attach/Detach power take off:
Hit Z in order to attach/detach the power take off.

Keep in mind that a tool needs a power take off, otherwise it can't be turned on!

Attach/Detach connection hoses:
Hold Z (for a short amount of time) in order to attach/detach the connection hoses.

Without attached connection hoses the following can occur:
- You won't be able to control hydraulics (e.g. moving parts, folding, use ridge markers etc)
- You won't be able to use the lights.
- Brakes will be blocked.

340665.title: Attach Implements Manually
340665.author: BayernGamers
340665.description:
This mod allows you to manually attach implements to your tractor.

In the general settings, you can choose whether attachments should be connected automatically or manually. If you opt for manual attachment, a message will appear when approaching an implement: "Exit vehicle to attach."

Once you've exited the vehicle and walked to the hitch, you can attach the implement by pressing Q.
After that, you can manually connect the hydraulic hoses, air lines, and electric cables by pressing Y.
The PTO shaft can be connected separately using the Z key.

An exception applies to trailers and implements with a drawbar hitch and Semitrailer attacher:
These will automatically attach as soon as you align the drawbar precisely with the implement’s hitch.

Additionally, when purchasing front loaders, you can choose between different coupler types:
- Manual: The front loader implement must be attached manually, as well as the hydraulic hoses.
- Auto Locking: The front loader will automatically lock when approaching (if enabled in settings) or by pressing Q from the cab, but the hydraulic hoses must be connected manually.
- Quick Coupler: The front loader will automatically lock when approaching (if enabled in settings) or by pressing Q from the cab, and the hydraulic hoses are also connected automatically.

If manual attachment is enabled in the settings, you'll need to manually connect the hoses after the implement is hitched.
If it is disabled, all connections will be made automatically once the implement is attached.

All key bindings can be customized freely in the settings. The default key for the "Attach" action uses the standard game assignment.

The SDK folder within the mod contains a guide on how to adapt mod vehicles for the mod. This is not strictly necessary but offers extended functions for coupling configurations and trigger adjustments.

Changelog 1.0.0.1:
- Fixed issues with hook lift vehicles and BigBags.

Changelog 1.0.0.2:
- Fixed issues with skid steer loaders.
- Fixed issues caused if vehicle height, length or width is not set.
- Added distinction between different hose types. Hydraulic, air, and electric connections are now handled separately.
- Forage harvester headers can now be attached from the forage harvester like with combine harvesters.
- For modders: The possible coupler types for front loaders can be configured in the respective XML of the vehicle. Additionally, a default coupler type can be set and the selection of other coupler types in the shop can be disabled.

Changelog 1.0.0.3:
- Added setting and corresponding function for automatic attachment of front loaders. When enabled, front loaders will automatically attach as soon as the front loader is close enough to the front loader console of the vehicle.
- Fixed ineffective setting for automatic attachment of front loader implements.
- Improved overall performance impact of the mod.
- For modders: In the modDesc.xml, it is now possible to specify the path to a configuration file. In this file, AttacherJoints can be marked as front loader AttacherJoints, so that corresponding configs and functions for these AttacherJoints can be used. Documentation of the functions can be found in the sdk folder.

340824.description:
This mod integrates into all maps and adds a new filltype for shredded straw. Shredded straw can be sold in loose form or used for the production of TMR.

The modified forage harvesaters, which are also included in the pack, can be attached directly to the baler, so that bales can be produced in a single operation during chopping.

341080.title: East Vineland, NJ USA
341080.author: MackTrucker921
341080.description:
This is the same popular USA map of East Vineland, New Jersey converted to FS25.

- The map was created from the area of my hometown and the map area was created from actual satellite photos.
- Vineland is in the southern area of New Jersey and is a very rural farm town. Most of the area of the city is farmland and forests.
- The fields, trees, and houses are as close to where they are in real life as I could make but of course I added productions and in-game sellpoints that do not actually exist there for gameplay.
- Growth map has been changed for the region's weather.
- Most of the production areas available have been added to the map.
- The production areas have been edited to both hold more pallets in the spawners and the production pallets have higher capacities.
- There are 120 different fields all with field missions ranging from the smallest field of 0.583 acres (0.236 hectares) to the largest of 20.35 acres (8.236 hectares).
- Land prices have been calculated from the average land cost of the area.
- All land areas are purchasable separatly. The land where there are houses is more expensive than un-developed land as it would be in real life.
- The Solar Farm can be purchased and will give you $3,000 an hour income.
- The Solar Farm can be sold to clear the land for farming if you choose.
- The main farm area has a multi-fruit storage silo with a capacity of 1,000,000 liters.
- A workshop area is also on the main farm and is owned by the player. (new farmer mode only)
- Added the ability to shred logs into woodchips at the sawmill as an additional production.
- Includes cow, sheep, pig, and chicken areas that need to be purchased to use.
- Husbandry capacities are: 250 Cows or Water Buffalo, 350 Pigs, 500 Sheep or Goats, and 500 Chickens.
- There is a storage area at the main farm for slurry and digestate.
- Added Corn Meal and Cracked Corn as additional products that can be produced at the Grain Mill from Corn.
- Corn Meal can be sold at the Pizzeria, Farmer's Market, Diner, and the Supermarket.
- Cracked Corn pallets can be purchased at the shop for chicken feed or produced at the Grain Mill.
- Cracked Corn can also be sold at the Farm Shops.
- Added Sunflowers, Oats, Scratch Grains, and Cracked Corn to the Chicken's feed.
- Chickens require Wheat, Barley, Sorghum, Oats, or Cracked Corn which are 25% of their feed requirements, Sunflowers are 25% of their feed requirements, and Scratch Grains are 65% of their feed requirements. (total of 115% productivity)
- Added straw swaths to canola and soybeans.
- All the bushes are mowable. When the bushes are mowed, new meadow grass is "planted" in their place.
- Custom modeled licence plates for the area.
- Lime production point has been added to the Debris Crusher to make lime out of stones.
- Map is Precision Farming ready.
- Lime, seeds, solid fertilizer, and bulk mineral feed can be purchased from the silo at the main farm and the Farm Shops.
- Slurry can also be purchased at the Farm Shops if needed.
- If you do not have, or do not plan to have pigs, there is a sellpoint for pig food for the productions that create it as a by-product.
- Pig food has been added as a by-product to some of the productions.
- Alfalfa and Clover have been added as additional crop types.
- Alfalfa Hay, Clover Hay, and Soybean Straw can be sold at the Farm Shops.
- Compost is an additional production fill type and can be spread with manure spreaders to fertilize your fields.
- There is a placeable bunker silo to "ferment" many different surplus crops into Compost.
- Excess Scratch Grains can be sold at the farm shops.
- Soybeans produce Soybean Straw when harvested.
- Added Alfalfa, Alfalfa Hay, Clover, and Clover Hay to the Sheep and Cow feeds.
- Added Soybean Straw to the Cow feed mixers and as bedding in addition to Straw.
- Meadow Grass is able to be planted as an additional crop type.
- Created a new grass type "Meadow Grass Flowers" that can be planted, mowed, and baled.
- All of the houses on the map are sellable to make way for larger fields.
- The light poles at the main farm area and the farm house are sellable.
- Purchasing the production points also purchases the land they are on. No need to purchase them separately.
- Production points are able to be sold.
- Many more ground textures have been added to paint in-game while landscaping.
- More foliage textures have been added to paint in-game while landscaping.

341183.title: Farming RP Pack
341183.author: Fzto
341183.description:
Would you like to make your Farming Simulator more immersive and authentic?
The Farming RP Pack brings subtle but meaningful changes that make daily farm life feel more believable, perfect for RP-style gameplay.

Main features:
No fast travel, every drive and walk across the map now has a purpose.
The game remembers your exact player position when you exit.
Contracts without borrowed vehicles, use your own machines and earn every coin.
Productions locked to "Store" mode, you must manually move goods between factories and sell points.
Loans disabled, progress comes from work not debt.
Decorative trees x20, meant for planting and harvesting real trees, not instant forests.
Animals must be bought and sold at the dealer with a trailer, no magical barn deliveries.
Manual carry limit about 50 kg, no more lifting logs like a superhero.
Selling land returns only 50 percent of its purchase price, prevents unrealistic flip farming.
Vehicles with 100 percent damage will not start, tow them to the workshop like in real life.

Note: the base game does not support transporting chickens.
You will need a trailer mod that allows bird transport.

A simple and lightweight pack designed for players who want more realism and immersion without losing the fun of everyday farming.

Greenhouse garden.

A small vegetable tunnel designed for realistic and small farms.
Instead of producing large pallets that require a forklift or loader, this tunnel creates small boxes of vegetables that can be lifted by hand, without the need for any additional mods.

Each production recipe now requires manure or solid fertilizer as an additional input.
To compensate for the extra work and materials, the production rate has been increased compared to standard greenhouses.

Since manure is relatively easier to obtain, production using manure is slightly slower than when using solid fertilizer
(about 15–20% higher output when using solid fertilizer).

Next to the tunnel, there is a storage shed where the produced boxes are automatically stored.
The total storage capacity is 150 boxes.

Additionally, during rainfall, rainwater collected from the roof of the shed is directed straight into the water tanks.
In winter, when snow accumulates on the roof, part of it also melts into the water storage during thaw periods.

The parameters determining the water collection speed can be adjusted in the script file:
GreenhouseStorageWater.lua

341381.title: Advanced Savegame
341381.author: Olafolaf1309
341381.description:
The Advanced Save System is a system that allows you to set specific times for the game to save.
A file named settings.xml is created, where you can define the exact times the saving process should trigger.
This is particularly useful for scheduled server restarts: for example,
if a restart occurs automatically at 7:00 PM, you can schedule a save for 6:59 PM to ensure no progress is lost.
The mod refreshes the configured settings every 10 minutes,
so there is no need to restart the server for the script to apply changes.
It is also possible to enter multiple save times.

341748.title: Ratzinger Height
341748.author: Da Andy
341748.description:
Welcome to Ratzinger Höhe, part of Greimharting, Rimsting, near the beautiful Chiemsee, the "Bavarian Sea."
The map depicts the small-scale, hilly landscape of the Alpine foothills using a true elevation model, with charming fields, meadows, and typical farmhouses that immediately catch the eye.

What awaits you on the map:

7 diverse farms, each unique in layout and operation

Multi-crop fields and varied soil angles thanks to the Weekend Farmers map base for authentic plowing, sowing, and harvesting

Approximately 100 fields, meadows, and wooded areas, ranging from 1 to 10 hectares

The entire map is purchasable

Customizable points of sale such as agricultural traders, farm shops, and livestock markets

Water can be drawn from streams and ponds

Authentic Bavarian roads, paths, and buildings

Viewpoints with panoramic views of the Alps and Lake Chiemsee

The map invites you to discover and cultivate the Bavarian Alpine foothills while enjoying the charm of small, detailed fields and farms.

Farms & Special Features

ID88 – Large, Customizable Farm
A spacious main farm with generous buildings and plenty of room for individual customization. All areas can be completely rebuilt, expanded, or removed to perfectly adapt the farm to your own gameplay preferences.

ID89 – Large Cow Barn with Apple Juice Production
A specialized farm with a modern, large cow barn and an integrated apple juice production facility. Ideal for players who want to combine dairy farming with an additional, unique processing operation.

ID90 – Goat Farm
A compact farm focused on goat farming, currently being expanded. Perfect for players who want to specialize in smaller ruminants.

ID91 – Large Horse Farm
A spacious horse facility with large stables, training areas, and plenty of room for trail rides. Ideal for riding stables or players who focus on horse breeding and training.

ID92 – Small Farm in the Village
A cozy, small farm in the heart of the village. Ideal for starting out or as a decorative side business. Less space, but an authentic village atmosphere.

ID98 – Starting Farm with Cow Barn
The starting farm for new careers. Equipped with a sturdy cowshed and basic buildings, vehicles, equipment, and parking spaces, allowing you to jump right into the game.

ID99 – Small Cow Farm with Its Own Bakery
A farm with a very small cowshed and its own small bakery. Perfect for players who want to combine animal husbandry with local artisanal production.

PS: It should ideally be 90% grass and 10% cornfields, but you want something to play with, right? ;)
If you have any questions, requests, or suggestions, please get in touch – this is my very first mod, so constructive criticism is very welcome, most easily on yt/@DaAndyGaming

342230.title: Dynamic Husbandry Capacity
342230.author: ModdingAssociation - Tidde
342230.description:
Description:
Say goodbye to unrealistically small storage capacities in large barns!
This mod automatically adjusts the storage capacities for food, straw, water, and liquid manure based on the barn's maximum animal count.
Instead of using fixed values, the capacity is calculated dynamically: Maximum Animal Count × Liters per Animal.
The adjustment occurs fully automatically upon placing or loading and is compatible with both standard and modded husbandries, without requiring any edits to their files.
Pastures with extendable fences are fully supported: The capacity updates dynamically in real-time while you draw the fence.

Instructions: Individual Settings
You can individually adjust the liter values per animal species in the xml/ChangeHusbandryCapacity.xml file.
For example, if you increase the food value for cows to 3000, a barn with 10 animals will automatically receive a capacity of 30,000 liters.
Changes take effect after restarting the game. If the file is missing, the mod automatically uses optimized default values.

Changelog 1.1.0.0
Fix: Fixed an issue where food levels were reset to standard capacity when loading a savegame.
New: Added external configuration file (xml/ChangeHusbandryCapacity.xml) to individually adjust capacities per animal species.
New: Dynamic capacity adjustment for extendable pastures during construction.
Info: Description updated and instructions for XML settings added.

342332.title: Advanced Silage Types
342332.author: ModdingAssociation - Tidde
342332.description:
The "Advanced Silage Types" globally extends all bunker silos, biogas plants and feeding robots with additional silage types.
The script integrates the fillTypes *GRASS_FERMENTED*, *CLOVER_FERMENTED* and *ALFALFA_FERMENTED*, which are intentionally named according to the MaizePlus fillType conventions to avoid conflicts with other mods.
The implementation is based on template structures provided by T4xs.

All new silage types are processed like standard silage. Stationary productions (BGA) and bunker silos automatically receive the new silage types as valid input, with methane output adjusted for higher-value silage.
Furthermore, the script extends all stationary feeding robots: they now accept the new silage types at their silage unloading spots and convert them into the standard forage mixture.

Silos are able to ferment any supported crop, provided the required fillTypes are registered on the map. Missing or non-registered fillTypes are automatically ignored to ensure maximum compatibility.
In addition, all new silage types are added to silage additives in forage wagons and forage harvesters. The fillPlanes inside the silo may visually differ from those used by the map; this is a technical limitation and does not affect functionality.

The script allows users to add their own silage types via a clearly organized table. Special thanks go to PfalzAgrar and SirJoki80 for providing the silage textures.

342403.title: Object Storage Extension
342403.author: GtX
342403.description:
An extension for the base game 'Object Storage' system that brings back some of the features found in the original 'Object Storage' mod (FS17 - FS22).

Along with improving some existing features it is also now possible for users to adjust building configurations so you can play your way.


# Global Menu:
A new tab is now included as part of the In-Game Menu allowing easy viewing and spawning of all stored objects.
It is possible to adjust some menu options from the 'General Settings' screen.


# Configuration - Input Trigger:
It is now possible to disable each buildings input trigger, helping you avoid unwanted delivery of objects.

# Configuration - Capacity:
Do you have a building that stores too many objects for your realistic gameplay or would you love just a little more space? Now you can easily adjust the capacity of your storage buildings to a number you are happy with.

# Configuration - Object Types:
Wishing you could limit a building to bales or pallets only? This is no longer a problem, simply select the object type you wish to store.


# Improvement - Packed Bales:
Object storage buildings now fully support packed bales, allowing them to be cut open once removed from storage.

# Improvement - Fermenting Bales:
Fermenting bales are now correctly grouped in the menu, dialog and info pop-up once fermenting is complete without requiring a game restart.

# Improvement - Multiplayer Bale Colours:
Bale colours are now synced in multiplayer games instead of the default white. To reduce unnecessary network bandwidth bales of the same fill type and size will use the colour of the first bale added to storage similar to a single-player game.


# NOTE:
There are more updates planned to include extra modding options, these will be released as they are completed.

Lachem is a fictional reconstruction in the beautiful Weserbergland, in the district of Hameln-Pyrmont.

All farms are designed so that you can sell everything and build your own farm from scratch.

In Lachem, you’ll find a bakery and a small cannery. In the neighboring village of Haverbeck, there are also several production facilities as well as the livestock dealer, who also sells slurry and manure.

- 32 terrain angles

- German license plates
- New crops added for animal feed
- Some ditches fill with water when it rains. Also watch out for certain water holes in the fields during rainfall

- 34 meadows & 75 fields, ranging in size from 0.5 ha to 11.7 ha

Additional information:
Currently, there are no AI splines for helpers on street and no collectible items, but both are planned.

You start at Brockmann Farm. It has the smaller fields and keeps cows. The main farm is located in the center of Lachem, with an additional building along the main road.

Changelog 1.0.0.1:
- Added paintable grass/meadow

343167.description:
Want a complete dairy farm but lack land! This Building is made for you.
A plot of land measuring 100x55 meters will be enough for you to have complete exploitation.

First of all install the stable building (Price: $400,000).

This will allow you to raise your cows with:
- 180 cows
- Capacities (in liters): Milk 120,000L / Straw 60,000L / Slurry 300,000L / Manure 400,000L / Food 80,000L

But also :
- to repair your vehicles.
- to sleep and change in your accommodation upstairs.
- to make your silage.
- to recharge your electric vehicles using solar panels which will also earn you $150 per hour.
- to refuel your thermal vehicles with 10,000 liter tanks.

When your finances allow you to do so, you can improve the stabling thanks to the 5 modules.

To install the modules, stack the canisters with matching numbers.

1st Cheese Factory Module (Price: $200,000):
Produce fresh cheese using milk from your cows (no need for a tank, the milk is directly transferred from your milk tanks), mature the fresh cheese in the cellar to be able to sell it, while waiting for prices to rise, store your stock in the fridge.

To handle the cheeses, pallets can be purchased in store.

2nd Storage Module (Price: $100,000):
Buy or transfer your fodder into the silos and then be able to collect them directly with your mixer, you prefer bales; the second platform allows you to store 500 bales.

3rd BGA Module (Price: $250,000):
You have too much slurry or manure to spread on your fields, use these to produce electricity, methane and digestate (capacities: Manure 30,000L / Slurry 60,000L / Digestate 90,0000L / Methane 30,0000L).

4th Dryer Module (Price: $150,000):
Dryer powered by methane allowing you to bring your grass directly to make hay. If you do not have a BGA to power the dryer, pallets of methane can be purchased in store. (Capacity: Grass 500,000L / Hay 550,000L / Methane 5,000L).

5th TMR Mixer Module (Price: $150,000):
Bring directly to the auger or put in the storage silos what is needed to make a ration, place a skip underneath and collect the directly mixed ration. (Capacity: 100,000L for each ingredient).

343291.title: Red Tape
343291.author: Ozz
343291.description:
Red Tape

A mod that adds depth to the game by introducing Policies, Schemes and Tax.

Policies include animal welfare and environmental regulations that, if not followed, can result in fines or other penalties.
Schemes offer opportunities for additional income or benefits but may come with their own set of requirements.
Tax adds a layer of financial management, requiring players to budget for regular tax payments based on their farm's income and activities.

Your performance in complying with Policies can impact the quality of rewards from Schemes and even offer tax benefits.

See the help menu in game for more information.

- GitHub:
https://github.com/sprkem/FS25_RedTape

Changelog:

1.0.3.0:
- Added safety check for edge cases with husbandries that cause errors.
- All scheme issued vehicles are properly excluded from the Advanced Damage System mod. Previously they were excluded initially but this did not survive game sessions.
- The event log should now be more specific to the player farm in multiplayer, and not show other farms events.
- Fixed a bug where manure manually placed into a normal manure bunker was counted twice for the manure management policy.
- Fixes for the Russian translation.

1.0.2.10:
- Update save hook for resiliency against mod conflicts.

1.0.2.8:
- Added a new setting to control if tax is currently recording expense/income. This allows players to temporarily disable tax recording if doing game set up etc.
- Disabling the tax system with the original setting will now clear tax history.
- Husbandries containing only diseased animals (using Realistic Livestock) will no longer be punished for low productivity.
- During the Salt Spreading Scheme, the UI will show how much money is earned so far as a clear indicator of progress.
- Improved the wording for the salt spreading scheme to make it clearer what the player should do.
- Reduction of the punishments for the restricted slurry policy. It is now far more lenient.
- Added a fix for enablement of policies and schemes.
- Reworked mp sending of settings. Thanks to KeilerHirsch
- Fix for salt spreading scheme earnings being reset when snow thickens on the ground.

1.0.2.7:
- Scheme issued equipment is now excluded from the Advanced Damage System mod. The exclusion is removed if vehicles are purchased.
- Added safety filter for demo schemes to filter out modded equipment which cause rendering issues.
- Fix mod reference path names for demo schemes in multiplayer.

1.0.2.6:
- Add safety guard for a sporadic error when spraying related to PF.
- Fix issue with settings not saving in certain circumstances.

1.0.2.5:
- The chance of a grant application being approved has increased to 50-60% depending on your tier.
- The minimum amount of allowed manure stored is now configurable in the settings.
- Add missing translations for scheme actions.

1.0.2.4:
- Revised inclusion of 'other' money types in tax calculations to only include certain types, e.g. Precision Farming soil information purchases.
- Add support for Witcombe rabbits in Animal Spacing. Also reduced space requirements slightly for some other animals.

1.0.2.3:
- Equipment demo schemes now have an 'Action' button to allow players to purchase the demo equipment at a discount.
- Equipment demo schemes will now generate equipment with less usage.
- Add safety guard to detect errors when detecting water when spraying.
- Reduced bale wrapping scheme now detects other grass types.
- All scheme and policy evals are wrapped in an error check to avoid issues such as animals not growing in the case of an error.
- Negative policy scores are floored now to prevent reports showing a -0 score.
- 'Other' income and expenses are now included in the tax system. This includes some things like certain objects and soil information with PF.
- Significantly reduced the reward for the winter cover crop scheme.

1.0.2.2:
- For crop promotion, save by fruit name to avoid issues if fruit type indices change. Also fix a bug that caused evaluation to fail.
- Added safety checking when selecting spawn vehicles for schemes to prevent errors.
- Fix a bug in sustainable forestry evaluation.
- Added miscellaneous safety checks.
- Added Polish translation, thanks to sabaka1983.

1.0.2.1:
- Manure dumped to the ground is now tracked as part of the manure management policy. Existing piles will not be counted unless they are added to.
- Added a new setting to control the speed of productivity gain. This is to better support moving animals regularly without losing out.
- Long running schemes will now automatically update their tier in line with the farms progression/regression.
- You can now end schemes early through the menu.
- Added console command rtAddPoints to add/remove points from the current farm.
- Grapes and Olives no longer need to be rotated (alongside grass types).
- Added Hungarian translation. Thanks to MathiasHun.
- Added Traditional Chinese translation, thanks to tony200242-ship-it.
- Add tax accounting support for the money types in FS25_Invoices
- Fix to block duplicate harvest history events in consecutive months, which could happen early game.

1.0.1.3:
- Don't show grants button when the system is disabled.
- Remove log warning for tax statement payments.
- Remove some duplicate localised texts.

1.0.1.2:
- Reduced the bonus for net positive tree.
- Fixed issues with crop promotion not ending, and not correctly detecting certain crops were grown.
- Additional safety checks on creeks and water detection.

1.0.1.1:
- Add fenceless pasture definition for FS25_buildableFeedlotPack.
- For slurry violations, decrease the points loss but increase the fine.
- Added additional safety check when scanning for creeks to prevent error in certain map/equipment combinations.
- Fix some issues with taking tax payments.
- Exclude pdlc equipment from schemes as they cause loading issues.

1.0.1.0:
- Purchased farmlands are exempt from the next evaluation of the Crop Rotation policy.
- Update grant eligibility text to explain minimum grant amount.
- Added Italian translation, thanks to FirenzeIT.
- Added Spanish translation.

1.0.0.11:
- Add a grant system. Use the construction menu to apply for grants.
- Add safety check and mitigations for mod conflicts that can impact tax.
- Treat Alfalfa and Clover as grass when present.
- Fix 24 hour productivity exceptions when moving animals via a trailer. Exceptions were previously only working correctly when buying new animals.
- Fix description of the bale wrapping scheme to correctly indicate potential penalties.

1.0.0.10:
- Adds a new crop rotation view showing harvest history, to aid planning. Minor rework of the crop rotation policy.
- Adds the idea of tax losses rolling over to future years. Upon loading an existing save, it will count losses from the previous statement.
- Added filter to brand demo to avoid offering useless equipment. Currently this filters out frontloaders but will adjust based on feedback.
- Add CZ translation.
- Correctly pluralise months for each language

1.0.0.9:
- Fix an issue with tractor demos not ending correctly.
- Fix a multiplayer issue when selecting schemes.

1.0.0.8:
- A number of multiplayer fixes.
- Fix excess tax rate maths I added when moving tax rate to a setting.

1.0.0.7:
- Further fix to address multiplayer progression issues
- Added settings to disable systems and set tax rate

1.0.0.6:
- Add threshold to manure storage policy to only be in violation above 5k litres of stored manure.
- Fix an issue on multiplayer which prevents animals aging correctly.

1.0.0.5:
- Adds a workaround to address an issue in the Realistic Weather which causes an issue in this mod when spraying.

1.0.0.4:
- Safe guard added to prevent salt spreading scheme showing up multiple times at once.
- Rework of manure policy. The report will be incorrect initially, but in a way that it is more lenient until all the data is tracked.
- Rework of animal spacing policy. Age is now taken into account, e.g. a 2 month old cow requires less space than a 24 month old cow. Points will no longer be deducted during a month that produces a warning only.
- Clarify 14m buffer zone in spray violation policy description.

1.0.0.3:

- Fix a multiplayer only issue when spraying fertiliser
- Skip pigs and horses for the animal productivity policy.
- Brazilian translation added, thanks to MuhWalker.
- Russian translation added, thanks to Martin.

1.0.0.2:
- Fixed an issue where seeders that fertilised caused harmless errors in the log.

343328.title: The Pichonnière Valley
343328.author: Blacksheep Modding
343328.description:
Discover an authentic French farm in the heart of the Sarthe region.

Welcome to The Pichonnière Valley, a map inspired by a real farm located in the Sarthe department, just a few kilometers from the legendary 24 Hours of Le Mans racetrack.
With the authorization of Julien, a dairy cattle farmer, the main farm, the livestock buildings, and the dealer’s shop have been faithfully recreated to offer you a unique immersive experience.


Start your game wherever you like:
- at the main dairy farm,
- at one of the new purchasable farms,
- or on a buildable plot to create your own custom farm.


On the map you will find:
- 111 arable fields (crops or grasslands)
- 7 forestry plots
- several buildable areas
- 1 main dairy farm
- 1 arable farm
- 3 small farms to develop
- 1 vegetable farm
- 1 pig farm
- 1 dealership
- Numerous production zones: dairy, sugar factory, carpentry workshop, sawmill, soup factory, flour mill, oil mill, cement factory, fertilizer and herbicide production
- 1 fish farming and processing site
- 1 livestock market
- 1 railway silo for crop sales
- 1 rail-based selling point for wood
- 1 warehouse for purchasing palletized products


New crops and productions

Precision Farming DLC compatible.

Expand your farm with new profitable and versatile crops:
- Mustard: condiment production;
- Rye, triticale, spelt: excellent value as grain or traditional flour for the Champ Gué bakery, straw usable for livestock or sale;
- Triticale: pig feed production;
- Green rye: silage in bales or silos with excellent yield, or use as green manure;
- Vetch–rye and green rye: use as green manure, hay, silage in bales or silos;
- Alfalfa and clover: hay, silage in bales or silos;
- Green-harvested silage maize: high yield for animal feed.

The map terrain has been reworked to provide realistic relief, optimized for soil cultivation from different angles (excluding potato cultivation).


Collectibles and exploration

Set off in search of the collectibles scattered around La Chapelle-Saint-Fray.
Solve a series of riddles to recover the 20 pieces of the Cochetière mill museum.
Once rebuilt, discover the museum’s final secret… along with a well-deserved reward.

343600.title: Somewhere In Thuringia IV Crossplay
343600.author: [D-S-Agrarservice] Kastor
343600.description:
Welcome to "Somewhere in Thuringia 4"!
Your journey takes you to the gently rolling landscape between Magdala (A4) and the town of Blankenhain – right into the idyllic village of Lossnitz.
Here, the fields lie open before you, while the dense forests on the horizon promise that plenty of work awaits.

Focus & Machinery:
The focus is on authentic arable farming and forestry.
The map has been primarily optimized for small to medium-sized machinery.
The paths and field layouts harmonize best with compact equipment, although the use of large machinery is technically possible with sufficient driving skill.

Your Start, Your Choice:
Two prepared farms are available to you: a charming small family farm for those who love nostalgia, and a large agricultural enterprise for those who want to operate on a grand scale.
Additionally, there is a BGA and a sawmill at your disposal.

True Orchards (Not a simple "Reskin"):
A special highlight of this map is the specialized fruit farming (apple/cherry/pear/plum).
This is not just a simple visual update of the grapes!
While we use the established system, we have deeply customized it with our own trees and a dedicated Picktrain.
This ensures a completely new and authentic harvesting experience.

!No visual mulching effect in orchards due to engine limitations.
This prevents critical errors (LUA Call-Stacks) when the AI helper performs mulching jobs.!

Multifruit & Regional Authenticity:
The map offers full Multifruit support.
To match the regional climate of Thuringia, exotic crops such as olives, cotton, sugar cane, and rice are not available.

Additional Crops: Green Rye, Humus Active, Mustard, Rye, Silage Maize, Triticale, Vetch Rye, Flowering Catch Crop,
Alfalfa, Clover, Field Grass, Winter Wheat, Winter Barley, Spelt, Onion, Apple, Cherry, Pear and Plum.

Technical Specifications:
- 32 ground angles for ultra-precise soil cultivation.
- Increased heightTypes limit for more variety when tipping materials on the ground.

Freedom & Support:
- Sellable World: Almost all decorative objects, halls, and props on the farms and the BGA can be sold individually.
This allows you to completely redesign existing facilities according to your wishes.
- Building Space: In addition to the starting farms, there is plenty of open space explicitly intended as building areas for your own projects.
- In-game Help: Extensive help has been integrated directly into the game, explaining all the map's special features in detail, not just the orchards.

Important Information:
- Map Edge: There is a building restriction in an approx. 50 m wide strip at the edge of the map (game standard).
Think carefully before removing objects from this area.
- Technical Note: The mods "Seasonal Prices" (w33zl) and "Harvest Profit" (Raster R3 Modding) are technically incompatible with this map.
Use them at your own risk, as errors may occur.

Randon's line of lowered trailers with movable necks is known for its practicality, and its use for transporting tracked machinery or machinery that cannot climb steep ramps. The disengageable head system makes it easy to transport a variety of different machines, and combined with the right physics, it makes a great trailer for general use!

- To transport, press the function that will lower the trailer to unhook it, and then unhook the rear part of the trailer. The front part will be attached to the truck, so move it away and load your machines as normal. Once the machines have been loaded, carefully move the truck to the rear and engage the rear part. Press the function that will raise the trailer and this will make it ready for transportation. Slide the tension straps over and it's ready for transportation. To improve transportation, if you prefer, open the side extensions using the animation in animation group 2. This will place a wooden extension on the side, collapsible and functional.

343878.title: Unlimited Weight
343878.author: Aslan
343878.description:
This mod removes the built-in physical weight limit for many vehicles and vehicle combinations.

In the base game, the actual weight calculation stops once the maximum allowed weight of a trailer or vehicle is reached – even when the trailer is only half full. This makes it possible for small tractors to pull or carry unrealistic loads without affecting handling.

With UnlimitedWeight, the true weight is fully simulated — even when overloaded!
Heavily loaded or overloaded combinations now have a noticeable impact on:

- acceleration
- braking
- traction
- climbing ability
- overall stability

Make sure your machine has enough power, especially on uneven terrain or difficult ground conditions. Overloaded vehicles become more challenging to handle and require more planning and skill — just like in real life.

Experience Farming Simulator with more realistic and demanding vehicle physics!

344150.author: modelleicher
344150.description:
This Mod aims to add more realism around balers. Here are the key features in short notes.

Squarebaler:
- bale animation is not constant but in steps in synch with the plunger speed like iRL
- power calculation is dependend on throughput/input of material and type of material
- power calculation is dependend on plunger so there are power requirement spikes for each plunger hit
(depending on the tractors sound settings this can actually be heard)

Roundbaler:
- bales can be unloaded before 100% is reached
- power calculation is dependend on throughput/input of material and type of material
- power calculation is dependend on bale pressure, if the bale is almost finished power need goes up drastically


Additional Notes:
Due to the nature of a global mod without specific settings for each bale the power calculation might be off.
This Mod uses the basegame power need settings in the xml of the baler as basis for its calculation.
So if this value is very high/low of a mod compared to the averate basegame baler the calculation might not feel right.
In this case it is unfortunately needed to adjust the power requirements within the mod baler itself.

- fixed early unload percentage not changing with bale size/volume

344256.title: Self-marketing
344256.author: farmerfivetom
344256.description:
With this pack, you can open your own direct marketing. For this purpose, you can choose between sales houses, of different sizes, as well as vending machines.
Self-marketing means fresh food for customers 24 hours a day and a clear conscience, as they know where the products come from. Freshly stocked, the products are provided to them by the producer without intermediate trade.
For you as producers, this means simple and direct marketing of your own products, which gives you a higher profit but also some additional work.
Depending on which model they choose, they will have different costs and profit opportunities.

! Important: There are two versions of each building. You can find them in the corresponding category.
- Selling stations are real selling stations and, as such, can only be used by the owner.
- Productions function similarly. However, they are productions! This means you can sell less, but with the same profit. The goods sold are gradually phased out over time, creating a more realistic farm shop experience. You simply need to activate the goods you want to sell beforehand.
Furthermore, you now have to decide which of your products you want to sell. This is done via the production menu. Here, you simply select the products you want to sell and activate "production." Depending on whether your product requires specific precautions, such as refrigeration, additional costs may apply.

The sales houses are available in four different designs:
- Large: lettuce, tomato, grape, potatoes, flour, milk, butter, cheese, eggs, honey, oils, bread, wool,
- Small: lettuce, tomato, grape, potatoes, flour, milk, butter, cheese, eggs, honey, oils, bread, wool,
- As extension: lettuce, tomato, grape, potatoes, flour, milk, butter, cheese, eggs, honey, oils, bread, wool,
- Very large: lettuce, tomato, grape, potatoes, grape juice, raisins, flour, milk, butter, cheese, chocolate, eggs, honey, cereals, oils, bread, wool, hay, fabric, clothes
- The Lights in the building can be turned on and the Doors could be opened

- Small milk filling station (price: 11.000$)

344901.title: Courseplay GPS Extension
344901.author: Schluppe
344901.description:
Courseplay GPS Extension
Description: This mod adds automatic steering to Vehicles based on Courseplay courses.
In order to use this mod there is the need to have Courseplay installed.

Afterwards you can use Field courses to enable GPS tracking when driving tractors or harvesters.
The motivation was to have the chance to smoothly swap between the CP helper and manual driving, but still using GPS tracking.
The Giants automatic steering does come with own courses might causing an offset or different tracks than CoursePlay uses.
In general does the CP course generator offer much more options to control the details of courses incl. the option to load and save them.
An example is cutting the grass (10m working width) and afterwards picking it up by simply loading the same course.


How to use this mod:
- Assign an activation key in the settings
- Generate or load a CP course
- As from this moment the you can activate the automatic steering when driving onto a field
- The system picks the closest way points and start to steer automatically

Features:
- Automatically follows the CP course
- The system is foreseen for working on fields only.

Parameters to control the following features:
- GPS tracking disabled (end of the row, end of the course, on connecting path or never)
- Disable cruise control (end of the row, end of the course, on connecting path or never)
- Remove Giants automatic steering courses when a CP course is loaded
- Define the mode to show the path of the course
- Time to hide the path after activating the automatic steering

345962.title: Module 8 Express Cotton Trailer
345962.author: Jolly Farms Modding
345962.description:
A game changer in hauling, our cotton trailer is designed for 8 round bales to lay flat on the bed for safer loading, transporting, and unloading. With traditional module trucks having capacity for only four bales, our trailer saves on time and fuel costs.

For best results it is recommended to position the trailer on a flat surface (or even slightly higher in the front) and load the trailer from the back first. The more powerful the truck is the easier it will be to pull this heavy trailer, and tension belts will help, although these trailers are usually used without them in real life.

This mod also has a self-loading store configuration and will pick up eight modules automatically when driven close to them. To start the autoload function, enter operating postion and drive near the cotton modules. Once they are all loaded up you can enter transport mode and the modules will stay on the trailer no matter how crazy you drive (as long as you don't reset the trailer!).
To unload, use the crane functions to move the modules to where you want to leave them, then simply "unload" them! This is an unrealistic option that I have added for ease of gameplay, but it is entirely possible to use the trailer with no autoload, tension belts, or fancy equipment.

This trailer is designed to be loaded by wheel loaders and telehandlers using large bale spears such as my Round Cotton Module Spear For Wheel Loaders mod (available on modhub), which goes well with this mod.

Wide meadows and fields alternate with dense forests, which appear in fresh green, warm autumn colors, or quiet winter tones depending on the season.

346266.title: Texture Streaming Budget Increase
346266.author: Helfer B.
346266.description:
By default, the game uses a maximum of 4GB of graphics card memory to
store high-resolution textures. As soon as you turn away from a building in the game, for example,
its textures may be discarded from memory in order to load other textures.

If you turn back toward the building, it may “flicker” briefly because only the low-resolution
textures are visible and the game then reloads the high-resolution textures into memory.

This mod "resets" the limit of the texture memory used from the default 4GB to the available memory (VRAM) of the graphics card.

Therefore, this mod should only be used if your graphics card
has more than 4GB of memory.

346446.title: Additional Inputs
346446.author: VertexDezign
346446.description:
Additional Inputs enhances your vehicle control in FS25 by adding explicit keybindings designed for realistic hardware setups,
such as the Moza Multi-function Stalks. This mod introduces authentic turn signal logic with comfort blinking (tip blink),
discrete controls for headlight and worklight stages, and dedicated inputs to Fold, Lower, and Activate implements
independently based on their front or back position without needing to select them first.

Features

Indicators / TurnSignal

Adds explicit inputs for indicating left / right and one for turning them off. Similar how an indicator lever in a car
works. Also adds the tip blink / comfort indicators functionality. If after the on signal an off signals follows within
500ms, the tip blink is activated.
If the hazard light is on, it has priority. These added inputs cannot turn of the hazard lights.


Lights

Adds new controls for normal front light on and off, also one for worklight front on.
