347177.title: Kreis Steinfurt
347177.author: Maloy
347177.description:
Welcome to the map “Kreis Steinfurt” located in the heart of the Münsterland region!

This highly detailed map is based on the rural communities of Offlum and Landersum near the town of Neuenkirchen in the district of Steinfurt, Germany. The area is characterized by typical Münsterland agriculture with open farmland, large grassland areas, small forests and traditional farms.

The map has been created with a strong focus on detail and aims to represent the structure of the real landscape as closely as possible. Players will find varied farms, realistic field layouts and a calm rural environment.

Map Features:
- 133 purchasable farmland areas
- 30 grassland fields
- 8 purchasable forest area
- 3 additional pastures available for purchase
- 5 fully equipped farms
- Several selling points and production facilities
- A biogas plant (BGA)

Farms on the map:
- An arable farm with chickens and horses
- A pig farm
- A potato farm with pigs and cows
- A dairy farm with cows
- A dairy farm with cows and chickens

Field sizes are typical for the Münsterland region. Most fields range between roughly 1 and 3 hectares, with smaller plots under one hectare and medium-sized fields up to about 6 hectares. Two larger fields of approximately 17 and 20 hectares allow the use of larger machinery.

The map is suitable for both singleplayer and multiplayer and offers a balanced mix of arable farming, animal husbandry and grassland management. The biogas plant allows players to process silage and other materials for additional income.

Explore the rural areas of Offlum and Landersum and build your own farming operation in the Münsterland

Note: To ensure the AI assistant works properly, we recommend disabling AI traffic in the game settings.

347250.description:
Start in Spring

This mod forces a new savegame to start in spring March instead of late summer.
On first load of a new career, all fields are reset to a cultivated state to ensure a clean and consistent spring start.

Main Features

- Game always starts in March spring
- Crop calendar is synchronized with spring start
- All fields owned and unowned are reset to cultivated on new save
- Harvest-ready and growing crops are removed at game start
- One-time execution per savegame safe to disable later
- Works on GIANTS base maps

Important Notes

- Field reset is performed with a delayed system-safe method to avoid base map overrides
- On some systems, the info message may appear a short moment after loading
- After the first successful run and save, the mod does nothing anymore
- The game may freeze for a while, while the fields are being reset

-Changelog: 1.1.0.0

- Added multiplayer and dedicated server support
- Start logic now works correctly in MP sessions via server authority
- Added dynamic snow amount based on starting month

347316.title: Crop Rotation
347316.author: Chissel
347316.description:
This mod brings a realistic crop rotation system to Farming Simulator 25 and adds significantly more depth to farming. The yield of your fields now depends on which crops you have previously grown.

Good crop rotations improve soil quality in the long term and ensure higher yields, while one-sided cultivation or unfavorable sequences deplete the soil and lead to yield losses. This makes every cultivation decision more important and strategic.

In addition, the mod takes into account the use of cover crops:

Suitable cover crops improve soil structure and have a positive effect on the next yield.

However, incorrectly chosen cover crops can have negative effects.

347991.title: Variable Tire Pressure
347991.author: HotShotPepper
347991.description:
Variable Tire Pressure allows you to deflate and inflate tires in order to adjust tire pressure to different applications (e.g. field work or road driving). Lower tire pressure increases traction.

Installation:
A new entry must be added to the vehicle/trailer XML. Installation instructions (DE/EN) are included. VariableTirePressure only works if the script/mod is installed in the mod folder.

For supported base game vehicles, you can now choose in the shop whether you want to use it or not.

In the settings window (Ctrl + Alt + U), you can adjust the tire deformation. After releasing air from the tires, you can also fine-tune the appearance using the Min. Tire Radius setting so the tires do not look like they are sunk into the ground.

Currently supported vanilla/DLC vehicle types:
- Tractors
- Slurry tankers
- Self-propelled slurry spreaders
- Manure spreaders
- Field sprayers
- Self-propelled field sprayers
- Combines / forage harvesters
- Loading wagons
- Auger wagons

Key bindings:
- Full vehicle combination: Alt + V
- Tractor tire pressure: Alt + T
- Trailer only: Alt + O

HUD:
- Open RDA control panel: Ctrl + Alt + U
- Show/hide HUD: Ctrl + Alt + J

Changelog 1.0.0.2:
- Mod vehicles without an XML entry are now detected.
- Saved pressure values are now loaded correctly when joining the server.
- Adjustments to the Vredo DLC.

Changelog 1.0.0.1:
- Added support for base game vehicles
- Pressure values can now be adjusted in-game
- Completely reworked HUD
- Fixed an issue with the mouse cursor when closing the settings
- vtp="true" can now also be added to a DesignConfig
- Added dashboard support for trailers

348292.title: Forester
348292.author: RHF
348292.description:
Forester for FS25 - a complete forest editing tool.

Please save your game before using this tool.

Press Ctrl + T to open the editor.

MODES
- Zone: draw a polygon on the terrain and generate, replace, or delete trees inside it.
- Plant brush: paint new trees within the brush radius.
- Replace brush: swap existing trees for another species within the brush radius.
- Delete brush: remove trees within the brush radius.

FEATURES
- Choose a specific species, weighted-random, or uniform-random selection.
- Configure per-species probabilities for weighted selection.
- Control density, growth stage, clustering, and trunk tilt.
- Delete stumps (Only in Zone mode).
- Live tree counter with an optional map-wide tree limit.
- Undo the last editor action.
- Multiplayer supported (Only available to Admins).
- Global tree cutting for Chainsaws and machinery (Needs to be activated by admins online).

ZONE EDITOR
- Left-click terrain to place polygon points (up to 32).
- Right-click to remove the last point.
- Full species, density, appearance and placement controls in the side panel.

NOTES
- Restart the game to reset tree LOD after large edits.
- Zone Mode cannot plant on fields.
- Replacing or deleting trees before Deadwood missions spawn can in some cases break the mission.

Changelog

2.0.0.0
- Major rewrite. Adds the full zone editor, plant / replace / delete brushes, a native settings panel, per-species probability configuration, growth-stage and clustering controls.
- Removed the separate delete-brush toggle keybind; the delete brush is selected from the Forester menu.
- Renamed the open-menu keybind to "Open Forester Menu".
- Added an options toggle to show or hide the Forester keybind hints in the on-screen help.

348669.title: Quicke 3-Point Linkage Adapter
348669.author: Agrogaatti
348669.description:
A simple adapter for using front loader tools on a 3-point linkage on machines without a front loader.

Quicke 3-Point Linkage Adapter has three different attachment points to choose from in the shop. The 3-point linkage has a more limited range of motion compared to a front loader, and not all implements can be used optimally with the adapter. However, by using different attachment points on different sized tractors and with different tools, it is possible to use most tools. Equipment with a very slanted attachment point, such as many standard buckets, are not well suited for the adapter. However, there is a wide range of usable attachments available.

The location of the upper attachment point is only a visual change in the game, which you can choose to suit the length of the top link of the vehicle you are using.
It is recommended to lower the three-point hitch before detaching, as this will make it easier to leave the adapter upright and ease the attaching next time. If the tool has fallen over and you are unable to connect it, you can lift it back upright by hand.

Categories: Front Loaders, Miscellaneous
Price: $660

349039.title: Silage Compaction Monitor
349039.author: Sumro Gaming
349039.description:
Take the guesswork out of silage making in Farming Simulator 25!

The Silage Compaction Monitor is a quality-of-life mod that adds a real-time information HUD to your screen whenever you are working in a bunker silo. No more endlessly driving back and forth wondering if your tractor is heavy enough or how much longer it will take.

Key Features:
- Real-Time HUD: Automatically appears when you enter an active bunker silo while inside a vehicle.
- Total Vehicle Mass: Accurately displays the combined weight of your tractor, weights, and attached implements in Tons.
- Efficiency Indicator: The mass display is color-coded to let you know if your setup is too light (Red/Orange), good (Yellow), or perfect for the job (Green).
- Time Estimation: Provides a dynamic estimated time remaining until 100% compaction, based on your current vehicle's weight.
- Progress Tracking: Clearly shows current compaction percentage and total silage volume.
- Smart Detection: Warns you if you are on foot and need to enter a vehicle.

Changelog:
v1.1.0.0
-Added a new option in the in-game settings menu. You can now freely move and adjust the position of the monitor on your screen to suit your playstyle!
-Resolved an issue with the weight count. The monitor now accurately tracks and displays the correct weight data for flawless compaction tracking.

349449.title: Carpathian Countryside
349449.author: MrHector
349449.description:
Welcome to Carpathian Countryside. Fictional map inspired by a modern real life agricultural company and its surroundings in western Slovakia.

Map features:

3 Pre-placed farms. To use them or interact with anything you have to buy them by purchasing the farm land they are built on.
All 3 pre-placed farms are fully editable, you can sell individual buildings or parts of fences - you can expand the farms. You can sell everything and build your own farm on the same place. Most buildings and objects used on pre-placed farms also have their placeable variants included in the map.

Main Farm (the start farm).
The largest pre-placed farm on the map, consisting of: 2 cow barns, 1 pig barn, 1 horse barn, 2 calf / heifer shelters, farmhouse, large grain silo with animal feed production, vehicle workshop, 2 covered bunker silo buildings (6 bunkers in total), many shelters for vehicles or any packaged or loose goods, bale and pallet storages, large manure storage, slurry tanks, water tower and more.

Pig Farm.
All about the pigs with: 2 pig barns, grain silo, bunker silo, vehicle workshop, vehicle shelter, manure storage, bale storage, pallet storage, bulk storage, water tower and slurry tanks.

Sheep Farm.
Includes: 1 sheep barn, 1 chicken coop, grain silo, vehicle workshop, manure storage, vehicle shelter, bale storage and pallet storage.

70 fields + 6 meadow fields. Especially large fields with different shapes, also some medium and small.
Some fields have electricity poles in them, their collisions can be disabled /enabled at any time - to do so visit the town hall next to the main farm.

Large forestry area.
14 purchasable forest parcels with different sizes, conditions and corresponding prices.

Contracts.
All Contract types included - all kind of field missions, dead trees removal, wood transport and rocks removal.

Collectibles.
100 wooden toys divided into 10 sets, 10 collectibles in each set.
The reward for collecting is 1,000.
The reward for completing the entire set is 100,000 and the toy will be displayed on the shelf in your room in the office building.

Train system.
Rentable train with railroad silos and sell point.

8 Selling stations.
Transport Company, Livestock market, Supermarket, Farmers market, Small farmer, Container trader, Construction material trader, Stone crusher.
Each interested in a different type and quantity of goods.
When the desired quantity of goods is reach the price will start to drop for some time.

7 Buying stations.
Big and small gas stations with electricity charges and methane refill station.
Lime station.
Farm supplies - option to buy farm consumables (e.g. seeds, fertilizer) directly to the trailer.
Livestock market - option to buy manure, slurry and animal feed.
Transport Company - option to buy any kind of products on pallets.
Construction material trader - option to buy construction materials on pallets.

11 Production sites built into the map.
Bakery, Grain mill, Dairy, Sugarmill, Sawmill, Carpentry, Spinnery, Tailor shop, Food processing plant, Preserved food factory, Biogas plant.
Production sites have their own forklifts, which can be used by everybody.
Sugarmill offer their own sugar beet loader useable for everybody.
The map contains several small and cheaply purchasable lands, which are ideal for building additional production points.

All selling and buying stations and productions have different opening hours.
The gates open and close automatically at specific times. (All closed by default when you first started the game, wait an hour in game to bring them back to normal cycle).
If you need to do something urgent even after closing, you can open the gates manually.

2 Small family businesses.
Piano factory - produce high quality and expensive pianos.
Wood artist - produce tractor playgrounds and various other handcrafted wooden products.
You can help them by selling them materials they require and see how they produce their art or you can buy them and run the business on your own for nice profit.

Construction projects.
There are 3 houses under construction, 1 in each village on the map.
They require your help and you can help them by selling them construction materials they require.
Furthermore you can help the neighborhood grow with placeable constructible rental houses and get nice profit too from the rent.

Abandoned quarry, Cement factory and Iron furnace.
There is abandoned quarry in the forest that you can run by purchasing the farmland it is built on.
It requires a lot of maintenance before it is usable again or even accessible. You have to remove overgrown foliage and rocks all around the place. Repair or remove destroyed buildings. The temporary safety fence surrounding it can be removed in build menu.
You can also build your own quarry anywhere on the map, all required aspects are included in the map as placeable variants.
Quarry in the forest produce: stone, limestone, clay and iron ore.
Stone and limestone can be used in the stone and limestone crushers to make gravel and lime. Gravel, lime and clay are then required in the cement factory to make varius construction products.
Iron ore can be used in the Iron furnace to make metal for nice profit. The side product is blast furnace slag which is then required in the cement factory to make cement.
Iron furnace and Cement factory must be build by yourself, they are not built directly into the map.
The cement factory included in the map is much more advanced, with much more realistic cement recipe compare to the base game one, new products like clay bricks and clay roof plates.
Another material required in the cement factory is sand, which can be only purchased from the construction material trader, aswell as any other materials you may need if you can not make them by yourself.
Any excess raw materials from the quarry can be also sold to the construction material trader.

Functional map villages.
A small features for role players or a real challenge of starting from scratch.
Almost all properties in villages can be purchased.
You can place in sleep trigger and use any house as your own or if there is enough space you can build something extra there too, however what is already placed on these parcels can not be removed.
With small enough equipment you can plant, grow and harvest crops in these yards.
Every single gate can be opened, even if you do not own the land.
Some properties such as: restaurants, pharmacy, football fields... generate stable profit if owned - If you purchase the farmland a new icon will pop up. The income is based on the farmland value - 1,1$ per hour / per each 1000$ land value.

Custom animal settings.
Slightly adjusted: food and straw consumption, production of manure, liquid manure and milk and animal prices.
Sheeps, goats and chickens produce manure if beded with straw (Only husbandries included in the map or a mod that meet requirements).
If you like to take care of calves in calf huts, the map features placeable calf huts. A variant for one calf and a group variant for five calves. (Recommendation: use mod to increase animal pastures limit, so it is possible to place more huts)

New crops: Alfalfa and Rye.
Alfalfa is part of the animal feeding. Edited placeable base game bunker silos accepting alfalfa are included in the map. Custom map bunker silos all accept alfalfa.
Rye can be used to make flour and bread. Can be harvested both ways, the classic combine or with windrower.

Enhanced crop growth stages for all crops on the map.
Each growth stage has different height so the growth looks much smoother.
Stubble destruction with wheels (If crop destruction is enabled).

Not all crops require rolling.
Crops that require rolling: wheat, barley, canola, oats, soybeans, rye.
Crops that do not require rolling: corn, sunflowers, potatoes, rice, long grain rice, sugar beets, sugar cane, cotton, sorghum, poplar, beetroot, carrots, parsnips, beans, peas, spinach, grass, oilseed radish, alfalfa.

Seasonal crop growth
Is mostly the same as the base game (fits very well for the country of the map) but with added option to plant wheat and barley in the spring - in march.
Cotton, sugarcane, rice and long grain rice are not typical for the country of the map, but you can grow them if you want, NPCs will not.

Custom seasonal weather, typical for the country of the map.
Twister probability reduced and can happen only during summer.


Orchards and Greenhouses:

Placeable Orchards.
Works as standard production point, require water, liquid fertilizer and compost to produce: apples, pears, apricots or plums.
Apples, apricots and plums can be sold or further processed in the placeable Fruit and vegetable processing plant or in the Food processing plant(built into the map) for bigger profit.
Pears can be only sold directly.

Placeable Advanced greenhouses.
Similar to the base game greenhouses but with additional requirements for bigger yield and additional fruits to grow.
Available as large, medium and small size variants.
Require water, liquid fertilizer and compost to produce: tomatoes, lettuce, strawberries, spring onion, napa cabbage, chilli, garlic, green pepper, cucumbers, onions and watermelons.
Byproduct of Advanced greenhouses is organic waste. This can be used in compost silo to make compost.
Tomatoes, strawberries, napa cabbage and cucumbers can be sold or further processed in the placeable Fruit and vegetable processing plant or in the Food processing plant(built into the map) for bigger profit.
Small amount of green pepper, spring onion, chilli, garlic and onions are required in recipes of the placeable Fruit and vegetable processing plant or in the Food processing plant(built into the map), but majority of it can be sold directly.
Lettuce and watermelons can be only sold directly.

Placeable Fruit and vegetable processing plant.
Can further process fruits and vegetables produced in the orchards and greenhouses for bigger profit.
Products: Raisins, Grape juice, Kimchi, Apple juice, strawberry juice, apricot jam, plum jam, ketchup and pickles.
Byproduct is organic waste. This can be used in compost silo to make compost.
Available also as small variant with lower production speed and price.
All products and same recipes are also available in the Preserved food factory and Food processing plant (factories built into the map).

Compost making.
Compost is required in the orchards and greenhouses and can be also sold for profit or used as fertilizer on fields.
Compost is made in placeable Compost silo from organic waste, grass, hay, straw and other similar materials.

Several small streams crisscross the land, with free water withdrawal.


Highlands Fishing Expansion features (if you own the DLC and is enabled):
Onion products in the DLC (onion soup, onion salt and fried onion) can be produced also in the Food processing plant(built into the map).
You can raise trouts in the forest fishing pond if owned, by purchasing the farmland it is built on.
Furthermore the fishing pond is also a place that people visit and fish there so you also get stable daily income from them of 140$ per hour. (This income works even without the DLC).


Precision Farming DLC ready - Custom soil map included. Compost and new crops fully supported.

350273.title: Vehicle Assistance System
350273.author: SoSi-Modding
350273.description:
Vehicle Assistance System (VAS)
Enhance your vehicles with intelligent assistance features that make driving and maneuvering more convenient and safer.

-- CORE FEATURES --
Parking Distance Control (PDC)
- Vehicle-specific feature that must be configured in individual vehicle XMLs. (is pre-registered for several basegame, dlc and mod vehicles)
- Smart sensors alert you as you approach objects when parking or maneuvering (under 10 kph), measuring distances in real-time.
- Can be toggled on/off in the general settings menu.

Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB)
- Vehicle-specific feature that must be activated in individual vehicle XMLs. (is pre-registered for several basegame, dlc and mod vehicles)
- Provides collision detection and automatic braking when obstacles appear suddenly ahead.
- Activates at speeds above 10 kph with detection range up to 20 meters.
- Can be toggled on/off in the general settings menu.

Intelligent Cruise Control (ICC)
- Globally available on all motor vehicles.
- Maintains your set speed while automatically adjusting your speed to the vehicles ahead of you using adaptive distance calculation.
- Respects your set cruising speed and automatically adjusts based on detected traffic.
- Toggle hotkey: Alt + 3.

Automatic Light Control (ALC)
- Available on vehicles with light systems.
- Intelligently manages low beam and high beam based on driving conditions, weather, time of day and oncoming traffic.
- Automatically switches to high beam in darkness and low beam when vehicles approach.
- Toggle hotkeys: Alt + F (low beam) and Alt + Ctrl + F (high beam).

Reverse Camera Control (RCC)
- Vehicle-specific feature that must be configured in individual vehicle XMLs.
- When enabled for a vehicle, it automatically activates a rear view camera when reversing, helping you navigate tight spots with confidence.
- Note: Requires the Mercedes-Benz Trucks Pack DLC.

-- ADDITIONAL FEATURES --
Animation Action Control (AAC)
- Advanced animation management system for vehicle interactions with dedicated hotkeys.

Beacon Light Control (BLC)
- Control beacon systems or emergency warning lights with dedicated hotkeys.

Fold Cover Disabler (FCD)
- Manage vehicle cover, folding and turnOnVehicle behaviors on specific vehicles through XML configuration, allowing better customization without mod conflicts.

For detailed technical documentation on integrating features into custom vehicles, please refer to the vas-documentation.pdf in the mod's sdk folder.

Changelog 1.0.0.1:
- Fixed: (RCC) Reverse Camera Control not activating correctly when steering direction change is set to automatic
- Fixed: (ICC) Intelligent Cruise Control breaks when vehicle size parameter are inaccurate
- Fixed: (ALC) Automatic Light Control does not effect attached equipment
- Changed: (AEB) Increased brake force at automatic emergency brake event
- Added: (FCD) disableTurnOnVehicle parameter

A bundle of hand tools covering every stage of the job, from field preparation to harvest.

350782.title: Enhanced Color Selection
350782.author: w33zl
350782.description:
This mod enhances the color selection options for vehicles by adding additional default colors (e.g. used for "Main Color") as well as adding some additional options for rim colors.

FEATURES:
- Adds ~25 missing color to the default color selction (e.g Volvo yellow, Kubota orange, MB truck and Unimog colors etc).
- Adds ~10 new rim colors and extends rim color selection with a handful of base game colors to choose from
- Automatically adds rim color configuration to 250+ vehicles that previosly didn't have rim color option
- Automatically extendeds the rim color selection of 100+ vehicles to use the new rim color options
- Tweak the default silver/aluminium rim color to use a slighlyt more metallic/shiny appearance.
- Adds a new polished aluminium rim color option.
- Adds a "pitch black" color option for main colors.
- Makes it possible for you to create your own colors that will be applied globally, see readme.txt for instructions.

If you experience issues with rim colors on certain vehicles, it is possible to change 'SOFTFORCE_INJECT_RIM_COLOR = true' to 'SOFTFORCE_INJECT_RIM_COLOR = false' on line 15 in the EnhancedColorSelection.lua file. This enables a less intrusive method to add rim colors, but will be applied to fever vehicles as a drawback.

Important note: While being safe to disable the mod at any time, disabling the mod will reset the color choice for any vehicle that uses one of the added colors back to the default color. To avoid this, you can go to the "Custom" color tab and apply the selected color again, doing so will convert the pre-defined color to a custom color making it persistent even after disabling the mod.

_______________________________________________________________________________

FOR MODDERS:
It is possible to use any of the colors defined by this mod in your own mods. You can reference the color by its template name (e.g. "PITCH_BLACK" or "RIM_ALUMINUM_POLISHED"), just remember to add this mod as a dependency in modDesc to avoid warnings in the log.

_______________________________________________________________________________

- NEW: Added six new rim colors: Polished Aluminium, Steel, Polished Steel, Chrome (alterantive), Dark Chrome, Gun Metal, Dark Metal, Silver

350970.title: GE10 Script - Placeable XML Editor (Prefab*)
350970.author: Aslan
350970.description:
This GIANTS Editor script allows you to easily create and edit a placeable XML file.
The script automatically detects the corresponding placeable.xml, provided it is located in the same directory and has the same name as the .i3d file. If existing entries are found, all supported parameters are read and made available for editing within the tool.

Installation:
1.) Locate the installation directory of the GIANTS Editor. By default: "C:\Program Files\GIANTS Software\GIANTS_Editor_10.X.X\"
2.) Copy the script "PlaceableXMLEditor.lua" and "iconBigDefault.png" from the prefab folder into the script directory of the GIANTS Editor.
3.) The script will then be available in the GIANTS Editor via the menu bar under “Scripts”.

Usage:
1.) Start the script on an object that you want to create as a placeable.
2.) The script automatically detects whether the object is located inside a mod and, if so, enables the tab “Add in modDesc.xml”. There, the path to the modDesc.xml can be specified in order to automatically add the placeable XML to the modDesc.
3.) Areas can be generated automatically. Set the offset value (in meters), select the object from which the areas should be generated, and click the corresponding button to create the area.
4.) Adjust all parameters according to your requirements.
5.) In the “I3D Mappings” section, select the nodes that should be stored in the I3D mappings of the XML. If necessary, the scene graph can be reloaded using the “Refresh” button.
6.) Finally, click “GENERATE” or “UPDATE” at the top to create or update the placeable.xml.

INFO:
At the moment, it is not yet possible to create all placeable specializations such as sellingStation, buyingStation, husbandries, etc. directly within the tool. However, the script can be used as a base to generate an XML file, which can then be manually extended with additional specializations.
The PlaceableIcon is currently only displayed if it is a .PNG file. .DDS files are not (yet) supported by the Giants Editor in scripts!

The script only modifies parameters that are configurable within the tool. Any existing XML entries that are not supported by the script will remain unchanged and will not be removed or overwritten.

Hotfix 20.02.2026:
- added iconBigDefault.png
- Path "PlaceableXMLEditor.PLACEABLE_ICON_EMPTY_PATH" adjusted
- Custom area names will be possible in the next regular update. Currently, only these exact names are accepted:
# testAreaStart01, testAreaEnd01
# clearAreaStart01, clearAreaWidth01, clearAreaHeight01
# levelAreaStart01, levelAreaWidth01, levelAreaHeight01
# indoorAreaStart01, indoorAreaWidth01, indoorAreaHeight01
# tipOcclusionUpdateAreaStart01, tipOcclusionUpdateAreaEnd01

351451.title: Adjust Tramlines For Missions
351451.author: BayernGamers
351451.description:
This mod allows you to adjust the tramlines on mission fields to match your own machines or working widths of rented mission vehicles.

When accepting a field mission (fertilizing, spraying, hoeing, weeding) in the mission menu, an additional window appears for supported crop types that allows you to adjust the tramlines.
It is also possible to adjust the tramlines for missions that have already been accepted but not yet started (progress at 0%). This adjustment can be made in the active missions menu.

When purchasing a field, it is also possible to make a one-time adjustment of the tramlines to match your own machines. This change takes effect immediately.
Later adjustments are still possible via the regular Precision Farming menu, but without immediate effect, but according to the usual handling of Precision Farming.

The mod also adds the console command "pfTramlineReset ", which resets the tramlines of a field. The field will then be completely covered with the current crop type again.
In addition, the console command "pfTramlineSet " from PrecisionFarming is unlocked for multiplayer, which can be used to set tramlines on a field.

351613.description:
The CRF 450R and CRF 450RX are the first off-road motorcycles offered to the public that feature a hydraulically operated clutch.
Its design is the same as that of MXGP competition bikes and the clutch lever is 10% lighter.
The driver also does not need to worry about adjusting the clutch cable, especially in longer events.
Light and compact engine, thanks to the single-lever cylinder head, electronic injection and programmable central ECU for different riding styles.

351741.title: GE10 Script - Placeable Importer (Prefab*)
351741.author: Aslan
351741.description:
Unlike the PlaceableToolkit by GIANTS, this script serves purely as a visualization aid during the map-building phase.
The typical workflow is as follows: First, place your placeables in-game and save the savegame. Then open the map in the GIANTS Editor and load the savegame „placeable.xml" via the script. All contained objects will be inserted into the map as placeholders.
The script loads automatically when opening the map in the GIANTS Editor and imports all placeables from the map's own „placeable.xml". Manual loading is therefore not required, unless you explicitly want to load the „placeable.xml" from a specific savegame.
As of version 2.0 it is also possible to reposition or copy/clone objects and write the updated positions back to the map's „placeable.xml" using the Save button.

INFO:
- Cloned placeables inherit all settings from the original placeable
- Repositioning or cloning stables with fences is error-prone – please place them as desired directly in-game
- Special placeables such as selling stations etc. must be added to the „placeable.xml" manually

Installation:
1.) Locate the installation path of the GIANTS Editor. Default: "C:\Users\[USER]\AppData\Local\GIANTS Editor 64bit 10.0.XX\scripts\"
2.) Copy the script „PlaceableImporter.lua" from the prefab into the scripts folder of the GIANTS Editor.
3.) The script will then be available in the GIANTS Editor via the menu bar under „Scripts".

-----------------------------
Changelog 2.0:
- Complete rework of UI and code
- All map placeables are now loaded automatically on startup via the GE
- All placeables are loaded using the 'excludeFromSave' flag (no manual deletion before saving required)
- Removed in-game script option as it was redundant
- Added option to select the folder containing extracted mods – allowing a separate folder per project
- Added placeable list
- Added jump functions
- Added DebugDraw to visually identify which placeable is placed where
- All placeables can be moved within the GE; the Save button writes the new positions back
- Copying/cloning existing placeables is now possible – the cloned placeable inherits all settings from the original
- Loading a different „placeable.xml" is now possible (e.g. directly from a savegame); it is converted on the fly and written to the map's „placeable.xml" via the Save button

Changelog 1.1:
- Fixed several path errors for alternative installation paths
- „placeable.xml" is now loaded automatically based on „modDesc.xml"
- Custom path for a „placeable.xml" now possible
- New options added – see the Info button for details

352670.title: Pallet Spawn Store
352670.author: FSG Modding - DaVaR
352670.description:
Pallet Spawn Store is a script mod that gives you full control over how each product leaves your productions. The game normally allows Store, Sell, or Distribute. This mod adds a new option and changes how Store works.

There are now four output modes you can cycle through for each product:
- Store (no pallets) – The product stays inside the production and no pallets are ever spawned. This keeps production areas clean and prevents unwanted pallet mess.
- Spawn – Works like the base game. Products are stored and pallets will spawn normally when enough product is available.
- Sell – Same as the base game. Products are automatically sold.
= Distribute – Same as the base game. Products are sent to other productions that can use them.

The output button in the production menu now cycles through: Store (no pallets), Spawn, Sell, and Distribute.

- Adds a scrollable list view to the object storage dialog
- Clearly displays all stored products
- Separates identical products with different fill levels
- Allows you to choose the exact quantity/version you want to spawn

This makes managing large storages much easier, especially on busy farms with mixed pallet and bale quantities.

However, AI traffic vehicles do not detect each other. Therefore, in rare cases, vehicles may try to drive through other vehicles.

352835.title: Neighbors On The Fields
352835.author: Huxinator
352835.description:
This mod spawns agricultural vehicles on foreign fields that perform field work there. This creates a more immersive experience on the map.

At the moment, neighbors can perform the following jobs: harvesting, fertilizing, sowing, mowing, tedding, cultivating, plowing, spraying, weeding, and hoeing.
Harvesters are not unloaded by support vehicles. The harvested crop simply disappears inside the harvester. Seeds, fertilizer, and similar consumables cost you nothing and are refilled automatically.

In the game settings, you can set the maximum number of neighbors that may work on fields at the same time. By default, the value is 0 (off). The more neighbors are active, the more performance your computer needs.

You can also choose whether neighbors are allowed to take existing contracts that you could also accept (creating competition), or whether they should generate their own contracts.

For the second mode, there is an additional option to adjust fields for contract generation. If all fields have been worked during the day (for example everything is already fertilized or sown), no new contracts may be generated. In that case, field states are adjusted so contracts become possible again.

MP: In multiplayer, the second farm that takes and runs these contracts is visible. It is best to leave that farm alone.

352943.title: FillType Conflict Resolver
352943.author: w33zl
352943.description:
A patch fixing the bug caused by two (or more) mods changing the same filltype, while the latter ones do not define explicit texture paths. Symptoms of this bug is errors in the log, textures looking like wheat (when it should be something else) or that some filltypes cannot be spawned as pallets.

Mods known to be affected by this bug is Additional Filltypes, Seasonal Prices and Coal Mine (but basically any mod altering filltypes might be affected by this issue). If you are using any mods adding or changing filltypes, this patch is highly recommended.

It is safe to add this to an existing savegame and can be removed at any time without implications. This mod just silently operates in the background adding a workaround to the bug until it is fixed permanently in the base game.

SYMPTOMS:
- Error in log, something similar to:
-- "Failed to open xml file 'C:/MODS/FS25_ZYX_SeasonalPrices_crossplay/data/objects/bigBag/pigFood/bigBag_pigFood.xml'"
-- "Unable to find vehicle storeitem for 'C:/MODS/FS25_ZYX_SeasonalPrices_crossplay/data/objects/bigBag/pigFood/bigBag_pigFood.xml'"
-- "Texture array layer 'C:/MODS/FS25_Coal_Factory/C:/MODS/FS25_AdditionalFilltypes/fillPlanes/coal_diffuse.png' couldn't be loaded."
- Unable to spawn pallets (e.g. using PowerTools)
- Custom filltype (e.g. coal) has wrong texture (either black, transparent or might look like wheat)

For more details, see https://github.com/w33zl/FS25_FillTypesPatch

352961.title: Restricted Periods
352961.author: ModdingAssociation - Tidde
352961.description:
This script implements realistic restricted periods for the application of organic fertilizers (slurry, digestate, manure), based on real-world fertilizer ordinances.
Turning on the implements is technically blocked during these periods.
Detailed Regulations:
Slurry & Digestate (Liquid):
Absolute Ban: November, December, January.
Conditional Ban: February, if the temperature is below 0°C (frost).

Manure (Solid):
Absolute Ban: December, January.

Functionality:
If the player attempts to turn on a slurry tanker or manure spreader during a restricted period, the action is blocked, and a warning message (e.g., "Restricted Period!" or "Ground Frost!") appears on the screen.

353530.author: Squallqt
353530.description:
Create, send, propose and track invoices between farms in multiplayer.

Ideal for contractor gameplay and structured MP servers, Invoices lets you bill other farms for fieldwork, transport, forestry, animal care and direct sales.

- Farm-to-farm invoicing with status tracking

Access via the dedicated tab in the InGame Menu (ESC).

353794.title: Gaúcho Fieds

353794.description:

The map features 69 farmlands (purchasable properties), divided into 58 agricultural fields, as well as 4 forest areas ideal for forestry and wood production.

-Collectibles spread across the entire map
-There are selling points where you can sell lime
Production & Economy
-5 production facilities

-A fully functional railway selling station, allowing goods to be transported to the city of Santa Maria – RS
-A dedicated bale selling point
-There are some rocks scattered around the map that can be broken with the help of a machine, allowing the area to be cleared and the land to be used more efficiently.
New Crops
The map introduces 3 new crops:
-Black beans
-Alfalfa
-Triticale
-In addition, the map includes a customized crop calendar, with special focus on the Brazilian second corn season (“Safrinha”), further enhancing the realism of regional agriculture.

Commerce & Details
-Imak Shop
-Pilzer Shop
-There are three forklifts on the map, one of them is at the shop, and a wheel loader at the quarry — all to assist with loading your products.
-Campos Gaúchos offers a complete farming experience, including crop farming, animal husbandry, production chains, forestry, and railway logistics — all set in an authentic southern Brazilian environment.Start your engines and write your own story in the heart of Rio Grande do Sul!

FEATURES:
- Change Vehicle Wear

- Toggle Vehicle Wetness
- Toggle Vehicle Damage
- Vehicle Dirt and Wetness combo button (single press toggles dirt on/off, long press toggles wetness on/off)
- Vehicle Wear and Damage combo button (single press toggles wear on/off, long press toggles damage on/off)

- Reload Vehicle (requires long press to avoid accidental reloads)
- Toggle Weather (will cycle through the different weather types for the current season, e.g. sun, cloudy, rain, hail and twister)

- Each hotkey have multiple modes (single tap, double tap, hold), e.g. a single press on the wear hotkey will increase the wear with 20%, while a long press increse in 10% incremenets, and double press will toggle between 100% and 0% wear


By default, all hotkeys are unassigned to prevent conflicts with other mods, but you can easily assign them to any key you want in the input bindings menu

Important! This mod is meant for testing and debugging purposes, and is not intended to be used in a regular playthrough. Always make sure to save your game before using the hotkeys, and use them with caution.

Note: In multiplayer, these functions can only be executed by the host.

354018.title: GE10 Script - SplineToolkit (Prefab*)
354018.author: Aslan
354018.description:
The SplineToolkit is a comprehensive GIANTS Editor script that brings a wide range of spline-related tools together in a single package. Nearly all functions include a real-time preview directly in the editor viewport.

--- Base Tools ---
The Base Tools form the foundation of the toolkit and provide essential tools for spline and terrain editing. Spline points can be projected directly onto the terrain, shifted vertically or horizontally, and the terrain height can be precisely matched to the spline. In addition, terrain textures and foliage can be painted along a spline, and Resample Spline allows the number of control points to be adjusted as needed.

--- Place Objects ---
Place Objects allows objects to be placed flexibly along a spline or distributed across a defined area. Placement can be done sequentially in the order of the SourceObjects or randomly from the available selection. A wide range of parameters such as distance, height type, rotation and offset provide precise control over the result.

--- Place Fence ---
Place Fence enables fast and structured creation of fence systems along a spline, with a clear list of base game fences including preview images. Fences can be imported directly, and animated gates can be positioned along the spline using a slider. The animation data is automatically written to the configuration file so that gates work correctly in-game via a trigger. A built-in XML viewer and the "Validate Fences" function allow full verification of all entries for errors and inconsistencies.

--- Export as .OBJ ---
The export tool allows splines to be exported as .OBJ files using two different methods, optimizing the workflow between GIANTS Editor and Blender. Additional parameters control the density and format of the exported points.

--- Generate Street ---
The road generator allows complete road meshes to be created directly inside the GIANTS Editor, including correct UVs and a selection of base game road textures. A real-time preview displays the result immediately in the viewport before the mesh is finalized. Matching traffic splines can optionally be generated automatically.

____________________________________________________
Installation:
1.) Navigate to the GIANTS Editor AppData path. Default: "C:\Users\[USER]\AppData\Local\GIANTS Editor 64bit 10.0.XX\scripts\"
2.) Copy the file "SplineToolkit.lua" and the folder "imgFence"/"imgRoads" from the prefab into the Script folder of the GIANTS Editor.
3.) The script will then be available in the GIANTS Editor via the menu bar under “Scripts”.

354130.title: Moisture System
354130.author: Ozz
354130.description:
Moisture System

Transform your farming experience with a sophisticated moisture and quality simulation system that brings realism and strategic depth to Farming Simulator 25. This comprehensive mod introduces dynamic moisture mechanics and crop quality tracking that fundamentally change how you approach crop management, harvest timing, and storage decisions.

Experience authentic environmental interactions where moisture levels fluctuate naturally across your farm based on terrain elevation, prevailing weather patterns (rainfall, snowfall, temperature fluctuations), and day/night cycles. Fields at lower elevations stay wetter while higher ground dries faster, so consider moisture levels when planning which crops to plant where and when to harvest. Every farming decision gains new weight as you balance optimal timing against changing conditions.

Advanced Crop Quality System: Each harvested load receives a quality rating (0-100) based on its moisture content at harvest. Quality determines your sell price and degrades over time when crops are stored above their ideal moisture level. Sell wet crops and you'll incur drying charges on top of reduced prices. Use the silo drying system to reduce moisture and halt quality loss before selling. Each crop species has unique optimal moisture windows and quality-to-price bands calibrated to real-world agricultural standards. Access quality tables, price grades, and seasonal moisture projections through the in-game menu (Shift+M).

Features:
- Regional weather simulation: choose a weather profile matching your region, with realistic seasonal patterns and yearly variation that directly impacts harvest timing and requires forward planning. See the guide on GitHub to create your own.
- Terrain-aware field moisture simulation driven by the active weather profile, with monthly variation patterns that reflect real regional climates
- Crop quality system: quality set at harvest, degrades hourly when stored above ideal moisture, drives sell price per crop-specific grade bands
- Silo drying: walk up to any silo and activate drying to reduce moisture over time. Costs scale with volume and are cheaper than selling wet.
- Drying charges at point of sale for crops above ideal moisture, shown as a separate finance entry
- Sophisticated grass management system featuring progressive tedding mechanics, weather-responsive drying rates, and automatic hay conversion at optimal moisture thresholds. Multiple tedding passes accelerates drying if you need it.
- Ground rot: Grass and straw piles left exposed accumulate rain exposure over time, triggering progressive volume loss as organic material deteriorates. Timing your collection and baling operations becomes critical. Hay will revert to grass if it gets too wet.
- Bale rotting: Unprotected bales track cumulative rain exposure with initial tolerance periods, escalating decay rates based on exposure history, and limited recovery during dry spells. Strategic use of wrapping and shelter infrastructure protects your investment.
- Purchase the moisture meter hand tool in the store for precise field and pile readings on demand (You can display this in the HUD if preferred).

Extensive customization options allow you to calibrate moisture dynamics, quality decay rates, drying speed, tedding efficiency, and decay parameters to match your preferred gameplay experience. Whether you seek hardcore realism or a gentler introduction to moisture management, the system adapts to your vision.

Note: The mod is not compatible with the following mods: NonStopCrop, RealisticWeather

Github: https://github.com/sprkem/FS25_MoistureSystem

354139.title: Multiple Silage Types
354139.author: Beustertal_Modding
354139.description:
Multiple Silage Types splits silage production into crop-specific variants and adds new harvest mechanics.

NEW FILL TYPES
- Grass Chaff – produced by the forage harvester from grass, field grass and alfalfa
- GPS Chaff – produced from grain windrows (whole crop silage route)
- Grass Silage – fermented from Grass Chaff in bunker silos or wrapped bales
- Whole Crop Silage (GPS) – fermented from GPS Chaff
- Grain Windrow – produced by mowing wheat, barley, oat, triticale, rye or sorghum in the last growth stage
- Vanilla maize chaff → silage path remains completely untouched

GPS HARVEST CHAIN
Wheat, barley, oat, triticale, rye and sorghum can be mowed in their final growth stage. The mower produces grain windrows which are then picked up by a forage harvester with pickup header and turned into GPS Chaff.

FORAGE WAGON – KNIFE FUNCTION
Forage wagons gain a toggleable knife mode. When the knives are extended, picked-up grass is chopped into Grass Chaff instead of being loaded as loose grass. The knives slightly reduce driving speed and increase power consumption, but provide a small yield bonus (doubled with silage additives). A HUD overlay shows the current knife state.

FORAGE WAGON – COMPRESSION
When a forage wagon is turned on (pickup active), material in the loading area is compressed. This increases the effective capacity by 60 %. A second fill bar on the HUD shows the compressed fill level.

BALER SUPPORT
Balers can produce Grass Chaff and GPS Chaff bales with unique textures. Wrapped bales ferment into the corresponding silage type. Grass silage and GPS silage bales are available as buyable objects in the shop.

FULL INTEGRATION
- Mixer wagons: all fermented types are accepted as silage ingredients for TMR
- Animal feeding: fermented types are injected into the appropriate food groups
- BGA / selling stations: all new types are accepted by biogas plants and selling points
- Fill type categories: new types inherit all relevant vanilla categories (CHAFF, SILAGE, WINDROW, SHOVEL, FORK, etc.)

COMPATIBILITY
- Works on every map – including mid-save installation
- Multiplayer compatible with full network synchronisation
- Vanilla maize silage chain is not modified

CHANGELOG v1.0.0.1
- Complete code rewrite: monolithic script (4300+ lines) split into 18 modular sub-modules
- New XML-based configuration (mstConfig.xml) – add new silage types without Lua changes
- Forage wagon: knife function to chop grass into Grass Chaff
- Forage wagon: compression change
- Forage wagon: HUD overlay for knife status and second fill bar for compression

354375.title: GE10 Script - Powerline Generator (Prefab*)
354375.author: Aslan
354375.description:
With this powerful GIANTS Editor script, a complete powerline network can be created in a short amount of time – from simple line segments to complex branches and crossings.

Power poles are connected via defined connection points in the Scenegraph, and the cables are automatically generated as meshes and properly organized within the project structure. The hierarchy remains clean and easy to manage at all times.

The generated powerlines use the official LS25 standard (including wind reaction), ensuring realistic in-game movement and seamless integration into existing maps.

A detailed, multilingual guide (DE / EN / PL / FR) is included directly within the tool.

Installation:
1.) Navigate to your GIANTS Editor installation directory. Default path: "C:\Program Files\GIANTS Software\GIANTS_Editor_10.X.X\"
2.) Copy the file "SplineToolkit.lua" and the folder "fenceImages" from the prefab into the GIANTS Editor script folder.
3.) The script will then be available in the GIANTS Editor via the menu bar under “Scripts”.

354625.description:
Welcome to the farmlands of rural northern Michigan. Here you will find rich soil, rolling hills and wide open fields. At the starter farm you will find all the equiptment needed to get you started.
The starter farm is setup as a beef cattle farm and has a small herd of Angus cattle roaming the pasture already. You start out with four fields, two of which will provide needed materials for your cattle. One is a hay field to produce food for your cattle.
There is also a field of wheat which you can produce straw from along with the ability to sell the grain for some income.
There are 70 farmlands available for purchase and 38 fields. There are 620 acres of farmable fields.
Aside from the starter farm there are three other buyable pre-built farms. One is a very basic small farm, the second is a small dairy farm and the third is a large dairy farm.
There is a forstry area at the north west corner of the map with a saw mill. There are also two supporting productions for forestry materials in the town area.

Bakery

354847.title: Double Strength
354847.author: TommyNookah
354847.description:
Enhance your player's physical capabilities or increase your immersion with dynamic carry-weight impact. DoubleStrength is a grounded, realistic alternative to traditional "Infinite Strength." mods. It allows you to increase your base lifting power from 1x up to 10x the standard limit, making logs, seed bags, and debris manageable without totally breaking your immersion.

DoubleStrength provides real physical feedback: the closer you are to your lifting limit, your movement speed is impacted accordingly. For added immersion, you can enable realism constraints that require you to brace yourself by crouching to handle the heaviest items. This mod is designed for players who want more forgiving limits, but who still want to feel the weight of their labor.

Features:
• Adjustable Strength: Set your base lifting limit from 1x to 10x via the in-game settings.
• Dynamic Weight Logic: Optional movement speed scaling that slows you down when carrying heavy loads.
• Realism options: Optional requirement to crouch when picking up heavy objects.
• Seamless Integration: No hotkeys required; the mod integrates naturally with standard gameplay for a more immersive experience.

355320.title: Automatic Tramline System
355320.author: Fabian
355320.description:
Tramline Automation for FS25
This is my first script mod for FS25. Since the tramlines from Precision Farming did not always convince me. It automatically integrates into all implements that can be used as seeders.
The HUD can be controlled with the mouse, which can be activated via an assigned key.

Set Tramline Distance:
Here you set the working width of the sprayer or fertilizer spreader.
This can either be adjusted using two assigned keys or by clicking the plus and minus buttons with the mouse.

Rhythm:
Here you can see the number of passes required for one working width of the sprayer or fertilizer spreader.
In Semiautomatic mode, the current pass can be adjusted with + and – if necessary.
I refer here to the help pages now available in the game in the ESC menu.
The half pass should only be done on the second pass.
If you are using GPS and a half pass is required, it should look like this:
First pass normal. Starting from the second pass, set an offset of half the working width in the GPS menu. See the description further below under GPS Offset Mode.

Mode:
The active working mode of the tramline automation can be changed either via an assigned key or with the mouse by clicking on the selected mode.
Pause:
No tramlines will be created.
The counter is paused.

Always:
Tramlines are always active when the implement is lowered.

GPS:
Automatic track detection via GIANTS Steering Assist.
At the beginning, a reference track must be set. This can be done using an assigned key.

Semiautomatic:
Counting is done by raising/lowering the implement.
The symbol behind it indicates whether a tramline is currently being created or not.

Enhanced Vehicle GPS: Automatic Lane Detection
Via the Enhanced Vehicle GPS, this mode is only available when an Enhanced Vehicle GPS course is active.
The current pass can be adjusted using the plus and minus buttons if it does not match.

Courseplay: This mode is only available if Courseplay is installed.
Please read the help page for this!

GPS Offset:
Requirement: GPS mode
Since with an even rhythm number you must work with half the working width on the first pass, you can set the offset so the track does not start jumping.
This value can either be adjusted via an assigned key or with the mouse using the + and – buttons next to the rhythm.
In GPS mode, these buttons are repurposed to increase or decrease the GPS offset.

Track Width:
Here you can see the configured tramline track width.
This can be adjusted with two assigned keys or by clicking the plus and minus buttons with the mouse to match the track width of the crop care tractor, because smaller tractors have a narrower track width than larger tractors.

Buttons:
Tramline distance +/-: Increase or decrease the tramline distance
CURSOR ON/OFF: Show or hide the mouse pointer
Tramline Mode switch: Switch the tramline mode
GPS reference Lane set: Sets the GPS reference track
reference -½ lane or reference +½ lane: Move the GPS reference track half the working width to the right or left
Track width +/-: Adjusts the track width from 1m to 6m

Changelog 1.1.0.0:

Fixed a HUD bug where the HUD was displayed for everyone on a dedicated server even though only one person was in the seeder
Fixed a bug where the HUD wasn't always displayed when too many keys were in the F1 menu.

355514.title: Radio Enhancements
355514.author: TRIDENTE
355514.description:
Radio Enhancements

This script adds some useful enhancements to the in-game radio.

1. You can now change the radio volume in vehicles at any time without opening the menu.
Default keys:
- Left Shift + 4 quieter
- Left Shift + 6 louder

The keys can be changed in the menu settings.

2. The current radio volume is shown for a short time in the F1 menu and then disappears again.

3. If you leave a vehicle while a radio station is switched on, you can continue to hear the radio up to a certain distance.
- after leaving the vehicle, the volume is reduced to 20% of the current value (can be changed)
- if you move away from the vehicle, the music becomes quieter and quieter (maximum distance can be changed)
- if you move closer again, the volume slowly increases again
- the radio must be switched off manually in the vehicle to disable this function
- the radio state (on/off) is saved individually for each vehicle
- helpers switch the radio on by default - you can hear it when driving past :) (helper radio can be disabled / changed)
- a RadioEnhancements.xml file is created in the modSettings folder where you can change values

4. Multiplayer
- the script synchronizes the radio state (on/off) and the volume of your multiplayer vehicles
- if another player drives past you with the radio switched on, you will hear it too
- internet radio streams are synchronized with your multiplayer partners if you have also set them globally on your side

5. Partybox (Changelog 1.2.0.0)
- you can buy a portable speaker in the shop under Miscellaneous > Miscellaneous
- this Partybox can be carried anywhere and, if desired, continuously plays your radio stations / music everywhere
- to use it, simply "enter" the speaker and check the F1 menu
- the Partybox has its own volume control, independent of everything else
- animated party lights of the speaker can be enabled in the F1 menu and are multiplayer compatible


Changelog 1.3.0.0

355698.title: Shop Mod Labels - New And Updated
355698.author: JonoChromatic
355698.description:
Displays a coloured ribbon label on shop item tiles to help you keep track of what is new or updated in your mod collection.

GENERAL SETTINGS
A dedicated section is added to the General Settings menu with two options:

- Label Position: A stepper control (◄ value ►) lets you fine-tune the vertical position of the labels on shop tiles. The starting position is automatically chosen based on your screen resolution — standard 16:9, widescreen, and ultrawide 21:9 displays are all detected at startup.

- Reset All Labels: Clears the history of all seen and updated mods, so every item in the shop will show as NEW again. Useful after a fresh start or a large mod list change.

Settings are saved and persist between play sessions.

355722.title: Compass Heading Display
355722.author: RocklandUSA Gaming
355722.description:
Compass Heading Display adds a smooth, scrolling horizontal compass bar to the top of your screen, now with a full in-game settings menu, a heading lock with an optional steering and walking lock, wild boar alerts for the GIANTS Vredo Pack DLC, and a dispatch marker for the GIANTS Emergency Pack DLC.

COMPASS
A full 16-point compass rose with tick marks every 10 degrees and a gold centre indicator showing your live numeric heading. Waypoint tracking with distance, tornado tracking with a flashing red marker, multiplayer player tracking with farm colours, and AI helper tracking with blocked-helper alerts. Filter players and helpers by farm.

IN-GAME SETTINGS MENU (default F6)
Configure everything without editing files, across four tabs: Display (bar position, width, field of view, background opacity), Compass (labels, tick marks, centre indicator, degree readout), Markers, and Colours (per-marker colour presets). A DEFAULTS button restores the original settings, and everything still saves to settings.xml.

HEADING LOCK (default the [ key)
Pin your current bearing on the compass with a live steer-correction cue and an on-line indicator, ideal for driving dead-straight passes or hand-working fields on foot. Turn on the optional Steering / Walk Lock to hold your line automatically: while locked, your vehicle drives straight and, uniquely, on foot with hand tools you keep walking dead-straight too, not just in vehicles. A thin guidance line runs along the ground ahead of you so you can see the exact row you are holding. Toggle it off any time.

WILD BOAR ALERTS (VREDO PACK DLC)
Wild boar come with the official GIANTS Vredo Pack DLC, and they can trample and ruin your crops. If you own that DLC, the compass adds a flashing marker whenever a boar herd wanders onto land your own farm owns, pointing straight to it so you can track it down and clear it before it damages the field. The alert only ever covers fields your own farm owns.

EMERGENCY PACK DLC
If you own the official GIANTS Emergency Pack DLC, the compass adds a flashing emergency marker that points to your active dispatch, so you always know which way the call is, on foot or in any vehicle.

All keybinds are rebindable in Options > Controls. Works in singleplayer and multiplayer. No performance impact. No dependencies required (the Emergency Pack marker appears only if you own that DLC).

For a link to our latest release, Help page and GitHub page where you can find more information, help, and report issues please visit our Compass Heading Website or go directly to our GitHub page.

Many thanks to our translators and to our community for reporting bugs, giving us feedback and great ideas.

Changelog v1.1.1.0:
- Added a shared settings hub: when two or more RocklandUSA Gaming mods are installed, F6 opens a mod list and you choose which one to configure. With only Compass Heading installed, F6 opens the compass settings directly, exactly as before.
- Compass Heading stands aside on F6 when the hub owns the key, so one press can never open two windows.
- The Heading Lock is unchanged. The [ key still works and its entry in Options - Controls is still registered.

355838.title: Krebach
355838.author: Jogi
355838.description:
Welcome to Krebach.

Krebach is already known from previous LS titles by RitchiF. In order to carry on his legacy in this LS as well, it was once again my pleasure to rebuild the map in its familiar core and expand it with many new gameplay elements and areas.
This means that the map has now been fully expanded in size, while the original core of the map has been preserved. We made to the core were adjustments to add more “life.” Parts of the side roads were expanded to create more variety in AI traffic, and a railway line has now also found its place on the map.

The map has been relocated back to its roots in the northern areas; however, Krebach is and remains a purely fictional and creatively designed map. It is meant to offer you cozy after-work gaming hours in which every player can feel comfortable.

What the map offers:

Basically, the map is built on the Weekend Farmers map base and therefore includes, among other things, multi-fruit crops. Suitable drive-through silos for these multi-fruit crops can be found in the shop.

356068.description:
Lipp tower silos became widespread in southern Germany during the 1970s and 80s and are still a common sight today. Each silo is still constructed on-site using Lipp's double-seam technology, with 400mm wide stainless steel strip spirally wound upwards and the seams folded. This unique manufacturing process allows for cost-effective and rapid assembly, as well as a long service life. The recreated silo has a capacity of 160m³ and is filled using a Claas forage chopper. The blower can be set up and removed from under the pipe with a mouse click. Silage is removed from the silo manually or with a milling machine, and the finished silage can be collected from under the discharge chute using a shovel, trailer, or conveyor belt.

Features:
- Twice-yearly shearing (April and October)

- Configurable shearing cost per sheep (default $5)
- All notifications individually toggleable in the Settings menu

356407.title: Fair Leasing Plus
356407.author: Tarabas1977
356407.description:
Fair Leasing Plus allows you to reduce leasing costs by up to 50%.

Base price, daily costs and hourly costs can be adjusted directly in the in-game settings menu so every farm can decide how expensive leasing should really be.

But there is more.

Fair Leasing Plus also introduces a reward system for returning leased vehicles in good condition.

If vehicles are returned clean and with a full tank (or battery), your farm earns points.
Those points unlock ranks which grant additional permanent leasing discounts.

Ranks:
IRON → BRONZE → SILVER → GOLD → PLATINUM → DIAMOND

The better you treat leased machines, the better the long-term leasing conditions become.

Features:
• Adjustable leasing cost reduction up to 50%
• Reward system for clean and well maintained returns
• Rank progression with permanent leasing discounts
• Statistics window showing your progress
• Multiplayer compatible

Hotkey:
Right Ctrl + L → Opens the Fair Leasing Plus statistics window

Perfect for players who prefer to treat leased machines properly instead of returning them like rental cars after a demolition derby.

356490.title: GE10 Script - Traffic Manager (Prefab*)
356490.author: Aslan
356490.description:
Traffic Manager

This comprehensive script for the GIANTS Editor 10 allows you to create, manage and debug complete traffic and pedestrian systems directly inside the editor. The Traffic Manager provides a wide range of tools for quickly setting up traffic splines, pedestrian paths and static characters, while also offering full control over all related XML data.

The tool enables you to convert splines into traffic or pedestrian splines and automatically assign required attributes such as speed, density and group settings. Existing systems can be loaded, extended and fully edited, including group management, time schedules, conditions (e.g. seasons, weather) and sound configurations.

A strong focus is placed on pedestrian management:
Groups can be created, modified and removed. Pedestrians can be assigned to these groups individually or globally. In addition, static humans can be placed directly in the editor, organized within groups and visually debugged. The tool also supports moving entities between groups as well as automatic renaming and scene cleanup.

For maximum clarity, the script includes extensive debug visualization directly in the viewport:
Traffic splines, pedestrian paths, static humans, directions and bounding boxes are rendered in real time. This makes it easy to identify issues and understand system behavior without leaving the editor.

This tool is designed for both beginners and advanced modders and significantly speeds up the creation of complex, lively maps.
____________________________________________________

Installation:
1. Navigate to the installation directory of the GIANTS Editor (e.g. "C:\Program Files\GIANTS Software\GIANTS_Editor_10.X.X\").
2. Copy the file "TrafficManager.lua" and the folder "imgTrafficVehicles" from the prefab into the GIANTS Editor script folder.
3. Restart the GIANTS Editor. The script will then be available via the menu bar under "Scripts".

356527.title: Crop Destruction Overhaul
356527.author: TommyNookah
356527.description:
Crop Destruction Overhaul

Take control of your impact on the field with a completely redesigned crop destruction system. This mod replaces the binary "On/Off" setting with a dynamic, physics-based approach that rewards precision and careful operation.

Key Features:

Crop damage is no longer binary or guaranteed. Instead of a single cutoff speed, the mod uses a 15-tier probability curve that increases gradually as you accelerate. At true creeping speeds, crops remain untouched. As your speed rises, the chance of destruction ramps up smoothly, making high-speed turns or transit through fields a calculated risk.

Footprint Matters: Destruction is calculated based on the actual physical contact area of your tires. Standard tires have a larger footprint and cause more damage, while narrower tires naturally minimize your impact.

Changelog 1.1.0.0:
- More detailed 15-tier non-linear destruction model
- More natural & detailed damage patterns
- Expanded localization
- Vanilla crop destruction setting integration (off = off)

356540.title: Through The Years
356540.author: Thalley
356540.description:
Are you yearning for the days of old? Looking for an extra challenge? Wanting to play a bit different than you've done before? Want to play with machines that you've typically never done before?

Through the Years will take you and your friends through the years, unlocking newer and more powerful machinery each year as you progress.

With heavy customization for your specific wants, this mod will restrict your buying options to the vehicles available at the time of your game. With a starting year as low as 1950, you can work your way from tractors with less than 50 horsepower and plows with 2 furrows, to the new and powerful machinery of the modern agricultural world.

This mods adds a completely new layer of progression as you know from so many other simulation games, and you will get to play with machines that you've probably never tried before.

The absolutely majority of the basegame vehicles are very modern, so this mod works best with the use of other mods. Which mods to use it completely up to you, but at https://gitlab.com/thalley/fs25_vehicle_years/-/releases you will find a curated selection of vehicle bundles to help you getting the highest rated mods from a specific decade.

The mod is heavily configurable, to provide the best gameplay experience for you.

Please report any issues or post any suggestion for the mod at https://gitlab.com/thalley/fs25_through_the_years.

357191.title: Farmland Auctions
357191.author: SimuTools
357191.description:
This mod adds regular farmland auctions.

On auctioned land, bids can be placed directly on the field using the B key. Each new bid increases the current auction price and offers an alternative way to purchase land.

Depending on the mod settings, NPC bidders can be enabled or disabled. It is also possible to restrict farmland purchases so that land can only be bought through auctions while a standard purchase is blocked.

In multiplayer, farms can bid against each other.

Available console commands:
- faStartNow -> starts the next auction immediately
- faStartAuction -> starts an auction manually for a specific farmland
- faEndNow -> ends the current auction immediately
- faCancelAuction -> cancels the current or scheduled auction
- faSetAuctionTime -> sets the minimum and maximum auction duration
- faSetStartInterval sets the minimum and maximum times for when the next auction starts

--Changes 1.0.0.1--
- Fixed multiplayer issues
- Fixed timing issue

357308.title: Headtracking MouseControl For IC
357308.author: DerElky
357308.description:
Adds a mouse cursor in vehicles to make it easier to click Interactive Control (IC) buttons and switches.

Requirements
- Works only when head tracking is enabled in the game and the Device is active.
- The cursor is tied to IC (only on the current vehicle with IC enabled).

Modes / Behavior
- IC active: the cursor is shown automatically whenever IC is active.
- IC active + manual: the cursor is shown automatically while IC is active; it can also be hidden/shown via Toggle.
- Manual: the cursor is shown only via key input (Toggle or Hold).
- Never: the cursor is disabled.

Controls
- Toggle (Standard Insert): show/hide the cursor.
- Hold (Standard Delete): show the cursor only while the key is held (Manual mode only).

Settings
- Mode can be changed in the in-game settings menu.
- Toggle/Hold key bindings can be changed in the game’s controls menu.

357319.title: CarboLime Prefab (Prefab*)
357319.author: [BG] Lahmi
357319.description:
This prefab extends your own Farming Simulator 25 mod map with a complete lime fertilization system featuring two variants: classic lime and CarboLime from sugar production.

CarboLime is a real agricultural by-product of sugar beet processing. It works faster than standard lime, contains valuable additional nutrients (phosphate, magnesium) and is significantly cheaper – because it is produced as a waste product.

WHAT IS INCLUDED?

Vehicles & Objects:
- Bredal K105 lime spreader with native support for lime AND CarboLime (12m / 18m spread width)
- Streumaster FW 212 TD PROFI with its own CarboLime particle effect (like K105)
- Šálek RZK 300H, Amazone ZA-TS 3200 and Amazone ZG-TS 10001 additionally with lime and CarboLime support
- CarboLime BigBag (2000 L) – purchasable in the shop
- CarboLime Pallet (2000 L) – purchasable in the shop
- Multi-purchase of up to 8 units at once

Map & Technical:
- Custom ground texture after spreading (visible difference to standard lime)
- Custom spreading particle effect (beige/earthy instead of white)
- Custom FillPlane texture in the spreader tank
- CarboLime correctly removes the lime requirement
- Standard lime correctly overwrites CarboLime fields

REALISTIC VALUES:
- CarboLime: ~$270 / 2000 L (40% cheaper than lime – by-product)
- Spreading amount: 1.5x higher than standard lime
- Bulk density: 1.2 kg/L

FOR MAP BUILDERS:
Complete step-by-step guide included (PDF). All XML entries, paths and configuration are documented. Every fertilizer and manure spreader in the game (base game and all active mods) gets lime and CarboLime support automatically – no vehicle needs to be registered individually or shipped as an i3d file any more. Individual spreaders can be excluded on demand via carboLimeSpreaders.xml – without touching the Lua files.

IMPORTANT NOTICE:
carboLime.lua may be freely published and distributed in its unmodified form. However, any modified or derivative version may only be published with the explicit written consent of the author.

https://github.com/Lahmi/FS25_Carbolime_Mod

357480.title: Iron Depreciation
357480.author: Antler22
357480.description:
IRON DEPRECIATION
Realistic Farm Equipment Resale Values for FS25

Iron Depreciation introduces an alternative vehicle value system built on real agricultural economics data from the USDA, Iowa State Extension Service, and Machinery Pete auction records. If you prefer resale values that more closely follow documented real-world depreciation curves, this mod provides that experience.


HOW IT WORKS

Age Depreciation uses the declining-balance method - the same standard used by farm accountants and the IRS for agricultural assets. This produces a steep early drop that slows significantly with each passing year. A tractor does not lose the same dollar amount in year 8 as it did in year 1. A first-year penalty is also included, modeled on real trade-in data, because new iron typically loses a disproportionate chunk of value the moment it enters service.

Hours Depreciation is calculated independently from age and is calibrated to realistic useful-life hour targets per equipment category. A combine at 5,000 hours is a different machine than one at 1,500. Powered machines receive a steeper hours-penalty curve than unpowered implements, reflecting real engine wear economics. The two factors combine cleanly - a low-hour older machine retains more value than a high-hour one of the same age, exactly as it would in the real market.


DEPRECIATION RATES
Approximate value retained at 10 years:

Tractors ................. 10% annual — ~35% retained at 10 yr
Combine harvesters ....... 13% annual — ~25% retained at 10 yr
Self-propelled sprayers .. 12% annual — ~28% retained at 10 yr
Balers ................... 11% annual — ~31% retained at 10 yr
Tillage tools ............ 8% annual — ~43% retained at 10 yr
Grain and crop trailers .. 7% annual — ~48% retained at 10 yr
Forestry machines ........ 12% annual — ~28% retained at 10 yr
Cars and utility vehicles 12% annual — ~28% retained at 10 yr
Trains ................... 7% annual — ~48% retained at 10 yr
Pallets and consumables .. no depreciation applied


REPAINT COSTS

This mod adjusts repaint costs to align with real-world professional paint work. A real professional full repaint on a large tractor costs $5,000-8,000 USD - roughly 2-3% of purchase price. Iron Depreciation caps repaint costs at 4% of vehicle price at maximum wear, scaled linearly with paint condition. A heavily worn $300,000 tractor costs around $12,000 to repaint under this system.

Note: this mod only replaces the repaint price formula. The repair price formula is untouched, preserving full compatibility with dedicated repair mods.


VEHICLE COVERAGE

All 120+ official FS25 vehicle types are explicitly mapped to their correct depreciation group with no guessing or substring matching. Mod vehicles with unrecognised types fall back to a sensible generic implement rate and are flagged in debug mode.


MINIMUM SELL PRICE

No vehicle can sell for less than 5% of its new price. Scrap metal and parts always have value.


TECHNICAL NOTES

This mod fully replaces the base game sell price and repaint formulas. At very high operating hours, the base game formula can produce unexpectedly low sell prices caught by the built-in price floor - this mod avoids that situation through a different calculation approach.

The base game applies its hours-based penalty differently across powered and unpowered equipment. This mod uses the reverse relationship, applying a steeper penalty to motorised machines to better reflect engine wear economics.

The repaint cost system in this mod is calibrated to real-world professional rates, resulting in significantly lower repaint costs than the base game at high wear levels.

Data sources: USDA-NASS, Iowa State Extension Service, Machinery Pete auction records.
