357739.title: Multiplayer Money Pause Mod Server Side
357739.author: Poofyswine
357739.description:
Running a multiplayer farm with friends is great - until time keeps ticking while you're offline and your bank account takes the hit.

If you've ever logged back in to find your balance drained because others kept playing or fast-forwarded time, this mod solves that problem while keeping things fair and consistent.

The Multiplayer Money Pause Mod allows all players on the server to save their farm balance before leaving and restore it when they return - all handled server-side for proper multiplayer support. It helps maintain realism by effectively pausing your farm’s money while you're away.

Player Controls:
CTRL + ALT + 9 → Save your current balance and set it to $0
CTRL + ALT + 0 → Restore your saved balance

How it works:
- Supports saving and restoring both positive and negative balances
- Balances are stored per savegame slot (savegame1 through savegame20)
- Once saved, the server keeps your balance locked at $0 to prevent changes while you're offline

Server Admin Console Commands:
moneyToolWipeSave savegame0 → Clears saved balances for a specific save slot
Example: moneyToolWipeSave savegame10 will only clear saved money for that save. You can specify any savegame from 1–20.

moneyToolWipeSave all → Clears all saved balances across every savegame slot on your server

Important:
- This is a multiplayer-only mod; singleplayer does not require these features
- All data is stored server-side, not on individual player machines
- Each savegame slot maintains its own independent saved balances for each farm

Ideal for dedicated servers — keeping things fair when the farm never sleeps.

Welcome to THE MECHET!

In the heart of the Morvan, in Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, The Mechet invites you to discover authentic farming in a landscape shaped by time and the work of generations.

Here, the land is alive!

The fields are not vast open expanses, but plots bordered by hedgerows, rows of trees, stone walls and traditional fences. Rivers and streams naturally shape the terrain and structure the landscape.
Each plot has its own character, and every path leads to a new opportunity.

You will find:

• 2 faithfully modelled villages, with an imposing church, a market square, a school, a post office, a castle and many shops.
• A rich hydrographic network made up of numerous streams, rivers, lakes, ponds, as well as a working mill.
• New grass foliage specially developed for this map.
• Extensive work on the colours of trees and vegetation to deliver realistic and immersive seasons.
• Farm tracks created from 3D scans for maximum realism.
• 4 farmsteads with varied atmospheres: sheep, cattle, viticulture and snail farming, including 4 barns, an animated milking parlour and a Stepa grab for the sheepfold.
• 136 fields and 179 purchasable plots.
• 3 agricultural cooperatives (two for cereals and one for root crops), also serving as purchase points for materials such as lime and fertiliser.
• A sawmill featuring 4 types of production: wood, firewood, planks and timber frames.
• A cannery where you can sell your vegetables or produce authentic recipes.
• Many small shops, such as a bakery, a dairy and a market, to add value to your farm products.
• New productions, including snails and their recipes, as well as local cow’s and sheep’s cheeses.
• Expanded farming systems, such as a 3-step grape juice production chain.
• New crops: silage maize, rye, vetch-rye, green rye, triticale, spelt, cover crop, field grass, alfalfa, clover, spring and winter wheat, spring and winter barley.
• Exclusive mechanics, with the arrival of compost and a dedicated shredder for processing it at the BGA.
• Advanced realism, with wind-animated power lines, overflowing gutters in the rain, waterlogged field entrances, Christmas decorations in the village, straw trails, leaves on the ground, and much more.
• New growth stages for many crops, offering smoother visual transitions.
• 4 new cattle breeds: Charolais, Simmental, Vosgienne and Montbéliarde. Each has its own characteristics to refresh the gameplay. It is up to you to choose the one that best fits your farm.
• The possibility to use the GAB (Groupement Agricole du Bocage), a kind of machinery-sharing cooperative allowing you to share your vehicles.
• A municipal water tower and retention basins.
• A railway export warehouse for your goods.
• A brand-new locomotive, specially modelled for The Mechet.
• The Bricodin, a DIY and gardening store where you can sell or buy essential products.
• A shop to build, allowing you to sell your farm products at a better price.
• A brand-new John Deere dealership.
• A large BGA with several silos and a composting area equipped with covered silos.
• A secret quest, as usual!

Finally, a custom help menu will allow you to understand all the map’s new features.

Le Méchet is not a map to rush through, but a territory to explore, develop and master according to your own vision.
Take the time to discover everything it has to offer!

358213.title: GE10 Script - TreeGenerator (Prefab*)
358213.author: Zyran
358213.description:
With this practical script for the GIANTS Editor 10, a complete forest can be automatically created. The Random Tree Generator offers a simple way to randomly place trees from an existing pool within a defined area – considering minimum distances, terrain alignment, and random rotation.

The tool allows any area (treeArea) to be defined as a forest area and automatically filled with trees from a treePool. Density, minimum distance, height alignment, and rotation can be individually adjusted.

A special focus is on user-friendliness:
- Easy configuration via a graphical user interface
- Real-time progress display during generation
- All trees are automatically grouped together (autoForest_X)
- Clear status messages and error notifications

For maximum control, the script offers numerous configuration options:

Density (trees/m²):
Determines how many trees are generated per square meter. Higher values create denser forests.

Minimum Distance (m):
Defines the minimum distance between two trees. Prevents overlaps and ensures natural distribution.

Max Attempts per Tree:
Specifies how many times the script tries to find a suitable spot for a tree. Higher values increase the success rate in dense forests.

Random Rotation:
Activates random rotation of each tree around its own axis. Provides more variety.

Align to Terrain:
Automatically adjusts the height of each tree to the terrain surface. Prevents floating or buried trees.

Height Offset (m):
Vertically shifts the trees. Positive values raise them, negative values lower them.

The tool is aimed at both beginners and experienced modders and significantly speeds up the creation of forests and woodland areas on custom maps.

____________________________________________________

Installation:

1.) Navigate to the installation directory of the GIANTS Editor.
Default: "C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\GIANTS Editor 64bit 10.0.11+"

2.) Copy the file "TreeGenerator.lua" into the scripts folder of the GIANTS Editor.
"C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\GIANTS Editor 64bit 10.0.11+\scripts\"

3.) The script is then available in the GIANTS Editor via the menu bar under "Scripts".

____________________________________________________

Scene Preparation:

Before you can use the script, your scene must have the following structure:

Root
├── terrain
├── treeArea (TransformGroup with cubes or other objects)
├── point1
├── point2
├── point3
└── point4 ...
└── treePool (TransformGroup with tree models)
├── treeOak01
├── treeSpruce01
├── treeBirch01
└── ...

The treeArea defines the area in which trees are generated. Each child of this group represents a corner point of the polygon. At least three points are required.

The treePool contains the template trees from which random selection is made. The more different trees, the more varied the forest will be.

____________________________________________________

Troubleshooting:

"treeArea not found!"
> The TransformGroup "treeArea" does not exist in the scene.

"treePool not found!"
> The TransformGroup "treePool" does not exist in the scene.

"No trees in treePool!"
> The treePool contains no tree models.

"treeArea needs at least 3 points!"
> The treeArea contains fewer than 3 points.

"No trees generated!"
> The area is too small or the density is too low.

358448.title: Unload Bale Wrap
358448.author: Kijbev
358448.description:
Some farmers use different wrap colors to keep their forage types organized in storage. To switch colors, they simply unload the old rolls, load new ones, and start wrapping. In FS25, you can't unload old rolls. When you load a new color, it only fills the empty slots, so the wrapper works through the remaining old-color rolls first, leaving you with mixed-color bales. This mod adds that missing step: unload the old wrap with a single key combo and start baling with the color you actually wanted.

FEATURES:
- Unloads all wrap film (storage rolls and spindle rolls) with a single key combo
- Refreshes the HUD fill levels and 3D visuals correctly
- Leaves twine, net wrap and silage additive completely untouched
- Restores spindle visuals automatically when fresh wrap film is loaded
- Works on integrated baler-wrappers and standalone wrappers

COMPATIBLE WITH:
Integrated baler-wrappers: Goeweil G-1 F125 Kombi, Goeweil Vario Master, John Deere C441R, Massey Ferguson Baler 4160V, Fendt Rotana 160 V Combi.
Standalone wrappers: KUHN SW 4014, Goeweil G5020, Goeweil G4010 Q Profi, Goeweil G1015, Anderson Group Hybrid X.
Should work on any machine that uses BALE_WRAP consumables.

Unloading refunds the same per-liter price you paid when you reloaded that wrap, so swapping colors is cost-neutral: dump the old, buy a fresh pallet in your new color.

Default key: Right Ctrl + U (rebind in game settings to your preference).

Changelog v1.0.2.0:
- Fixed: load-confirmation message no longer fires for wrappers not owned by your farm. Fixes the false-positive on map load when a dealer-yard wrapper is pre-loaded with wrap (most visible on maps where the player spawns near a dealership). Also blocks the same message from surfacing for other farms' wrappers in multiplayer.

Changelog v1.0.1.0:
- Fixed: keybind unresponsive on integrated mod baler-wrappers
- Added: cash refund when unloading wrap film, matches the per-liter price the game charges on reload
- Added: in-game settings panel (confirm before unloading, on-screen message position/size/color)
- Added: French locale, color-switch hint, in-vehicle keybind prompt
- Added: load confirmation message — when loading wrap film into an empty wrapper, an on-screen "Loaded with " message tells you exactly what was loaded

This mod may only be hosted on the official GIANTS ModHub. Redistribution on other websites is not permitted without the author's written consent.

358677.title: License Plate Randomizer
358677.author: Kijbev
358677.description:
Every vehicle you buy in Farming Simulator 25 rolls off the lot with the same default license plate. Buy three tractors, two trailers, and a harvester, and they all share an identical plate. This mod fixes that by automatically generating a realistic, region-appropriate plate when you open any vehicle in the shop. The plate you see is the plate you get when you hit "Buy." Prefer a specific plate on a certain vehicle? Just customize it in the shop before you buy and the mod keeps your plate instead of randomizing. Leave a plate untouched and it is randomized as usual. You can also change it later at a repair shop.

FEATURES:
- Generates unique, realistic plates based on real-world formats for the map's country
- Applies to both the 3D shop preview and the plate widget
- Edit or customize a plate before you buy if you prefer a non-randomized one for a specific vehicle; untouched plates are still randomized
- Detects the map's country automatically, no configuration needed
- Green agricultural plates on German maps (tractors get green, cars and trucks get black)
- Uses the map's regional prefix automatically (e.g. "EF" for Erfurt, "ZLK" for Zielonka)
- Regional prefixes can be changed manually in plateConfig.xml
- Plates persist across sessions and multiplayer

DUPLICATE PLATE FINDER (Right Ctrl + Period):
Already have a fleet of vehicles with identical default plates? When you load a savegame, the mod automatically scans your farm and notifies you if any vehicles share the same plate. Press Right Ctrl + Period anywhere in the game to open the Duplicate Plate Finder. It lets you randomize them one by one or all at once.

SUPPORTED COUNTRIES (21):
Germany, France, Italy, Poland, Austria, the Netherlands, United Kingdom, Northern Ireland, Luxembourg, Czech Republic, Romania, Hungary, Slovakia, Spain, Sweden, Denmark, Switzerland, Belgium, Finland, Norway, Ireland.
On maps not recognized as one of these (e.g. US or Asian maps), the mod stays inactive.

PLEASE NOTE:
This mod controls the plate text (characters, format, regional accuracy). The plate's visual appearance (background color, font, euroband) is determined by the map maker's license plate template. If a map uses the correct template for its country, everything matches perfectly. If a map reuses a template from another country, you may see correct text on a mismatched background. This is a map-side limitation that no script mod can fix. For map makers, license plate prefab packs for many European countries are available on ModHub. This also applies to Germany's green agricultural plates. A German map's plate template may define only black text, or both black and green. On German maps without a green color defined, agricultural vehicles will show black text like regular plates.

Changelog v1.0.2.0:
- Added: edit or customize a plate in the shop before buying a vehicle or trailer, and the mod keeps your choice instead of randomizing. Untouched plates are still randomized as usual.

Changelog v1.0.1.0:
- Compatibility update for FS25 1.19.

This mod may only be hosted on the official GIANTS ModHub. Redistribution on other websites is not permitted without the author's written consent.

358719.title: The Shoreline Of Lake Michigan
358719.author: Papes_Farming_Mods
358719.description:
Welcome to The Shoreline Of Lake Michigan. This fictional map is roughly based off the north west tip of the lower penninsula of Michigan. Here you will find the farming a little challenging. With sandy soil close to the lake and the extreme weather this location will test your farming skills.
If the farming gets too tough or the weather gets the best of you there is always the option to shift into some forestry. Here you will find vast forests to the north suitable for forestry. This is a bit of a challenge as well due to the steep terrain.
The amazing scenery of the shoreline of lake Michigan makes up for the difficult environment. This map has tons of new and unique features. There are many different options for farming including dairy farming, traditional crop farming, fruit orchards,
greenhouses and even a bee garden to harvest honey from. There are a total of 43 fields and 113 farmlands that can be purchased.

There are five prebuilt farms that can be bought. The main farm is setup for crop farming along with a small sheep barn and chicken coop. The main farm comes with a preplanted alfalfa field to provide food for the sheep. Three other farms are dairy farms all differing in size with one that has a seperate pasture with water buffalo.
The last prebuilt farm is a rustic farm with older stye buildings. There are stand alone houses than can be purchased as well if you want to start from scrath or just want to upgrade you house.

There are multiple production points and selling points on the map.

You can play around with the boat or go fishing on Lake Michigan.

358940.title: Gigerwald
358940.author: Da Andy
358940.description:
Gigerwald – Life Below the Dam

Welcome to idyllic Gigerwald in Switzerland – nestled below the imposing dam of Lake Gigerwald, surrounded by a breathtaking yet challenging Alpine landscape.
This farm combines traditional agriculture with modern technology and demands your full attention.
At its heart is an old farmstead with a traditional inn, inviting you to linger and preserving the charm of bygone days.
Just a few meters away, a modern cowshed with state-of-the-art round bale drying equipment was recently put into operation – a symbol of change and progress in the valley.

Farming focuses entirely on grassland: organic fertilization, mowing, windrowing, and round bale harvesting are central to your daily routine.
Arable farming plays no role in this Alpine region – instead, efficient work on steep meadows is key.

The map offers opportunities for production and processing:

On-site dairy
Round bale drying
Quarry
Small and large cement plants
Sawmill

Water can be drawn directly from the surrounding streams, but it's easier to get it from the hydrant in front of the Gigerwald mountain inn.
The terrain requires special attention: Scree and small rocks, especially in the fields, can be crushed into usable stones with the jackhammer and processed in the cement plant.

The extremely steep terrain presents a real challenge – both for you and your machinery. Precision, planning, and the right equipment are key to success.
Are you ready to take on this alpine challenge?

Note: The roads have a special collision warning because the extreme gradient would make them very bumpy – avoid terraforming on the main roads.

359062.title: Move Placeables Advanced
359062.author: Helfer B.
359062.description:
This mod allows you to reposition placed objects. It supports movement along all three axes (X, Y, Z) as well as rotation around all three axes.

Usage:
- Open the construction screen (default: Shift+P)
- Click on the placed object
- Select the Move button
- Left-click on one of the 3 displayed axes (green, blue, red) and move the mouse => Move the object along the selected axis
- Right-click on one of the 3 axes and move the mouse => Change the object’s rotation around that axis
- Confirm the change by clicking on the placeable object again or pressing the Escape key; a final confirmation prompt will appear
- During editing, you can also reject or undo the change by pressing Escape

When guides are enabled (default), the following markings are displayed:
- White line frame: Leveling and texturing area
- Pink line frame: Collision area (not available in free mode)
- Yellow line frame: Fence path (only when moving)

Settings for the mod are located under General Settings in the menu:
- Free Movement: When enabled, moving objects incurs no cost.
- Show Coordinate Overlay: Displays the start and current coordinates (position and rotation) as an overlay when moving.
- Fence Undo Cost Refund: When enabled, undoing the last husbandry fence segment refunds its cost.
- Align Axes to the Object: When enabled, the move gizmo aligns to the object's own axes by default instead of world axes.
- Show Guide Lines When Buying: Shows colored guide lines while buying/placing an object (collision area, ground clearing area).
- Show Guide Lines When Moving: Shows colored guide lines while moving an object (collision area, ground clearing area, fence outline).

ATTENTION! This mod is a complete remake of the mod "Rearrange Placeables" by Helfer B (myself).
The new mod is not compatible with the old mod but replaces it.
All functions have been revised and optimized to provide a better user experience.
If you are using the mod "FS25_RearrangePlaceables.zip", you must delete it first in order to use the new perfect version "Move Placeables Advanced".


Changelog 2.3:
- Removed the “Fence Gate Fix” since Giants has since fixed this in the base game
- Corrected the colors of the gizmo axes (Thanks and apologies, nilBrain)
- NEW: Display of collision detection areas (non-free mode) when purchasing new placeables and moving them, indicated by white lines
- NEW: Display of ground adjustment areas (leveling, texturing) when purchasing new placeables and moving them, indicated by pink lines
- NEW: Options to show or hide guide lines when buying/moving placeables

Changelog 2.2:
- Added an option to specify whether the axis shift aligns with the object's axes or with the world axes
-> Default: Object axes, previously world axes (check last Screenshot)

Changelog 2.1:
# New Features
- When moving animal barns, pasture fences are now also moved, indicated by yellow lines
- Fences automatically adjust to the new ground level when moved
- After moving an animal pen, you are asked whether a (new) pasture should be created within the fenced area
- Map hotspots and teleport points for production facilities/animal pens/etc. are now also correctly moved and updated
- Refund for barn/fence construction: Undoing the last element now also refunds the cost of that element (discovered and requested by DerElky)
-> Configurable in the game settings (menu), default: enabled

# Bug Fixes
- Fixed collision areas when moving placeables & immediate release of previous collision areas
- Fixed synchronization issues in multiplayer for pastures, fences, and animal displays
- Pre-placed map placeables that are moved are now saved at the new position and loaded correctly with the save game (separate XML in the save game)
- Multiplayer

# Base Game Bug Fixes (Starting with Game Version 1.18)
- In rare cases, fence gates float or sink into the ground after loading a save file
-> All fence gates are repositioned at startup and adjusted to the terrain height (reported and requested by [WF] T4xs)

- Various minor bug fixes
- Various logic optimizations

The map is designed for nearly every type of gameplay and player. From single-player “small farmers” with 3m working widths to large-scale multiplayer farmers with heavy machinery. It also supports production management gameplay or “zero-to-hero” storytelling—everything is possible. Thanks to the option of purchasing individual “field barns” or “remote animal facilities” (which is quite common in this region due to limited farm expansion space within old village centers), expansion from small to large operations is also planned—provided you have the necessary funds. There are also designated building plots for creating your own farm, or you can establish yourself as a production manager in the industrial area.

Excellent soil quality (80–90 soil points) ensures high yields. In addition to grains, potatoes and sugar beets thrive particularly well, the latter of which can be delivered directly to the sugar beet factory. Extensive forest and woodland areas are available for forestry enthusiasts.

What to expect:

163 fields with arable land and grassland
10 farms / 2 biogas plants
32 soil angles
Multi-crops
Preparation CCM-Pack [by Kastor]
Visually adjusted crops (e.g., wheat is shorter than rye), adjusted yields, weights, and prices; modified potato ridges and growth-stage textures; less common native crops removed; alfalfa included with custom texture
Field paths deteriorate with each pass (until server or save restart)
A well-developed road and path network

To make the map as authentic and versatile as possible, we have integrated numerous buildings, decorative objects, and placeables. As we maintain close collaboration with fellow modders within the community, the map includes many dependencies on mods from the ModHub, ensuring that all modders receive recognition for their work. Our goal is to fully utilize the possibilities of Farming Simulator.

359554.title: Steering Lock
359554.author: mike1000195
359554.description:
Locks a vehicle to a compass heading with gentle persistent correction. Works with any steerable vehicle.

All keys are unbound by default. Assign them in the in-game Controls menu under "Steering Lock".

Actions / Keybinds:
- Activate / Deactivate: Toggle the steering lock on or off
- Cycle Heading Preset: Cycle through 0 / 90 / 180 / 270 degrees
- Clear Heading: Clear the preselected heading, and disable the hud overlay.
- Get Current Heading: Capture the vehicle's current compass heading
- Fine Adjust Heading +0.1 deg: Nudge the target heading clockwise (hold to select faster)
- Fine Adjust Heading -0.1 deg: Nudge the target heading counter-clockwise (hold to select faster)
- Reposition HUD: Move the HUD display to a different location

Usage: First set a heading using the preset cycle or by capturing the current heading. Fine-tune the heading with +/- adjustments if needed. Activate to lock to that heading. The heading is remembered when deactivated so you can resume without re-setting it. Works better at lower speeds, there is less impact at high speeds to avoid overcompenating and wobbling too hard back and forth.

Reverse lock functionality: The lock stays active while reversing too! - the steering correction automatically inverts so the vehicle holds the same heading backward along the same line. Useful for tight silage compacting, tool work, row tasks, backing straight into unloaders and into trailers, or parking spots without losing your heading. If you want to back up freely to maneuver, just deactivate first - your heading stays remembered and one press of Activate re-engages the lock, same thing with going forwards!

HUD Reposition: Press the Reposition HUD key to enter reposition mode. The mouse cursor appears automatically, with the reposition box. Move the mouse to place the HUD, then LEFT-CLICK to save.

ANY ISSUES WITH THE MOD CAN BE REPORTED BY OPENING AN ISSUE AT https://github.com/mike1000195/FS25-Steering-Lock

359620.title: Fire Alarm System (Prefab*)
359620.author: Modding Keller
359620.description:
This is a prefab and can only be used in mods or maps.
It is intended for decoration.

- Manual Call Point (Picture 1 and 2)
It is pressed in a real emergency when fire or smoke is noticed. Sometimes a strong stale smell can also be a reason to activate it.
The call point forwards the alarm to the fire alarm control panel. It is also called a manual fire alarm call point.

- Fire Alarm Control Panel (Picture 3)
The fire alarm control panel receives the information from the smoke detector or the manual call point and displays the affected fire zone on the building maps.
This helps the fire brigade identify the location of the fire more quickly. At the same time, the fire brigade is automatically alerted.

- Smoke Detector (Picture 4)
The smoke detector can detect different types of vapors, such as smoke or steam.
As soon as something is detected, it sends a signal to the fire alarm control panel.

- Fire Alarm Sign (Picture 1)
The fire alarm sign is installed above the manual call point in public buildings to clearly mark its location.

- FACP Sign / Fire Alarm Panel Sign (Picture 3 top)
The FACP sign marks the way to the fire alarm control panel in public buildings, which is usually located near the main entrance.

359725.title: GE10 Script - Ext. FieldToolkit (Prefab*)
359725.author: Aslan
359725.description:
The Extended FieldToolkit expands the standard GIANTS FieldToolkit with a wide range of new features and an improved debug view, making it significantly easier to create and manage fields.

FEATURES:
- Create or edit fields entirely through the UI
- Create and manage land parcels (e.g. farms, forests, lakes, etc.)

Debug View
- Field names are rendered in the 3D viewport at each field's pivot position
- Polygon points and names are shown for the selected field
- Duplicate polygon vertices are highlighted

Tools
- Validate Fields: Checks all fields for misconfiguration, InfoLayer overlaps and missing attributes – with a clear [OK] / [WARNING] / [ERROR] output
- Adjust Field Pivots: Moves each field's TransformGroup pivot to the area centroid of its polygon (correct even for concave fields)
- Set Foliage from fields.xml: Paints the fruits defined in fields.xml directly onto the fields
- Repaint Fields: Repaints all fields into the farmlands InfoLayer
- Clear Fields: Removes all fields from the farmlands InfoLayer
- Clear Foliage: Removes foliage from fields, with an optional configurable edge offset
- Paint Field Edges: Paints a chosen terrain texture along field borders, optionally inwards as well
- Rename Fields: Renames all fields with a consistent 3-digit numbering
- Align Polygon Points: Aligns all polygon points to the terrain height
- Field statistics (total area, field count) are displayed at the top of the window

INFO:
On first launch, the tool automatically adds the userAttribute “farmlandID” to all fields that don't already have it. This attribute is used to determine farmland ownership and replaces the name-based approach used by the standard FieldToolkit.
____________________________________________________
Installation:
1.) Navigate to the GIANTS Editor AppData path. Default: “C:\Users\[USER]\AppData\Local\GIANTS Editor 64bit 10.0.XX\scripts\”
2.) Copy the file “FieldToolkitExt.lua” from the prefab into the scripts folder.

359729.title: Wildlife Feeder Infos
359729.author: Helfer B.
359729.description:
This mod adds a marker to feeding stations from the Vredo Pack DLC when placing them, allowing you to view and check the feeding station’s 250-meter action radius or effective radius before placing it permanently.

Additionally, the feeding station’s info box (bottom right) is expanded to include two pieces of information: “Fed last year” and “Fed this year”

This lets you know the current status of each feeding station to avoid damage caused by wildlife. One of the values must be “Yes.”

Since there is no official information available yet, here is an explanation of the effective radius and feeding statuses (the mod does not change these).

IMPORTANT: This mod only works if the Vredo Pack DLC is installed and active. None of the mod's functions will be executed if the DLC is not installed or not active.

Since there is currently no official information or in-game help regarding feeding stations, here is an explanation of their radius of effect and feeding stats (the mod does not change these).

If any of the farm’s feeding stations were filled last year or this year, the farm’s fields will be completely spared from wildlife damage—the radius and factor then play no role at all.

This means: a filled feeding station protects the entire farm for two years (this year + last year). A season lasts 3 months. Each month, the feeding stations consume 1/3 of their capacity. The feeding stations must therefore be refilled once a year.

Note: The winter months are December, January, and February. The new year for the feeding stations therefore begins in March.

If the feeding stations have not been refilled, there is a risk of wildlife damage to your own fields. In this case, the 250-meter radius of the feeding stations comes into effect.

Without feeding stations in place, the risk of wildlife damage is 10%. By setting up feeding stations, the probability is reduced to 5% within the radius of the respective feeding station.

As long as you have at least one feeding station that was filled last year or this year, all of your farm’s fields are protected against wildlife damage.

A feeding station requires at least 10 mature trees within a 50-meter radius to be placed.

360158.title: Fields Of Stories - Roleplay
360158.author: AirFoxTwo
360158.description:
Fields of Stories – Living Characters in Farming Simulator

Fields of Stories expands Farming Simulator with a dynamic neighborhood of currently 13 virtual characters who live and work independently in your world and interact with you.
Each character has an individual daily routine and tasks.
You meet characters randomly at the gas station, in the field, at the dealer, or anywhere across the map.
Have conversations, build relationships, and support them when they need help.

BETA note: Please check the roadmap and the features that are still planned. Report bugs and feature requests via GitHub.
GitHub: https://github.com/AirFoxTwo/FS25_FieldsOfStories

Features:
- Up to 13 characters, including farmers, family members, mayor, contractor, grain trader, civilians, machinery dealer / mechanic.
- 4 independently working farmers: work their own fields and use different machinery fleets. They have a cultivation plan and a daily schedule with priorities that they follow for every day.
- Dynamic daily routines: each character has unique or irregular events, but also routines such as sleeping, working, shopping, and refueling.
- Random encounters in the game world: characters move freely around the map, either at public places like the gas station, the park, the industrial area, or out in the field. (Roadmap: AutoDrive Compatibility)
- Spoken, natural conversations: German & English, with individual voices, choice options, and random conversation topics. (Voice packs must be downloaded manually from the Fields of Stories Website.)
- Phone calls: You receive phone calls from the farmers when they need help. You can answer the call and help them or decline the call.
- Field contracts based on Farmers workload: The farmers need your help for specific tasks in their daily schedule. Sometimes, they can take care of it but if not, they will try to call you for help.
- Borrowing machines: You can borrow a machine from the farmers yard, if you don´t have the right equipment for the contract. You need to pickup and return them.

Characters:

Farmers: 4 farmers work their fields independently. They plow, cultivate, seed, fertilize, and harvest. Each has a different, realistic machinery fleet.
For farmers, that means getting up early. Machines are prepared early in the morning at their own farm and, depending on the month, are used until late in the evening.
After that, routine tasks like maintenance, appointments, and shopping still need doing. Sometimes there’s also time for a bit of free time.
Depending on the workload, they will try to call you for help.
All their machines have defined parking spots at the farm. Visit your fellow farmers regularly. You might occasionally be allowed to borrow a machine or they will help you for free (see roadmap).
Contractor: supports during peak periods and with special jobs such as harvesting potatoes, sugar beets, or specialty crops (see roadmap).
Forester: takes care of the forests and forest paths. In summer, he pays special attention to the risk of wildfires (see roadmap).
Mayor: is often out and about in public places. A good relationship with the mayor helps you expand your farm in the long run. He is a good contact for field areas and the local economy (see roadmap).
Grain trader: travels the region and buys grain from the farmers (see roadmap).
Family: helps you with routine tasks on the farm and in the fields (see roadmap).
Machinery dealer: responsible for maintenance, repair, and the sale of machines (see roadmap).

Roadmap:
Individual small talk for each character with positive and negative relationship development.
Farmer gameplay features (taking over or helping with field and farm work, borrowing machines, etc.).
Communication with characters by phone (jobs, meetings, small talk).
Assign farm and field tasks to helpers (via phone and in person).
Driving around the map on supported maps.
Movement of characters within the situation.
Contractor gameplay features (assigning contracts).
Forester gameplay features (forest maintenance, etc.).
Mayor gameplay features (subsidy programs, land purchases, municipal services, etc.).
Machinery dealer / mechanic gameplay features (maintenance, repair, sale, etc.).
Grain trader gameplay features (buying, selling, stock, prices, etc.).
Small missions & random events.
Story mode with long-term story arcs.
Free-form communication.

Supported maps:
All GIANTS standard maps (Riverbend Springs, Hutan Pantai, and Zielonka are already optimized).
All mod maps (locations are created automatically and may need to be added or removed. Finished map configurations can be uploaded/downloaded via fields-of-stories.com).

Controls:
SHIFT + R: Start conversation.
SHIFT + F3: Fields of Stories menu.
Construction menu: Create map places in the "Fields of Stories" category. SHIFT + Q switches the place size, SHIFT + DELETE removes all places of the selected type.
Story tab: Overview of all characters with relationship, relationship level, and relationship points.
Map locations: Place encounter locations (on foot, with a vehicle, or with a vehicle + implement) of various categories on the map.
Character settings: Individual characters can be reset or removed, and their home locations can be removed.
Mod settings: Function to remove all mod contents (reset is possible by saving the game and reloading).
Game Settings: Adjust the number of contract calls per day. Activate realistic contract assignment or classic contract list.

Optimize maps:
Generator (only for unknown maps): On the first start of the mod on a map without a stored configuration, a location generator will detect known objects on the map and automatically create locations.
Home locations: Move the home locations for the characters if the houses don’t fit the character. Create additional parking spots and implement/tool spots for the 4 farmers so their machines and implements can be parked.
Field paths: Drive the field paths once and add parking spots in suitable places, because these cannot be detected automatically.
Cleanup: Remove faulty locations where a character cannot be placed safely or sensibly (e.g., sideways across a parking space).
Misc: You can add various other location types to create a more varied gameplay experience (e.g., industry, leisure locations).
Release: If you want to publish/share the map configuration, you can upload the map via fields-of-stories.com.

Other:
Relationships: Relationships are measured with points and levels. Each conversation gives points for the character’s relationship strength. The relationship points and levels are also credited to you in the form of money.
Conversations: Conversations are based on the current situation and the characters behavior (e.g. suspicious, friendly, etc.). They have real vehicle and work informations in it, like regular outages of Skoda cars, hydraulic parts of a tractor, etc.
Voices: All conversations are voiced in German and English. Language and voice are determined automatically by the downloaded voice pack.
Missions: In later versions, the current conversations will be expanded with missions that you can accept as a player. There are already conversations hinting at this, but they currently don’t trigger any missions yet.

360184.author: Kastor [D-S-Agrarservice]
360184.description:
IMPORTANT NOTES:
- This mod pack adds 4 new tippable heaps (heightTypes) to the ground. Please be aware of the heightType limit on your map if there are already many new fillTypes installed!
- DIRECT FEEDING: CCM / GRIST can only be fed directly if it is registered in the map's animalFood.xml. For use in forage mixers, CCM / GRIST must be explicitly included in the MAP'S recipes – a standard mod cannot add these entries globally!
- BALE ERROR: Due to a Giants error regarding the loading order of bale and filltype definitions from mods, baling CCM is only possible on maps that already have these bales integrated natively into the map!

Take your animal feeding to the next level!
This pack expands your feeding options with the production of high-quality grist and CCM (Corn Cob Mix).
The extra effort of milling and fermenting is highly rewarded:
By cracking the grain (up to 25% yield bonus) and the subsequent processing in the mixing factory,
you achieve a significantly higher feed output compared to using raw crops.
It pays off!

How to process your crops:
You have two options for milling, depending on the size of your farm:

1. The Mobile Hammer Mill:
Designed for large-scale operations.
It provides a seamless continuous process driven by a powerful tractor (280 hp) or PTO generator.
Once the unloading pipe is unfolded, the material is milled on-the-fly and can be unloaded to the ground, a silo, or a trailer.

IMPORTANT: The use of mill additive is mandatory for this mobile process!
Without the additive, the raw material is output un-milled.

2. The Stationary Grist Mill:
A compact, placeable, and cost-effective alternative for smaller farms.
Simply fill the bunker and let the facility do the work.
Finished grist automatically spawns on pallets or can be unloaded as bulk material via the pipe.
No additive or tractor power required.

Raw CCM from either mill must then be fermented in one of the included bunker silos or wrapped into bales (if the map supports it!) using the included Goeweil baler (with mounted Additive Tank!) or vanilla roundbale balers to obtain usable CCM.

In the placeable mixing factory,
the produced goods can then be mixed with forage or root crops
to create highly efficient pig food and Total Mixed Ration (TMR) for cows.

360264.title: GPS Headland Assist
360264.author: Lism
360264.description:
The GPS Headland Assist supports you when driving the headland using the vanilla GPS system.

When the mod is enabled, the vanilla GPS lane guidance automatically switches to the next segment at the end of the active lane segment in headlands and field islands. This means you no longer need to reactivate the GPS in between or make manual steering corrections on curved field contours.

In the settings you can configure the maximum angle up to which the automatic switch to the next lane segment should occur. Up to 80 degrees are supported. At steeper segment transitions you will still need to take over manually.

You can also set how many meters before the end of the lane segment the switch to the next one should be triggered.

If the segment switch does not happen automatically, you can increase the radius in which the mod searches for connecting segments at the end of the active segment.
Warning: Values that are too high, especially with small working widths, may cause an incorrect GPS lane to be selected.

360703.title: Toggle Fertilizer On/Off
360703.author: Hammaneggs Modding
360703.description:
Toggle Fertilizer On/Off

- The default key bind is F3. You can change this to any key bind of your liking.

- The base game AI worker will not complete a sowing task of any kind if your implement has an empty fertilizer capacity. With this mod the tank can be empty and they will complete the sowing task or mission as long as Toggle Fertilizer is turned off. You will see it in the F1 Help Menu. If you start an AI helper and you realize that you didn't want to have fertilizer applied, you can turn it off while the helper is hired. No need to fire the helper and rehire them. This can be done at any time whether the implement is in operation or not. No need to empty your fertilizer from your sowing implement anymore when you don't want it applied. This eliminates wasted fertilizer when it is not needed.

- This mod has been tested in both single player and multiplayer settings.

- For bug reports, questions or comments please use GitHub: https://github.com/HammaneggsModding/FS25_ToggleFertilizer/issues

Happy Farming!!

360720.title: Storage Overhaul: Pallet Degradation System
360720.author: TommyNookah
360720.description:
Give yourself a new reason to use all of the incredible shed mods on the ModHub!

This Pallet Degradation System attempts to simulate the realistic physical toll that outdoor storage takes on your goods. The old tactic of leaving produce exposed to the elements for months while waiting for the best market prices will now result in both temporary and permanent damage with in-game financial consequences.

KEY MECHANICS:
- Exposure is calculated every 30 in-game minutes for palleted goods.
- Status is visible in the info GUI (Sheltered vs. Exposed).
- A financial bonus/deduction is applied, based upon the condition on sale.
- Configurable whitelist of products affected by exposure (via in-game settings).
- All vanilla game filltypes have individual decay rates - bread decays faster than beetroot.
- Configurable decay speed, recovery rate & financial impact (via in-game settings).

SURFACE WEAR (Temporary Damage)
Represents external dirt and moisture on the packaging.
- Accumulates quickly when exposed to weather.
- Naturally "cleans and dries" over time when stored under shelter.
- Reduces sale value if sold while dirty/wet.

Condition (Permanent Damage)
Represents the decay of the actual goods.
- Accumulates much more slowly but is more financially punishing.
- Irreversible: Once damage is done, moving it indoors will not fix it.

FINANCIAL IMPACT:
- PRISTINE BONUS: Sell high-quality, sheltered goods for a profit bonus.
- MARKET REFUND: If you sell damaged or weather-worn goods, the buyer will demand a refund!

Protect your profit—keep your pallets under a roof!

Located 20 miles from the nearest minor town, this map strictly follows the definition of remote. With fields covering the land as far as the eye can see, only the largest equipment will be able to work the land in a timely manner.

With many fields larger than 100 acres, the map has a total of 900 acres of field available to purchase, this map is the ultimate test of your large scale farming skills. And for those who think the map is lonely, there are two farm yards ready to go on farmlands 12 and 13. Alternitavely, there is more than enough open space to add your own, or keep yourself company with large animal pastures. Around the map are many locations to sell your products, and a warehouse is included to faciliate the completion of construction projects. The wind sure does come sweeping down the plains in Montana, and the summers never get too unbearably hot. The winters will require a snow plow and careful driving skills in order to travel safely.

There is not much to write about the vast openness of this map, and nothing could truly stand in place of the raw farming experience when you are surrounded by over 90% farmland

361360.title: Bank And Credit
361360.author: Squallqt
361360.description:
Bank & Credit adds a fractional-reserve bank to Farming Simulator 25. Borrow money, manage your debt and grow your credit capacity by farming.

The bank is a standalone virtual entity with its own equity, funded by the interest it collects. Credit is not granted automatically: it is evaluated based on your income and assets.

Features:
- Three loan types: Annuity (fixed monthly payment), Bullet (interest-only, full principal at maturity), Revolving (draw and repay freely, no fixed term)
- Revolving: 1%/year commitment fee on the undrawn portion; voluntary closure when balance is zero
- Credit scoring via DSCR (12-month decay-weighted income history) and LTV (asset liquidation value with per-category haircuts)
- Five risk levels: LOW / MODERATE / HIGH / CRITICAL / REFUSED - transparent rate breakdown and explicit refusal reasons
- Risk surcharges on top of base rate: LOW +0%, MODERATE +0.75%, HIGH +2%, CRITICAL +5%
- CRITICAL applications are auto-capped at 50% of the requested amount (the bank still lends, but at a reduced size)
- Asset haircuts by category: farmland 70%, livestock 60%, buildings 55%, inventory 50%, tools 50%, tractors 40%, cash 30%
- Borrower limit: liquidated asset value plus 24-month income projection, minus existing outstanding debt
- Concentration cap: a single farm cannot exceed 25% of the bank's total lending capacity
- Loan detail view: full amortisation schedule (Annuity, Bullet) or draw and repayment panel (Revolving)
- Bank health dashboard: equity, leverage ratio, outstanding portfolio, internal loss reserve (not player-loan reimbursement), coverage ratio
- Annual financial report per farm
- Base rate with mean-reversion, updated quarterly (1% - 12%, configurable anchor)
- Type spreads: Annuity +0%, Bullet +0.75%, Revolving +5%
- Early repayment on Annuity and Bullet loans: full or partial by number of months (configurable penalty 0% - 5%)
- Settings (in Game Settings): starting capital (100 k€ - 5 M€), leverage ratio (5x - 20x), base rate, dynamic rate, early repayment penalty
- Separate Interest and Principal entries in the Finance tab
- Solo and multiplayer: in multiplayer, bank equity and portfolio are shared server-side across all farms
- Compatible with FS25_Invoices: invoice income counts in DSCR history
- Compatible with FS25_RedTape: subsidy and grant income counts in DSCR history

Important: this mod replaces the vanilla loan system. Any vanilla loan balance is automatically cleared at game start.

Issues & suggestions: https://github.com/Squallqt/FS25_BankCredit

Access via the dedicated tab in the InGame Menu (ESC).

- Fixed multiplayer synchronization of paid loans and annual reports
- Fixed Bank tab display in the menu
- Fixed repayment and draw amount fields accepting letters
- Added full translation coverage for all 27 supported languages
1.0.0.0:
- Initial release

361530.title: Custom Farm Logo
361530.author: Sunil [Sarmy Farm]
361530.description:
Enhance your farm's identity with the Custom Farm Logo mod. This tool allows players and contractors to integrate their specific virtual farm company or team branding directly into the interface. It creates a more professional, immersive roleplay experience.

How it works:
- On the first launch, the mod creates a configuration folder: Documents/My Games/FarmingSimulator2025/modSettings/FS25_CustomFarmLogo/
- Place your custom farm's logo files inside that folder.
- Rename your file to: "logo1" (Must be all lowercase with no spaces or symbols).

File Requirements:
- You can add up to 20 unique logos to switch between! (must be named "logo1" to "logo20")
- Formats: PNG or DDS (DDS format is recommended for better visual clarity and texture streaming performance).
- Resolution: Supports any resolution but you should always create your logo using a "power of 2" dimension. (A resolution of 512x512 is highly recommended for performance optimization and VRAM savings on mid-to-lower end PCs)
- Logo backgrounds must be transparent.

Controls (Edit Mode - On Foot Only):
- Toggle Edit Menu: LEFT SHIFT + L (Visible in the F1 Menu)
- Toggle Visibility ON/OFF: Key O
- Logo Slots (1-20): Key I (Forward) / Key U (Backward)
- Move Logo: Hold RIGHT SHIFT + K/J/N/M
- Size/Opacity: M/N and K/J
- Reset to Default: BACKSPACE
- Save and Close: Press ENTER
- Discard and Close: Press [LEFT SHIFT + L] to exit the menu without saving.

Note:
- Menu keys [LEFT SHIFT + L] can be fully remapped in your game control settings.
- If you toggle the HUD off, the logo will also disappear. This ensures your screenshots remain clean.

[ ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ]
- A setup guide is inside the mod ZIP, and a copy [readme.txt] is automatically created inside that same folder on first launch.

361558.title: New Gloria Farm

361644.title: Dynamic Implement Force
361644.author: Paceline
361644.description:
This PC only mod adds an immersive layer of realism by allowing you to dynamically adjust the pulling resistance of any attached implement in real-time while you are playing.

You can simulate realistic challenges or just test your tractor's limits without needing to edit any XML files. A dynamic counter in your F1 Help Menu and blinking on-screen warnings provide immediate visual feedback.

The script injects logic into all implements that require engine power. It directly modifies their performance parameters in the game's active memory. When you execute a keybind, the script adds or subtracts .15 resistance to the implement's force requirements. For ground-engaging tools like plows and rippers, it modifies the ground friction coefficient. For powered tools like combine headers or mowers, it increases the required pto engine horsepower. Settings return to default values when reloading your save game.

Controls:
- Increase Force: Alt + 9
- Decrease Force: Alt + 8
(Keys can be customized in the game's keybindings menu. Custom controller mapping is supported via the settings menu.)

361679.title: Enhanced Help Menu
361679.author: petvind
361679.description:
Replaces the built-in F1 help menu with a smarter, always-visible overlay that shows every active input action and its key binding, not just the handful the game chooses to highlight.

The list updates as your context changes: on foot, in a vehicle, near interactive objects, or using attachments. New actions get a subtle green accent bar and slide to the top of the list so you notice them straight away.

Features:
- Lists every active action across all connected input devices, with real key bindings (keyboard, mouse, joystick, gamepad) and proper formatting for combos and alternates
- Category filter and per-row hide, for both action rows and status lines (work-mode, AI-mode, etc.); selections persist across sessions
- Filter mode softly blurs the game world behind the panel for cleaner focus
- New-action highlighting with smooth fade-in and green accent bar; auto-sorted to top
- Long bindings wrap to a second line so nothing hides behind an ellipsis
- Pagination for long action lists; cycle device filter (with "ALL devices" mode) when multiple devices are connected
- Status lines for work mode and AI helper mode (with HOLD key pill and live Driving / Working / Turning / Blocked state)
- Precision Farming combine/seeder/sprayer widgets render cleanly inside EHM (no more overlap)
- In-game Enhanced Settings tab (ESC -> Settings) for: show native help menu (adds a 3-state F1 cycle), rows per page (6 - 20), and panel width (125% - 300%)
- Follows the game's UI Scale setting (Display -> UI Scale) so the panel grows/shrinks alongside other HUDs
- Full German localization

Controls (defaults; all remappable in the Controls menu):
F1 : Cycle display (overlay only / native only / both hidden)
ALT + INS : Open or close filter
ALT + PGUP : Previous page
ALT + PGDN : Next page
ALT + HOME : Cycle device filter

The ALT prefix gives EHM its own non-colliding keyspace -- bare PGUP / PGDN zoom the camera as the game intended, while ALT + key drives EHM. Upgrading from an earlier version? Your existing bindings carry over -- new defaults only apply to fresh installs. Rebind in the Controls menu (Enhanced Help Menu section) any time.

What's new in this update:
- Key labels now match your keyboard layout. On non-US layouts (German QWERTZ, Norwegian, AZERTY, etc.) bindings used to show the US key for that position; they now show your real keycaps, including layout-specific keys like Ae/Oe/Ue and Ø / Æ / Å.
- Controller / joystick support for the toggle and paging. Toggling the display and changing pages now work when those actions are bound to a gamepad, wheel or farmstick button, not just the keyboard.
- Fixed: the feed mixer's "Mixing Ratio" panel (the straw/hay/silage/additive percentages) is shown again in the overlay. It was being hidden.

Earlier changes (since v1.0.0.0):
- New defaults: ALT + INS / ALT + HOME / ALT + PGUP / ALT + PGDN (was F4/F10/F6/F7). Sidesteps the old PGUP/PGDN camera-zoom conflict. Existing players keep their bindings; new installs get the new defaults. All keys remain remappable, combos supported.
- Added "Enhanced Settings" tab under ESC -> Settings, with three settings: show native help menu, rows per page (6-20), and panel width (125% - 300%).
- Added German localization across the whole UI.
- Added ALL-devices mode in the device cycle (shows every connected device's bindings side by side).
- Added work-mode and AI-mode status lines, with live AI-worker state (Driving / Working / Turning / Blocked) and the HOLD-key pill.
- Precision Farming widgets now coexist cleanly with EHM (no more overlap).
- Panel now follows the game's UI Scale setting.
- Header tightened: dropped the redundant TOGGLE [F1] pill, action count, and duplicate "PAGE" label.
- Filter-mode hide/un-hide now works on header status lines too.
- Fixed F1 cycle drifting after construction-screen visits.
- Fixed native F1 menu occasionally leaking on top of EHM.
- Fixed sub-pixel seam lines at non-integer UI Scale values.
- Visual polish on chord-key and alternate-binding separators.

Feedback, bug reports, and feature requests:
https://github.com/petvind/FS25_EnhancedHelpMenu_modhub

361863.description:
Construction Helper enhances the building placement experience by providing precise coordinate display and advanced snapping controls.

FEATURES:
• Real-time coordinate display (X, Z position and rotation) in the construction HUD with 3-decimal precision
• Customizable position snapping increments: 0.1m, 0.25m, 0.5m, 1.0m, 2.5m, 5.0m
• Customizable rotation snapping increments: 1°, 5°, 10°, 15°, 30°, 45°
• Local/Relative snap mode - entire grid rotates with building angle for perfect parallel alignment at any rotation

DEFAULT KEYBINDS:
• LALT + 1: Cycle Position Snap - Change position grid size
• LALT + 2: Cycle Rotation Snap - Change rotation angle step
• LALT + 3: Toggle Local Snap Mode - Switch between world grid and building-relative snapping

All keybinds can be customized in Settings > Controls.

GLOBAL vs LOCAL SNAP MODE:
• Global Mode: Building snaps to world X/Z coordinate grid (best for 90° aligned placements)
• Local Mode: Entire snapping grid rotates with the building - objects placed at the same local grid coordinates will form perfectly parallel lines in world space, regardless of rotation angle. Ideal for creating aligned rows of buildings at any angle (30°, 45°, 60°, etc.)

HOW LOCAL MODE WORKS:
When placing multiple objects at the same rotation (e.g., 30°), they will align in straight lines parallel to each other. The grid rotates rigidly with your building, so objects placed at local grid positions (3,0), (6,0), (9,0) will form a straight line at 30° in world space.

GitHub link: https://github.com/gingerskull/FS25-ConstructionHelper

361963.title: Collision Damage
361963.author: Dude23
361963.description:
Adds additional vehicle damage after stronger collisions.

The mod uses the existing Giants damage system. There are no visible deformations, but the normal damage value of the vehicle increases and can be repaired as usual.

Stronger impacts are detected when the sensor-based check can confirm an external contact in the travel or sensor area. When two usable vehicles, trailers or tools collide, the hit object can also receive the same additional damage value if it has its own damage system.

Static obstacles such as buildings or trees are not damaged. The driven vehicle combination's own attached tools or trailers are not counted as a second crash participant.

Damage calculation runs on the server side and uses the game's existing saving and synchronization.

1.2.0.0:
- Collision detection completely reworked
- Impact damage is now detected more reliably
- Collisions involving front loaders, buckets and other attached equipment are better taken into account
- Fewer false triggers while braking, steering, attaching or detaching equipment
- Improved performance and stability

1.1.1.0:
- Fixed an issue where hard braking on open ground was detected as a damage event
- Fixed an issue where attached tools were detected as collisions and therefore caused continuous damage

1.1.0.0:
- Stability improvements
- The damage amount can now be adjusted in the game settings. 100 percent corresponds to the standard effect.

362332.description:
PriceTicker is a market price assistant for Farming Simulator 25. It evaluates current market opportunities, your own stock and possible revenue in one FS25 style ESC menu and a discreet in game HUD.

Functions:
- Price quality, sell now recommendation, expected seasonal maximum and possible gain from waiting
- Own stock from farm storages, productions, husbandries and supported object storages; vehicles and pallets are optional
- Current revenue, potential maximum revenue and separate summaries for the best opportunity and highest absolute price

- Percentage alarms at 80%, 85%, 90%, 95% or 100% and new annual high alarms
- Once only or repeating alarms with configurable reminder intervals and optional stock requirement
- Hourly savegame history with views for 24 hours, 7 days and 12 months, including chart, minimum, average, maximum and changes since yesterday and last month
- Favorites plus filters for stock, good prices, crops, animal products, production goods, liquids and mod products
- Configurable multi row HUD with position, size, opacity, rotation speed and manual previous/next controls
- Automatic support for compatible mod fill types, localized currency and prices per 1,000 liters

PriceTicker does not change market prices. It helps you understand them and decide whether selling now or waiting is more worthwhile.

362333.title: Vehicle Trade In
362333.author: Pat95
362333.description:
Vehicle Trade In adds a complete, safe trade in and used equipment system to Farming Simulator 25 and integrates it into the normal vehicle dealer.

Functions:
- Native dealer page for selecting owned vehicles and replacement vehicles
- Trade in value based on purchase price, age, operating hours, damage and dirt
- Six stage valuation with configurable factors, minimum value and payout cap
- Optional dealer service: repair and clean the vehicle before valuation
- Safety checks for attached implements, trailers, loads and unsupported objects
- Vehicle configurator after a successful trade, including colors, wheels and license plate
- Used market with daily offers, transparent prices, discounts and condition data
- Separate LS25 style pages for used market, financing and statistics
- Financing plans with interest, installments, remaining balance and contract overview
- Statistics for trades, revenue, value loss, averages, records, brands and recent trades

- The configurator can be cancelled with ESC and safely restores the complete unfinished transaction
- Financing supports manual installments and full payoff; financed vehicles are protected from trade until paid
- Settings, used offers, contracts and statistics are saved and synchronized in multiplayer

Navigation:
Open the normal vehicle dealer and select Vehicle Trade In. The used market, finance and statistics pages have their own footer buttons. Back from an information page returns to the Trade In dealer page.

362405.title: Forage Harvest Extension
362405.author: [Weekend Farmers]
362405.description:
This mod adds growth-stage-dependent yields to the field chopper harvesting system.
Players who harvest later may be rewarded with higher yields, but they also take on a greater risk of damage from severe weather or wild boars.

Appropriate default values are already set for the base game and maps based on the multi-fruit templates.
Custom adjustments can be made directly via the forageYieldScales.xml file in the mod.

Example: Default values in the mod for Maize:
- harvestReadyGreen - Growth stage 5 - 100%
- harvestReadyGreen2 - Growth stage 6 - 125%
- harvestReady3 - Growth stage 7 - 80%

The mod includes a PDF guide that explains how to integrate it into mod maps and how to adjust the YieldScales directly within the mod.

Maps that use their own forageYieldScale entries remain playable without the mod and therefore do not lose their existing crossplay capability.

Animal Waste Control allows you to modify the amount of manure and slurry produced by your animals.

The mod adds a configurable multiplier directly in the game's general settings,
allowing you to easily adjust production to match your gameplay style.

For example, if your animals normally produce 200 liters of manure per hour and the multiplier is set to 2,

- Slurry does not require straw to be produced.

This mod is fully compatible with multiplayer and dedicated servers.

362785.author: nop82
362785.description:
Welcome to Wildenberg.

Here you'll find a fictional village called Wildenberg on the Danube, an industrial park with various production facilities, and a port area,
all nestled between valleys and mountains with idyllic forests and the Danube River.

Distributed across the map are:

- 5 farms
- 1 farmstead that you can purchase for 0,- $ but you'll need to clean it up afterward, which isn't cheap
- 1 small farm plot in the forest
- 1 expansion plot with a sheep and goat barn
- 1 smaller, vacant building plot outside of Wildenberg and 1 larger, fully developed building plot in Wildenberg for your own development or expansion
- 2 outdoor bunker silos. Potatoes and sugar beet pulp can also be added to the concrete-block silos; these are likewise converted into chaff.

The decorations on the farms can be sold individually or in groups, depending on their layout, just like the buildings themselves.

The decorations on the farms can be sold individually or as a whole, depending on how they're arranged, just like the buildings themselves.
The starting area is located a little outside the town and is divided into two parts separated by a stream, but don't worry, they are connected by a bridge.

Animal Shelters:

- Starting Farm: Cow Shed and Chicken Coop
- Large Cow Farm: One regular cow shed and a separate cow shed next to it for expansion
- Farm in the Valley: Pigsty
- Small Farm in the Village: Cow Shed
- Large Farm in the Village: Cow Shed
- Small Merchant Farm: Pigsty and Chicken Coop
- Outlying Farm: Two cow sheds
- In the Village: Sheep and goat barn for free expansion

There are:
- 18 meadows with a total area of 31.01 ha, ranging from 0.16 ha to 5.06 ha
- 32 fields with a total area of 60.04 ha, ranging from 0.45 ha to 6.38 ha
- 45 forest areas
- Multi-soil angles with 32 angles
- New pallets: IBC silage additive, pallet equipment storage and cocoa butter

The map includes multi-crop farming with the following additional crops:
- Rye
- Triticale
- Spelt
- Humusactive
- Mustard
- Silage Corn
- Green Rye
- Vetch Rye
- and my own creations Reproduction grass, which is mowed or threshed as in the original game
- Modified meadow grass

- Spring barley
- Winter barley

Production, sales, and purchase stations:
- Dairy

To transport your goods and merchandise, or to send them on to another region and sell them, there is also a train line with two loading bays.

In the building menu, you can place a Euro pallet yourself to store your equipment, and a traffic mirror to place on your farmland, which displays information just like in the original game.

Furthermore, the Wildenberg animal stables offer a customized feeding regimen, expanded to include other fruits thanks to the multi-fruit option. For pigs and horses, you can also feed them day-old bread,

362921.title: Save Unit Profiles
362921.author: SimGamerJen
362921.description:
Description:
Save Unit Profiles lets each savegame use its own currency and unit settings.

The mod adds a native Unit Profile selector to the Farming Simulator 25 Settings menu under:

General Settings > Units

Changing the Unit Profile selector assigns the selected profile to the currently loaded savegame and applies the active in-game unit settings when the Settings UI is closed. No separate dialog is required, and normal players do not need to edit XML manually.

This is useful when switching between maps from different regions. For example, a North American savegame can use dollars, miles, Fahrenheit and acres, while a UK savegame can use pounds, miles, Celsius and acres, and a European savegame can use euros, kilometres, Celsius and hectares.

Features:
- Per-savegame currency and unit profiles.
- Native Unit Profile selector in General Settings > Units.
- Profile selection applies immediately to the current savegame.
- Built-in regional profiles for multiple map locations and play styles.
- Integrated currency support directly within Save Unit Profiles.
- Save Current Units option for creating a custom profile from the current in-game settings.
- Existing XML mappings remain supported for advanced/manual configuration.

Configuration:
For normal use, open General Settings > Units and select the desired Unit Profile.

The mod also stores its configuration here:

modSettings/FS25_SaveUnitProfiles/saveUnitProfiles.xml

This file can still be edited manually by advanced users, but manual XML editing is no longer required for normal profile setup.

Hotkeys:
No hotkeys are required.

Console commands:
suStatus - Show current status and loaded settings.
suReload - Reload the XML configuration file.
suApply - Apply the configured profile for the current savegame.
suApply UK / suApply US / suApply EU - Manually apply a specific profile.
suProfile UK / suProfile US / suProfile EU / suProfile CA - Assign and apply a specific profile to the current savegame.
suSaveCurrent - Save the current unit settings for the loaded savegame.
suDebug on / suDebug off - Enable or disable debug logging.

Changelog:
Version 1.2.0.2
- Added optional compatibility handling for external time-format settings.
- Prevented unsupported use24HourTime GameSetting calls when the optional provider is not available.
- Added localisation keys for the Unit Profile settings row and related UI text.

Version 1.2.0.1
- Improved live settings application when changing Unit Profile from General Settings > Units.
- Profile changes now apply correctly after leaving the Settings UI.
- Reduced duplicate on-screen success notifications during normal profile selection.
- Warning/error notifications remain available if a profile cannot be applied correctly.

Version 1.2.0.0
- Added native Unit Profile selector to General Settings > Units.
- Added automatic apply-on-selection behaviour for unit profiles.
- Added integrated regional currency/profile support directly in Save Unit Profiles.
- Added additional predefined regional profiles for more map locations and play styles.
- Added Save Current Units option for creating custom profiles from the current settings.
- Removed the need to manually edit XML for normal savegame profile setup.
- Retained support for existing XML mappings, custom profiles and console commands.

Version 1.1.0.0
- Added SAVE UNITS button to the in-game Settings interface.
- Added support for saving the current unit settings directly to the loaded savegame profile.
- Added suSaveCurrent console command as a manual fallback.
- Existing manual XML mappings and custom profiles remain supported.

Version 1.0.0.0
- Initial release.
- Added per-savegame unit and currency profiles.
- Added default US, UK and EU profiles.
- Added console commands for status, reload, manual apply and debug logging.

GitHub link:
https://github.com/SimGamerJen/FS25_SaveUnitProfiles

363077.title: Extended Vehicle Maintenance
363077.author: SimuTools
363077.description:
Extended Vehicle Maintenance adds a realistic maintenance and repair system to Farming Simulator 25.

Drivable machines require regular maintenance based on their operating hours. To open the maintenance menu, stand next to the machine you want to service and press CTRL + M. Maintenance and repairs can then be started through the custom service menu.
While a machine is in service, it cannot be used, started or driven. Different service options are available: sending a machine to the workshop takes longer, calling a technician is the most expensive option, and self-repair is the cheapest option but takes the longest to complete.
The mod also includes realistic malfunctions such as engine problems, flat tires, RPM/emergency-mode failures and battery-related faults. Overdue machines can become unreliable and may fail during operation.
In addition, Extended Vehicle Maintenance includes a collision damage system. Strong impacts can damage vehicles depending on the collision speed, making careful driving and realistic vehicle handling more important.
The default instant repair workflow is replaced by a more immersive service system for realistic multiplayer and long-term gameplay.

If you have any feedback or encounter any errors, please feel free to contact us here:
https://github.com/SimuTools/FS25_ExtendedVehicleMaintenance

363383.title: Terrain Texture And Object Picker
363383.author: Nalathan
363383.description:
Terrain Texture And Object Picker adds a pipette function for ground textures, foliage, bushes, trees and supported placeable objects to the construction menu.

It allows previously used paint textures, visible foliage such as grass, flowers and bushes, placeable trees and supported objects to be picked directly from the map and found again in the construction menu. In mixed areas, several matching results can be shown.

How to use:
1. Open the “Pipette” tab in the construction menu.
2. Press the “Activate pipette” button.
3. Click a ground texture, foliage, a bush, a tree or a supported object.
4. Confirm the desired result in the construction menu.
5. Paint or build as usual.

If needed, the pipette can be activated again at any time. The active brush is reset before picking.

The mod considers available ground textures and suitable foliage of the current map. Map foliage is detected without loading additional entries into the regular construction menu unchecked.

Search:
The “Search” tab (right next to “Pipette”) lets you search the entire construction menu by keyword. Multiple words can be entered in any order, results are sorted by relevance. For general search terms, the search recognizes connected groups of objects – currently trees and husbandry as the first examples – even when the term doesn’t literally appear in the name. This recognition will be extended to more areas over time.

Credits:
Thanks to PeterPwn247 for “All Decorative Foliage” and to modelleicher (Farming Agency) for “All The Ground Textures Ingame”. Both mods helped with understanding how map content can be made available in the construction menu.

GitHub: https://github.com/Nalathan01/FS25_TexturePipette/issues

363411.author: BayernGamers
363411.description:
Mercedes Benz DLC Work Cameras for all Vehicles

This mod enables the functional cameras of the Mercedes Benz DLC vehicles to be used in all vehicles. The Mercedes Benz Trucks Pack is required for this.

The cameras in the vehicles can be split into different groups, in which the cameras can be switched through. In addition, an automatic switching of the cameras can be activated, which selects the appropriate camera depending on the driving direction and/or status of the unloading pipe.

The mod adds the cameras to existing vehicles from the base game, so you can start using them right away with the available vehicles.

For some implements and trailers, cameras are available as well. These will be displayed in suitable pulling vehicles as soon as the implement is attached.
Mod vehicles that are properly prepared can also use Work Cameras. A guide for integration can be found in the mod directory.

The control of the camera functions is done via the following key bindings:
- Switch camera group: Right Ctrl key + Quote key
- Activate/deactivate camera group: Right Alt key + Semicolon key + Numpad / key
- Select next camera: Right Alt key + Semicolon key + Numpad + key
- Select previous camera: Right Alt key + Semicolon key + Numpad - key
- Toggle automatic mode: Right Alt key + Semicolon key + Numpad * key

With the upcoming version 2.1.0.0 of Dashboard Live, the cameras will also be usable in a large number of standard vehicles with DBL displays. The cameras are integrated into the displays there.

363427.title: Automatic Bale Storage
363427.author: C.Schoch
363427.description:
Changes how bale and pallet storage placeables unload their contents.

Instead of spawning all objects at once, an unload request from the storage UI is queued and dispatched in batches every 5 seconds. If the output area is full the mod waits and retries automatically, so you never lose queued items. The pending count is saved to the savegame and survives a reload.

The vanilla unload-amount cap is also removed, so the UI slider goes up to the actual number of objects currently stored rather than the vanilla hard limit.

Compatible with all base-game and modded placeables that use the GIANTS object storage specialization.

GitHub: https://github.com/CSchoch/FS25_AutomaticBaleStorage

Changelog 1.0.0.3:
- Fixed: Selling or deleting a storage while an unload was still pending could keep the mod working on the removed placeable.
