363579.title: GE10 Script - Spline To Field Generator (Prefab*)
363579.author: Steven1134
363579.description:
The SplineToFieldGenerator is a script for the GIANTS Editor designed to help users create fields more easily using splines while keeping the number of polygonPoints as low as possible.
This script can save a significant amount of work, especially when working with very large or irregularly shaped fields.

Features:
-Simple field generation using fieldBoundarySpline
-Field island generation using: fieldIslandSpline/fieldIslandSmallSpline
Field islands are completely optional and not required.

UI Features:
-Creation of all required splines and groups
-Generation of polygonPoints
-Show and hide splines
-Render debug mode for a better overview of the generated polygonPoints of the selected field using the current settings, including live updates when settings are changed
-Delete all splines and groups from either a selected field or all fields
Notes: When deleting splines and groups for the first time, a backup TransformGroup will automatically be created under: SplineToFieldGenerator -> Backup. The deleted splines and groups will then be stored there as: fieldXXBackup. This backup system is used to preserve the splines and groups of a field in case something was deleted accidentally or additional changes need to be made later.

Additionally, the script performs many automatic checks and outputs useful messages to the GE console, explaining what is currently happening or why certain functions could not be execute

Example Field Structure:
First, you need a field created using the GIANTS Editor FieldToolkit or another script that supports field creation.

Simple Field
fields
----└── fieldXX
--------├── polygonPoints (transformgroup)
--------├── nameIndicator (transformgroup) Standard GIANTS structure
--------├── teleportIndicator (transformgroup)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------└── fieldBoundarySpline (Spline) SplineToFieldGenerator structure
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Field With Field Islands
fields
----└── fieldXX
--------├── polygonPoints (transformgroup)
--------├── nameIndicator (transformgroup) Standard GIANTS structure
--------├── teleportIndicator (transformgroup)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------├── fieldBoundarySpline (Spline)
--------└── fieldIsland (transformgroup) SplineToFieldGenerator structure
------------└── fieldIslandSpline (Spline)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The fieldIsland TransformGroup must be properly aligned with the field islands.
The blue debug lines in Render Debug mode help visualize whether areas are correctly detected as field islands during generation.

Field With Hard-To-Reach Field Islands
fields
----└── fieldXX
--------├── polygonPoints (transformgroup)
--------├── nameIndicator (transformgroup) Standard GIANTS structure
--------├── teleportIndicator (transformgroup)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------├── fieldBoundarySpline (Spline)
--------└── fieldIsland (transformgroup)
------------├── fieldIslandSpline (Spline) SplineToFieldGenerator structure
------------├── fieldIslandSpline (Spline)
------------└── fieldIslandWaypoint (transformgroup)
----------------└── fieldIslandSpline (Spline)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The fieldIslandWaypoint is used to provide one or multiple fieldIslandSpline objects with an additional TransformGroup, allowing difficult-to-reach field islands to be generated more accurately.
This is especially useful for highly complex or heavily twisted field layouts.

Important Notes:
The hierarchy does not need to follow the exact same order as shown in the examples.

Internally, the script processes data in the following order:
fieldBoundarySpline -> fieldIsland (transformgroup)
It does not matter where the fieldBoundarySpline is located inside the fieldXX group, since the script automatically searches for it first.

The only important requirement is:
Everything containing fieldIsland in its name must also be located inside the fieldIsland TransformGroup.
Otherwise, incorrect or unexpected generation patterns may occur.

Please also note that the script may not always generate perfectly accurate field shapes in every situation. Due to the technical limitations of splines, corners may occasionally become slightly rounded or uneven, since splines cannot create perfectly precise 90-degree edges. Because of this, some corners or transitions may require minor manual adjustments afterward.

Installation:
1.)Start the latest version of the GIANTS Editor
2.)Navigate through the top menu bar to: Window -> Script Editor. and open the Script Editor
3.)Right-click the folder where you want to store the script (for example: Shared Scripts) and select: Explore Folder
4.)Copy the SplineToFieldGenerator.lua file into your selected script folder and restart the GIANTS Editor
5.)The script will then be available inside the GIANTS Editor through the top menu bar under: Scripts

CHANGELOG 1.0.0.1
- Updated the script code to support GIANTS Editor 10.0.12.
Important! This update requires GIANTS Editor 10.0.12 and Farming Simulator 25 version 1.19.0.0 or newer.

363665.title: Silage Fermenting Settings
363665.author: [Weekend Farmers]
363665.description:
With the Silage Fermenting Settings mod, you can adjust the fermentation time for silage bales and mobile silos directly in-game.

This mod was created because, in FS25, silage bales and mobile silos can take significantly different amounts of time to ferment depending on the game settings.
By default, bales are heavily influenced by the economic difficulty setting, while mobile silos are tied to the number of days per month set in the game.
This mod allows both systems to be brought onto a consistent, shared monthly basis.

The fermentation duration is specified in in-game months and automatically adjusts to the set number of days per month.
Bales and mobile silos can be set independently of each other.

Available values:
0.25 / 0.50 / 0.75 / 1.00 / 1.25 / 1.50 / 1.75 / 2.00 months

For silage bales, the economic difficulty is ignored so that the set fermentation duration remains identical across Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulty levels.

Bales already in fermentation retain their current progress percentage when the setting is changed.
Mobile silos that have already been closed also retain their current fermentation progress and continue running with the newly set duration.

The settings are saved per game save and restored when loading.
In multiplayer, the settings can only be changed by the admin.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

364007.title: To Pasture And Back
364007.author: Kijbev
364007.description:
In FS25, barns with attached pastures let animals roam freely between the barn and the pasture or meadow. But standalone barns keep livestock locked inside. To Pasture and Back changes that.

This mod emulates the experience of letting otherwise barn-locked animals roam freely on fields and pastures suited to each species, especially useful when a barn is not attached to its own pasture. Send your animals to a field where they can graze, forage, wander, and rest. While the herd is out on pasture, only the youngest animals stay behind in the barn. When you recall them, the animals return to their stalls.

Feeding, breeding, and production continue as normal in the barn. The mod handles the visual side without affecting your farm's economy.

All livestock supported (cows, sheep, goats, pigs, horses). Chickens excluded.

Designed for the base game animal husbandry system.

FEATURES:
- Send herds from any barn to a suitable field: cows and horses graze grass, sheep and goats browse rougher pasture, pigs forage on mowed fields and stubble
- Collect several herds and drop them one per keypress: stack compatible species on one field or spread them across different fields
- Animals too young to leave the barn stay home and remain visible in their stalls while the rest of the herd is out
- Animals refuse fields with growing crops; grass at any stage and harvested stubble are fine
- Adjust how many animals are visible at barns and pastures, per player (Auto picks by graphics quality, or 25 to 500 manual)
- For fields without an existing fence, decorative temporary fences mark the grazing area (visual only, no collision, toggleable)
- Manual recall any time (RCtrl+K)
- Optional 10 PM curfew and 6 PM dusk reminder as safety nets for forgotten herds
- Customizable on-screen messages (size, color, on/off)
- Multiplayer supported
- Saves and loads across sessions

This mod may only be hosted on the official GIANTS ModHub. Redistribution on other websites is not permitted without the author's written consent.

364141.title: Forage Silo Extension
364141.author: Nalathan
364141.description:
Forage Silo Extension adds extra storage options for feed and bulk materials to normal farm silos.

The feed silo extension is enabled by default. This allows normal farm silos to accept and unload additional fill types that are relevant for producing and storing animal feed.
The full fill type extension can optionally be enabled in the game settings. This allows normal farm silos to store all fill types registered in the savegame, as long as they are provided correctly by the game, map, DLCs or other mods.
Existing stored fill types are protected, so already stored material should not be lost when the settings are set differently.

Important:
Disabling additional fill types takes effect immediately.
Enabling additional fill types again requires saving and reloading the savegame before the silo triggers accept the newly enabled fill types.
After setting the options, vehicles may also need to leave and re-enter the unload trigger area so the base game trigger can refresh its accepted fill types.

Features:
- Feed silo extension enabled by default
- Option for all registered fill types
- Protection for already stored fill types
- Support for base game, DLCs, mod maps and additional fill type mods

364188.title: Farm Operations Dashboard
364188.author: VeteranModding
364188.description:
Farm Operations Dashboard

Adds a multiplayer-compatible in-game menu page with native sub-tabs for day-to-day farm management.

The overview tab highlights current work across finance, owned fields, animal pens, production points, contracts, price opportunities and vehicles. The Plan tab now works as an operations board with weather and event context, work windows, dependencies and suggested kit. Dedicated tabs provide full views for fields, animals, productions, contracts, prices, pallet product totals and all owned vehicles.

Fields use live game field-state data where possible, including harvest-ready periods, withered, harvested, plowed and growing states. Harvest readiness avoids preparing and growing states, while harvest urgency uses calendar data exposed by the loaded fruit or map and avoids hardcoded base-game calendar assumptions on custom maps. First harvest-ready calendar period is shown as Watch, second or later harvest-ready period as Urgent, while harvested and withered fields remain informational. Animal pens show overall food and health levels, empty husbandries stay low priority until animals are added, productions focus on output storage and input supply, prices use the bundled max-price alert support, pallets have their own product totals view, and vehicles show brand/manufacturer-style naming, category, fuel, wear, hours and current use state.

Changelog 1.1.0.0:
- Added operations-board Plan tab with weather/event context, work windows, dependencies and suggested equipment.
- Added pallet inventory tab with total quantity by product and removed pallets from normal vehicle work.
- Improved field readiness on custom maps and custom crop calendars by ignoring misleading harvest-ready ground markers when growth state is not ready.
- Added field trace console diagnostics for harvest-ready debugging.
- Improved animal handling so empty husbandries remain low priority and do not create plan actions until animals are present.
- Expanded vehicle details with brand/manufacturer naming, category, condition, fuel, hours and use state.

364457.title: Livestock Visibility
364457.author: Kijbev
364457.description:
In FS25, the engine only renders about 25 visible animals per husbandry, no matter how many you actually own. A barn holding 140 cows, or a coop holding hundreds of chickens, still looks nearly empty. Livestock Visibility lifts that cap.

Raise the visible animal count at your husbandries up to a limit you choose (Auto, or 25 to 500). It is purely visual: it renders more of the animals you already own, and never more than that. It does not change buy and sell capacity, breeding, feeding, productivity, health, or save data in any way.

Works on the base game animal system for every farmed species: cows, sheep, goats, pigs, horses, and chickens. It applies the same to barns, barns with attached pastures, and standalone pasture placeables. It never renders more animals than are actually there, so a barn with 40 of 140 filled shows 40.

For players who want to see their full herds and flocks but do not need a grazing mod.

FEATURES:
- Lifts the base game ~25-per-husbandry visible animal cap up to 500
- Never shows more than you actually own (a barn with 40 of 140 filled shows 40)
- All farmed species including chickens and other poultry
- Per player, visual only, no gameplay or economy change
- Auto picks a limit based on your graphics quality, or set 25 to 500 manually
- RCtrl+T opens a quick on-screen panel to change the limit while you watch the animals
- Multiplayer supported, each player sets their own limit
- Settings persist across sessions
- Stands down automatically when a mod that already manages herd visuals is present (Realistic Livestock, To Pasture and Back, More Visual Animals, Enhanced Livestock)

This mod may only be hosted on the official GIANTS ModHub. Redistribution on other websites is not permitted without the author's written consent.

364582.title: Build Menu: Husbandry Storage Info
364582.author: Aekzl
364582.description:
See an animal husbandry's storage capacities BEFORE you place it.

In the construction menu (and the shop) each barn shows, inline next to the animal count, the storage capacity for its feed trough, slurry (liquid manure), manure, milk, straw and water - each with its fill-type icon.

The key for planning: if a barn produces slurry or manure but has NO internal storage, the value reads "external" and the whole label turns orange - that means you must also place a separate slurry pit / manure heap nearby. If the animal type does not produce something, that line is simply omitted (e.g. pastures, chicken coops).

Pure display add-on: it only reads the stored data and changes nothing in gameplay, savegames or multiplayer. The redundant feed-type icon strip is hidden for husbandries to make room.

364812.title: Everything Constructable
364812.author: Ozz
364812.description:
Everything Constructable

Buildings no longer appear instantly. Instead, placing a building creates a realistic multi-phase construction project with fenced sites, monthly progress, and resource delivery.

You can disable and enable this process at will. For construction projects, you can deliver material yourself to reduce the cost. Projects will take a number of months, depending on the cost.

You can pause a project if you want to wait and supply materials. You must always pay for labour, but can configure the portion of the total cost for labour vs materials.

Fully supports multiplayer. Excludes base game simple pastures and those in FS25_FencelessPastures.

Github: https://github.com/Ozz-Modding/FS25_EverythingConstructable

365010.title: Crop Control Override
365010.author: SimGamerJen, Hyper138
365010.description:
Description:
Crop Control Override is a per-save crop policy manager for Farming Simulator 25. It lets players control which crops are permitted for the player, which crops NPC farmers may plant, and whether NPC crop planting should be limited by field size.

The mod includes an editable FS25-style GUI, per-save XML rule files, NPC field validation, blocked NPC field reporting, and a guarded Apply / Force Apply workflow to prevent accidental invalid save states.

Main GUI features:
- ALL RULES: view and edit crop policy rules.
- DISABLED: view globally disabled crops.
- SIZE LIMITED: view crops with NPC field-size limits.
- NPC DISABLED: view crops NPCs should not plant.
- VALIDATION: view existing NPC fields that violate the active policy and use the guarded dry-run / confirm reset workflow.
- SUMMARY: view active config, rule counts, and validation state.
- HELP: view in-game guidance.

Configuration:
- APPLY / FORCE APPLY writes staged crop-rule changes to the active per-save XML.
- DISCARD resets staged values.
- SAVE DEFAULTS TO CONFIG.XML backs up the existing template config and writes the current full active rule set to config.xml.
- Existing per-save XML files are not overwritten by Save Defaults.
- RESET BLOCKED DRY-RUN does not change the save state. CONFIRM RESET performs the actual blocked-field reset after review.
- VALIDATION includes RESET MODE: CULTIVATED or RESEED SEASONAL.
- RESEED SEASONAL uses the current seasonal planting window and CCO policy rules to choose a replacement crop for blocked NPC fields.
- Each crop has an individual reseed weight from 0 to 5, editable in the GUI and stored as reseedWeight on its fruit rule.
- A crop weight of 0 excludes that crop from NPC-field reseeding without disabling it for the player.
- The global leaveCultivated weight remains available, allowing weighted resets to leave some fields cultivated instead of reseeding them.

Changelog 2.0.3.6:
- Replaced the seasonalMission and seasonalLifecycle category weights with an individual 0-5 reseed weight for every crop.
- Added GUI controls for editing the reseed weight of the selected crop.
- A crop weight of 0 now excludes that crop from NPC-field reseeding while leaving the crop otherwise enabled.
- Retained the global leaveCultivated weighting.
- Added automatic migration of existing per-save XML files, assigning the default weight of 5 where reseedWeight is missing and removing obsolete category weights when files are normalised.
- Added multiplayer synchronisation for per-crop reseed weights.
- Fixed dedicated-server player joins changing loaded seeder selections, commonly back to Wheat.
- Prevented remote CCO seed-list refreshes from sending seed-selection changes back to the authoritative server.
- Hardened NPC crop planning so a failed replacement does not leave SowMission with an invalid fruit reference.
- Added recovery for legacy invalid sow contracts that can trigger repeated getIsPlantableInPeriod errors.

Hotkeys:
ALT+C opens the Crop Control Override GUI. This keybind can be changed in the in-game controls menu.
Mouse: use the GUI tabs, table rows, and buttons.
Keyboard: use the displayed FS25 footer actions for tab navigation, Load Defaults, and back.

Useful console commands:
ccoGui, ccoStatus, ccoWhichConfig, ccoReload, ccoValidateSave, ccoScanBlocked, ccoResetBlocked dryrun, ccoResetBlocked, ccoListNpcCandidates, ccoSeasonProbe, ccoGrowthProbe, ccoHelp

GitHub link:
https://github.com/SimGamerJen/FS25_CropControlOverride

365583.title: Distribution Redux
365583.author: Bones
365583.description:
Distribution Redux
Replace Farming Simulator 25's standard distribution system with a smarter, demand-driven logistics network.
Distribution Redux automatically moves resources between productions, animal husbandries, silos, and storages based on actual demand. It prioritises the nearest available source, supports automatic feed, straw, and water distribution, and gives you full control over how each output is handled.
Features

* No additional placeables required
* Works with existing productions, storages, silos, and animal husbandries
* Demand-driven distribution based on real consumption
* Automatic feed, straw, and water supply
* Multiple output modes: Hold, Distribute, Sell, Store, and combinations
* Hold Internal mode: keep bulk product in a production and spawn pallets on demand
* Proximity-based or whole-farm distribution
* Per-building and per-product configuration
* Multiplayer supported
Compatibility
Designed for the base game and compatible with most standard mods. Some custom buildings may require additional support.

Feedback/Issues: https://github.com/Bones50/FS25-Distribution-Redux

Changelog

v1.1.0.0
1. Over 39 Bug Fixes (see GitHub Readme for full details).
2. Over 17 QoL Additions (see GitHub Readme for full details).
3. Compatibility added for many mods, and the code strengthened to improve mod compatibility overall (see GitHub Readme for full details).
4. Added an Overview tab that allows you to see all distribution activity, and distribution settings, for all buildings in one place (includes filters, and can be set to show all sources and productions contributing to a specific end product)
5. Added Advanced Input and Output management (block, prioritise, reserve stock, fill target, max in) for all buildings.
6. Added the ability to move and sort product between storages (i.e. Silos, Pallet Stores etc)

v1.0.0.2
- Buildings can now be renamed: all buildings in the distribution network can be given a custom name from the base-game construction menu (silos, sheds and pits included, which the game does not normally allow). Distribution Redux uses that name throughout its menu, with the original building name shown beneath it as a reference.
- Fixed the Manure Heap and Slurry Pit listing each other's product: the Manure Heap now shows only Manure and the Slurry Pit only Slurry.
- Fixed the Manure Heap and Slurry Pit showing no incoming product; they now list what actually flows into them.

v1.0.0.1
- UI fixes and consistency edits.
- Added Markets and Kiosks to the distribution system.
- Fixed the sell-at-best-price logic that could sell too early on the first pass.
- Added the Hold Internal output mode: keep a production's bulk product in the building instead of auto-spawning pallets.
- Added manual pallet spawning from a Hold Internal output's held stock - a pop-up lets you pick the pallet type and quantity (capped by what's stored), available from the Distribution Redux menu and the base-game production screen.

The map features realistic road layouts, field structures, and forest areas, creating a strong sense of authenticity. At the same time, the village, buildings, and infrastructure have been deliberately adapted to the needs of Farming Simulator to provide smooth and enjoyable gameplay. As a result, the location is not an exact replica of its real-world counterpart, and not every building has been recreated. The focus is on achieving a balanced mix of realism and playability for traditional farming, production chains, and forestry. The central starting farm provides an ideal starting point and can be expanded with additional land to suit your playstyle. Sell points and production facilities are conveniently distributed throughout the village, while features such as snow clearing add even more variety to the gameplay.

366174.title: Dynamic Market
366174.author: Nalathan
366174.description:
Dynamic Market makes selling prices change over time, on top of the normal seasonal swings from the base game. Each product group develops differently, so the best time to sell keeps changing.

Prices
- Additional monthly market swing on top of base game prices
- Every product group (crop farming, forage crops, animal products, livestock, processed goods, building materials, map-specific goods) follows its own price curve
- Optional yearly average mode: replaces the base game's seasonal peaks with one stable yearly value, so you don't have to wait for a specific month
- Sales pressure at selling stations: selling large quantities at once temporarily lowers the price there, which then recovers over time (threshold and strength adjustable)

Stock & Notifications
- Shows your actual stock per product: in storage, trailers/implements, and the output storage of production buildings and animal barns
- In-game notification when a good you have in stock rises notably in price
- Show an item's storage locations at the press of a button, including map markers for the storage location and the best sell point

Overview
- Dedicated market screen with base game price, adjusted price, percentage difference, selling location and best selling month
- Search, storage filter and sortable columns for fast navigation

Favorites
- Mark goods as favorites directly in the market overview
- Filter the overview to show only favorites, and sort by favorite
- Favorites are saved with your savegame

Automatic detection
- Automatically detects sellable goods from any map or mod, without manual setup
- Goods that don't fit an existing group but can genuinely be sold end up in their own "Map-specific" group instead of being ignored
- Manual group assignment available for special cases

Multiplayer
- All market calculations run server-side, so every player sees the same prices

Feedback and issues on GitHub: https://github.com/Nalathan01/FS_Dynamic_Market/issues

Changelog 1.3.0.0:
- New: market notices now show an event that explains the price change (e.g. "A wholesaler bought large quantities") - just for flavor, does not change the actual prices
- New: "GIANTS Prices Only" setting - fully turns off Dynamic Market's own prices, you just get the game's original prices, overview and search still work
- Hotfix: search field in the market overview reworked - more consistent look, own Clear button, Esc now clears the search first and only closes the menu on a second press
- Hotfix: "Best selling station" could show a station that isn't actually paying the best price right now
- Hotfix: several notices used to appear at once on a period/day change - now you get one bundled notice
- Hotfix: with daily recalculation on, the notice no longer appears every day, only on a real month change

Changelog 1.2.0.0:
- New: get an in-game notification when a good you have in stock rises notably in price
- New: show an item's storage locations at the press of a button, including map tagging for the storage location and the best sell point
- New: the "Sale value" column now shows stock x current price instead of just the price difference to base price
- New: goods in trailers/implements and production building outputs now count towards the shown stock
- New: manure, liquid manure and digestate are now tracked as sellable animal products
- New: unclassified but genuinely sellable goods now get their own "Map-specific" price group instead of being ignored
- Fixed: market prices were recalculated every 5 seconds even when the period had not changed
- Fixed: "Normal" price-base mode now keeps the original seasonal curve instead of flattening it
- Fixed: group names and market notices now consistently use the shipped translations
- Fixed: crop farming and other merged categories had lost their seasonal price influence
- Only actually unloadable and sellable products are now shown for production buildings, animal barns and attached implements
- New: sales pressure at selling stations: selling large quantities at once temporarily lowers the price there, which then recovers over time. Two new settings control the threshold and the price drop per step
- Simplified how the mod's menu tab registers itself, to be more robust for gamepad/controller navigation

Changelog 1.1.0.0:
- New option: daily market recalculation, for savegames with multiple days per month
- Product groups simplified from 14 to 6 more realistic categories, for more frequent market swings
- Market overview reworked: added group and stock columns, sortable column headers

Changelog 1.0.2.0:
- added italian language (thx to FirenzeIT)

Changelog 1.0.1.0:
- UI adjustments for better text readability
- Revised French translations

366477.title: Mouse Click Actions
366477.author: Kijbev
366477.description:
Mouse Click Actions (MCA) makes vehicle interactions in Farming Simulator 25 easy and intuitive. It lets you aim freely with the mouse and trigger actions with a clean, satisfying click.

It works completely standalone and does not require any other mod. When used as the primary interaction mod, MCA provides a full mouse-driven interaction system with hold-to-click, cursor freeing, head-tracking support, and optional labels.

When the Interactive Control (IC) mod is also installed, Mouse Click Actions automatically switches to companion mode: it adds clear on-screen text labels to IC's interaction points while leaving all interactions to Interactive Control.

How It Works (Primary Mode)

Mouse Click Actions uses a mouse-driven approach:

* Hold the interact key (R) to freeze your view in place and free the mouse cursor.
* The cursor highlights interaction points clearly - the one under your cursor is emphasized.
* Click to trigger actions with satisfying precision.
* Scroll the mouse wheel while holding R to zoom in/out for tightly packed controls.

This works both inside the cab and on foot. Releasing R instantly returns you to normal mouse-look or head-tracking.

Mouse Click Actions was designed with head-tracking users in mind (TrackIR, Tobii, opentrack). In the cab, your view follows your head, which is wonderfully immersive but makes aiming for an interaction point tricky. Hold R and the head-tracked view freezes while the mouse cursor is freed: just face the general direction, then move the cursor straight to any control and click, no precise head-aiming required. Scroll the mouse wheel while frozen to zoom in on tightly clustered controls. Release R to resume head tracking.

Interaction mode is only active while holding R, so quick taps of R continue to work normally for other game functions.

Features (Primary Mode)

* Works on foot and inside vehicles
* Designed for head tracking - freeze view on demand for precise clicks
* No accidental activations - actions only trigger on actual clicks
* Optional labels for interaction points
* Out-of-reach points appear grayed out; empty points stay hidden until relevant (e.g. implement attached)
* Fully customizable: labels, colors, backgrounds, and click sound via Settings > General Settings
* Full multiplayer support

Compatibility & Notes

* Mouse Click Actions reads the same interaction data format as VertexDezign's Interactive Control, so it supports all vehicles that work with IC.
* In companion mode (with IC installed), it adds helpful text labels that automatically respect your Interactive Control visibility settings (always, on hover, or off).
* All label options remain available in the settings menu. Primary mode options are grayed out when IC is present.

366595.title: Motor Load HUD
366595.author: Dr.Fajen
366595.description:
Motor Load HUD adds a compact information display while the player is seated in a motorized vehicle.

Displayed information:
- Current engine load in percent
- Estimated engine power currently being used
- Available engine power at the current engine speed
- Smoothed driven-wheel slip
- Theoretical speed range of the current gear

The following options are available in the general settings:
- Show or hide motor load and power
- Show or hide wheel slip
- Show or hide the gear speed range
- Display power in PS or kW
- Position the HUD below or above the speedometer
- Select a small or large HUD width
- Display the upper HUD inline or in two stacked rows

When the upper position is selected, the original fill-level and fill-type display is moved upward automatically to prevent overlapping. The additional displays are linked to the standard in-game HUD and are hidden when the standard HUD is disabled.

The settings are stored locally for each player. The mod does not change vehicle performance, vehicle configurations or savegame data and is compatible with multiplayer.

Additional multiplayer information:
- Motor load, power and gear speed range are available in singleplayer and multiplayer.
- The wheel-slip display is synchronized for joined multiplayer clients; the server calculates the vehicle slip and sends the value to the respective player.

Changelog 1.1.0.0:
- Added multiplayer synchronization for the wheel-slip display.
- Restored the personal HUD options in the General Settings page after the game update.
- Moved all HUD options to General Settings so each player can configure the display locally.
- Filtered false wheel-slip peaks during initial acceleration and when coming to a stop.
- Added separate settings for motor-load, wheel-slip and gear-speed displays.
- Added a PS/kW power-unit setting.
- Linked the additional display to the visibility of the standard in-game HUD.
- Added a smoothed wheel-slip display with green, yellow and red warning levels.
- Added the theoretical speed range of the current gear with one decimal place.
- Added positions below and above the speedometer.
- The original fill-level display is moved upward automatically when the upper position is used.
- Added small and large HUD-width options.
- Added inline and stacked layouts for the upper HUD position.
- Improved positioning and spacing of all HUD sections.

366961.title: ModMixer
366961.author: Avolation Industries
366961.description:
Mods silently break each other. When two mods change the same game function, the one that loads last usually wins — the other mod's work just vanishes: no error, no crash, no explanation. ModMixer finds these conflicts, explains them in plain English, and gives you a control panel to settle them.

THE SWITCHBOARD
A full control panel in the in-game menu (look for the ModMixer icon), six tabs:
- CONFLICTS — every mod fight in one place. Pick a winner (that mod wins, the rest are muted) or activate a shared chain to set its run-order — all restart-gated. Switch the view (top-left): SIMPLE ranks mods (higher wins everywhere), BY CATEGORY settles one realm at a time (wheels, HUD, economy, weather...), ADVANCED shows every contested function with its full hook chain — who runs first, who overrides whom.
- LIVE — instant settings your mods expose (toggles and sliders), applied in-game immediately.
- VEHICLE — live diagnostics of the machine you're sitting in: damage, wear, temperature, speed, mass, per-wheel grip.
- PERFORMANCE — live per-mod cost (ms per frame) against your fps budget. Find the mod eating your frame rate and park it without uninstalling.
- REVIEW — worth a look: likely duplicate mods, known incompatible pairs, HUD overlaps — each with evidence. Dismiss what you've judged.
- PROFILES — save your whole ModMixer setup (conflict picks, reorders, toggles, hibernation) under a name and load it back.

Every row comes with a plain-English explanation. You still get the classic boot conflict report (ModMixer.log, next to your game log) and an on-screen warning when two flatly incompatible mods are installed.

BUILT SAFE
- Structural changes (reorder, mute) apply on restart — nothing is rewired mid-game.
- Load-critical functions are locked and can never be vetoed.
- If a launch doesn't complete, the next one starts in safe mode automatically (all levers off) — your game always loads.
- Manual kill switch: create an empty file MODMIXER_SAFE_MODE.txt in modSettings/FS25_ModMixer/.
- Disk footprint: ModMixer stores only its own settings, profiles, and a boot-recovery marker under modSettings/FS25_ModMixer/ — nothing elsewhere, and it makes no network connections.
- Abnormal-load protection: if a load comes up with no farm (a conflict brick), ModMixer blocks that session's saves so the broken state can't overwrite your existing savegame, then self-recovers on the next launch.

IMPORTANT: keep the zip named FS25_0_ModMixer.zip — the 0 makes it load before your other mods, which is how it sees every hook they install.

Multiplayer: loads and reports per client; the Switchboard's levers are designed for singleplayer.

GitHub: https://github.com/AvolationIndustries/FS25_ModMixer
By Avolation Industries.

367087.title: Wood And Weight Info
367087.author: mike1000195
367087.description:
A lightweight HUD overlay built for wood/forestry data and weight information - shows your strapped wood volume/piece count, as well as any strapped pallets/machinery and bulk materials at a glance while driving, so you always know exactly what you're hauling, and how much it weighs.

Primary display function (wood):
- Wood pieces: live count of physically strapped logs
- Wood volume (L): total volume of strapped wood

As an added feature, the HUD also includes full cargo weight information for all vehicles:
- Total Weight: Weight of the bare vehicle and attached implements + Load mass.
- Load: Current "load/cargo" mass across the entire current vehicle chain: (Fill units, and all strapped down vehicle attachments, wood, pallets, vehicles, and more!)
- Weight shown in metric (kg) or imperial (lbs), plus short tons (t) available in imperial!
- You can choose any size and any position! Use the keybinds (unbound by default) to resize and reposition the display, and switch it between vertical and horizontal in the settings menu! Completely customizable!

Any mass data (non fill-unit, i.e. wood logs, bales, pallets, vehicles, etc) are only displayed when cargo is strapped down with tension belts. Fill unit mass is calculated automatically.

The entire HUD hides automatically when on foot, and can be toggled on and off when in a vehicle with a keybind.

Settings:
Open the in-game Settings menu and look for the "Wood and Weight Info" section under General Settings:
- Orientation: Show the HUD boxes stacked vertically, or side by side horizontally.
- Mass Units: Metric (kg) or Imperial (lbs and short tons).

Keybinds:
- Toggle HUD: Show or hide the overlay
- Reposition HUD: Move the HUD display using the mouse cursor
- Increase HUD Size: Make the HUD larger
- Decrease HUD Size: Make the HUD smaller

All keybinds are unbound by default. Assign them in the in-game Controls menu under "Wood and Weight Info".

HUD Reposition: Press the Reposition HUD key to enter reposition mode. The mouse cursor appears automatically, with the reposition box. Move the mouse to place the HUD, then LEFT-CLICK to save.

Note: Total mass numbers may differ with the readout from any in-game scalehouse due to the math giant's uses to calculate the mass on the scales. This issue is only apparent in very specific cases (multi-vehicle and fillunit chains loaded onto the back of a trailer), and should not be a problem otherwise.

Note: The wood information box will not display for some autoload trailers. Autoload trailers in general may not be fully compatible with this mod, and may not provide results as accurate as using base game equipment.

ANY ISSUES WITH THE MOD CAN BE REPORTED BY OPENING AN ISSUE AT https://github.com/mike1000195/FS25-Wood-And-Weight-Info

Changelog v1.0.1.0:
- HUD labels now display in your game language (English, German, French)
- Reposition mode text is now localized as well
- Wood volume and piece count box now shows for logs that aren't strapped down, including logs simply resting on a trailer
- Note: wood weight still requires the load to be strapped with tension belts, just like pallets, vehicles, etc.
- Note: autoload trailers may provide inaccurate or unexpected results, and the wood information box will not display for some autoload trailers.

367297.author: moji
367297.description:
Soil Work Yield Bonus rewards proper soil preparation before planting. Worked parts of a field receive a yield bonus.

The bonus depends on the tool:
- Disc harrow: +4%.
- Cultivator: up to +6%.
- Power harrow: +8%.
- Subsoiler: +10%.
- Plough: +12%.

Bonuses do not stack: stronger soil work replaces the previous bonus, while weaker work does not reduce it. The effect applies only to the area actually worked and is consumed after harvest.

Soil status is shown on the map and in the field information panel. Savegames and multiplayer are supported.

Changelog 1.3.0.1:
- Added support for ploughs and subsoilers.
- Improved detection of the area actually worked.
- Added Italian localization.

367320.title: Farm Reputation
367320.author: Narbenstahl
367320.description:
Farm Reputation extends Farming Simulator 25 and Better Contracts with a complete reputation and career progression system, adding long-term progression and a more realistic contract experience.

Develop your reputation both as a farmer and as a reliable contractor to unlock better opportunities throughout your career.

Features:
• Complete career progression with multiple ranks
• Individual reputation for every contractor
• Contractor-specific contract value bonuses
• Farm reputation system with long-term progression
• Quarterly farm evaluations
• Field analysis
• Unlock new rewards as your reputation grows
• Increase the number of active contracts
• Unlock higher maximum contract values
• Earn additional contract payment bonuses

How it works:
• Earn reputation by successfully completing contracts.
• Earn additional reputation through positive quarterly farm evaluations.
• Lose reputation by cancelling contracts or receiving poor farm evaluations.
• Every contractor has an individual reputation.
• Higher contractor reputation unlocks higher contract value limits for that specific contractor.
• Your career rank determines your base contract limits, reward bonuses and the maximum number of active contracts.
• Farm evaluations are based on weed management, stone management, fertilization, liming and plowing.

Controls:
• F9 - Move the reputation HUD
• A - Previous page
• D - Next page
• Arrow Up - Select previous contractor
• Arrow Down - Select next contractor

Requirements:
• Better Contracts (latest version) is required.

Compatibility:
• Multiplayer supported
• Existing savegames supported

367391.description:

Includes 10 ready-made climate profile templates:
- Morvan uplands (semi-continental)
- Cotes-d'Armor (oceanic, Brittany)
- Calvados (oceanic, Normandy)
- Maine-et-Loire (temperate, Loire valley)
- Aude (mediterranean)
- Riverbend Springs (Mississippi Valley)
- Hutan Pantai (tropical Southeast Asia)
- Zielonka (Central Europe)
- HORSCH AgroVation (Central Bohemia)
- Silverrun Forest (Pacific Northwest)

Recommended maps, where the matching template is auto-detected: Le Mechet, Lanrelas, Vouilly Normandy, The Angevin Countryside, La Pomarede.
Official GIANTS maps are also auto-detected: Riverbend Springs, Hutan Pantai, Zielonka, HORSCH AgroVation and Silverrun Forest.
On any other map, simply choose the template that best fits the landscape.

Features:
- Realistic temperature, precipitation, snow and fog patterns per climate profile.
- Morning fog and summer storm notifications.
- Dynamic soil wetness and harvesting-risk warnings.
- Climate-based planting and harvesting calendars.
- 3-day weather bulletin HUD with icons: LCTRL + LALT.
- Respects game unit settings (Celsius/Fahrenheit, km/h/mph).
- Multiplayer supported.

This mod uses built-in climate templates; it does not download live online weather data.
Please do not re-upload or republish this mod on other websites.

367607.title: Manual Hydraulic Control
367607.author: KöllaKind
367607.description:
CManual Hydraulic Control allows the player to manually raise and lower the hydraulic lifts—just like in real life—and hold them at any desired height.
This is particularly useful when dealing with low shed entrances, as it allows you to lower the implement slightly to clear the opening.
The mod also enables a more active style of operation; for instance, you can fully lower a plow to engage it in the soil.
The base-game "V" key function for raising and lowering remains available, allowing for a hybrid control style.
- Stepless height adjustment: Manual control at the push of a button (hold down = move, release = stop).
- Selection via the “G” button: The currently selected hydraulic system (front or rear) is always controlled.
- Automatic end positions: The system automatically sets the operating status at the end positions (e.g., for plowing or cultivating).
- Full compatibility: The original automatic lift/lower system remains fully functional.
- Realistic operation: The control system is active only when the engine is running.

Additionally, the automatic hydraulic lift function is disabled when attaching an implement. This function can be toggled on or off via a button;
however, the current setting remains active until all attached implements have been detached and reattached (meaning, for example, if you manually lift a rear-mounted cultivator after attaching it,
then reactivate automatic lifting and attach a front weight, that weight must also be lifted manually; the automatic lift function only engages again once all implements have been detached and reattached).
My recommendation is to change this setting only when no implements are attached to the tractor.
Default controls (customizable in the menu):
- Numpad 8 = Raise
- Numpad 2 = Lower
- Numpad 5 = Toggle automatic lift on attach on/off

367616.title: 24 Hour Crop Growth
367616.author: Slidex
367616.description:
24 Hour Crop Growth makes supported crops ready for harvest exactly 24 in-game hours after they are sown. This means the next in-game day at the same time, not the next in-game month. The mod does not wait for the next monthly growth period. If the savegame uses multiple days per month, crops still mature after one full in-game day. For the intended behavior, Seasonal Growth should be turned off in the game settings.

The mod records only the areas that are actually planted and remembers the exact in-game time of sowing. Each recorded area is moved to its first harvest-ready growth stage after 24 in-game hours. Sleeping, changing the time scale and saving or reloading the game are fully supported.

The mod works with all standard sowable base-game crops that use the normal GIANTS fruit growth system. Standard crops planted on mod maps are also supported. Pending crop-growth data and the enabled state are stored separately in the savegame.

Press Left Alt + G during gameplay to enable or disable 24 Hour Crop Growth. The key binding can be changed in the Controls menu. The mod must be enabled while sowing so that the exact planting time and planted area can be recorded.

367658.title: Tire Sound
367658.author: PeterAH (Modding-Welt)
367658.description:
This global script adds a tire sound to all tractors, provided that the maximum speed of each tractor is at least 30 kph. The sound is only heard when the tractor is driving quite fast on a road, on fields or dirt roads there is no tire sound. The sound is a bit different depending on the tires; a difference is made between normal tractor mud tires, narrow care tires, crawlers and Nokian tires.

Some tractors from the base game already have a tire sound since FS22, so the sound is switched off by default. You can turn on the sound when you buy the tractor in the shop, where you can also adjust the volume (from 40% to 300%). If you have already bought a tractor in the game, you have to drive to the workshop to turn on the sound. The recommended volume setting is around 100% to 125% for tractors with original Giants sound, and often more for mod tractors.

You can change the default configuration setting in the "modDesc.xml" with "defaultVolumeConfigPercent". If the range of the config is not enough for you, you can change the volume in the "tireSound.xml" (located in the foöder "sounds") with "volumeScale". Normally, however, no changes are necessary in the XMLs.

367754.title: Traffic Density Control
367754.author: Razak
367754.description:
Traffic Density Control adds a dedicated section to the game settings where the AI traffic density can be adjusted.

The number of active AI vehicles can be set directly in-game. Values from 15 to 150 vehicles are possible.

For map creators, traffic splines can optionally use the user attribute trafficDensity or density.
Example values are 0 for blocked traffic, 0.1 for very low traffic, 0.25 for low traffic, 0.5 for medium traffic and 1 for normal traffic.
Splines without this user attribute keep their normal map behavior.

A manual reload function is also available for singleplayer. It can reload the AI traffic once if needed,
for example when vehicles are stuck or traffic behaves unusually.

In multiplayer, only the host or an admin can change the number of AI vehicles.
For the change to take effect, the server must be saved and restarted once after adjusting the vehicle count.

Important note:
A higher number of AI vehicles can, depending on the map, system performance and gameplay situation, cause performance issues, traffic jams or unusual AI traffic behavior.

Therefore, increase the value carefully and test the setting individually on each map.

Changelog 1.0.0.5
- Custom AI traffic on mod maps is now supported.
- New mapper function “trafficDensity” to control traffic density on individual traffic splines.
- Installation instructions added as a text file.

Changelog 1.0.1.0
- Fixed pathfinding for custom trafficSystem vehicles on mod maps.

The mod comes with a carefully curated list specifying which pallets can be stacked and at what height they are stacked.
Pallets that cannot be stacked in real life (such as milk cans, saplings, big rolls and so on) are intentionally excluded from stacking.


For modders and mod creators:

The mod adds optional settings attributes:
- Make your own modified pallets stackable and specify at what height they should be stacked on top of each other.
- Add or customize stackable pallets for a specific object storage.
- Completely disable stacking for a specific object storage.
- Rotate the arrangement of the pallets in an object storage by 90 degrees so that the pallets face forward with their long side — just as they would be placed by a forklift.

The mod includes a documentation and an attribute overview: see examples/README_en.txt

367994.title: No Overtake Splines
367994.author: Razak
367994.description:
With No Overtake Spline, AI traffic in Farming Simulator 25 is enhanced with no-passing zones on selected road sections.

As a result, traffic behaves much more realistically on prepared maps. Especially in towns, on roads with no-passing zones or in areas with limited visibility,
AI vehicles will stay behind slower road users instead of attempting risky overtaking maneuvers.

The mod also includes an exception for vehicles using their hazard lights. If a vehicle is stopped at the roadside with its hazard lights activated,
the no-passing restriction in that area is temporarily lifted, allowing AI traffic to safely pass the stationary vehicle.

Please note that AI traffic in Farming Simulator cannot always behave completely predictably.
If you stop at the roadside with your hazard lights enabled while several AI vehicles are directly behind you,
unexpected overtaking behavior may occur in rare situations. A dedicated handling system has been implemented for this,
but it cannot guarantee perfect behavior in every possible scenario. Whenever possible,
it is recommended to stop only when no AI vehicles are directly behind your vehicle.

Supported GIANTS maps with prepared no-passing zones:

Riverbend Springs
Hutan Pantai
Zielonka
Highlands Fishing

Important notes:

- Mod maps are only supported if they have been prepared for No Overtake Spline.
- Installation instructions for mappers are included in the mod as README.txt.
- The mod works in both Singleplayer and Multiplayer on all supported maps.

No Overtake Spline provides more realistic and safer AI traffic behavior and helps to prevent problematic overtaking maneuvers
on narrow or difficult road sections.

367997.title: Sync Cruise Control
367997.author: gsShooter
367997.description:
The mod adds a feature to automatically sync speed between 2 vehicles.

The vehicle with which you wish to synchronize your speed must be controlled by a helper or another player.
Stationary vehicles without a helper or player are ignored by the sync mode.

As long as the mode is active and a vehicle is nearby, the speed is permanently synchronized.
Application: Emptying the combine while driving, drive alongside the chipper, etc.


Operation:
1. Press sync mode button. Default: ALT+S.
2. Drive next to a combine, chipper or other vehicle.
3. Activate normal FS25 cruise control with button 3.
4. When sync mode is active, the mod automatically adopts the next vehicle as the target and continuously adjusts the cruise control speed.
5. Switch off cruise control or press the sync mode button again to end synchronization.

368117.title: Imperial System Conversion Settings
368117.author: FastFarm Dad
368117.description:
Adds a "Unit Conversion" section to the Game Settings tab in the pause menu.

Choose your preferred units for:
- Liquid: Liters or US Gallons
- Crops: Liters, Bushels (grains) or Lbs (root crops / other solids)
- Weight: Kg / Tonnes or Lbs / US Tons
- Measurement: Meters / Centimeters or Feet

Converts the shop list, vehicle configuration screen (capacity, fuel, methane, working width, bale sizes), in-game HUD fill levels, prices menu storage, and info boxes. Fill types are classified individually: grains show bushels, liquids gallons, dry bulk lbs / US tons, and bales or pallets keep their piece counts.

Settings are saved per-profile and persist between game sessions.
Does not affect in-game prices or game mechanics — display only.

--- CHANGELOG ---

v1.1.0.0
- New setting "Weight Scale": choose pounds only, US tons only, or pounds switching to tons over 1 ton. Pounds only keeps feed mixing and rationing precise, where tons are too coarse.
- Large numbers now use thousands separators, so 49,600 lbs is readable at a glance.
- Fixed: bales were sometimes shown in gallons instead of a bale count.
- Fixed: total mixed ration, silage and other feed were shown in gallons instead of pounds / US tons.
- Fixed: silos and production points showed every commodity in the same unit; each fill type is now converted on its own.
- Improved: US units per commodity. Rye, spelt, buckwheat and flax now use bushels; sunflower and rice use pounds / US tons, the way they are actually traded in the USA.
- Improved: displayed weights now match the real in-game mass of the load, and crops added by map mods are converted automatically.
- Fixed: error on dedicated servers, where the mod tried to build its settings page without a user interface.
- Fixed: liquid additive tanks (silage additive, liquid seed treatment) were weighed as solids.

v1.0.0.0
- First release.

368342.title: Regional Crop Calendar
368342.author: moji
368342.description:
Regional Crop Calendar adds regional farming seasons for 15 climate regions around the world.

The selected region changes the planting, growth and harvest periods of 20 main crops, along with regional prices. The new schedule appears in the standard menu and on the separate Crop Regions page.

Grapes, olives, sugarcane, grass and crops from other mods retain the map's calendar. Climate restrictions can still block new grape, olive or sugarcane planting where unsuitable.

Optional settings:

Regional weather
Changes temperature, precipitation chance, snow, cloud cover and other weather conditions relative to the current map's climate.

Rainy months and spring snowmelt can increase yield. A prolonged drought gradually applies a penalty. The strength of the effect depends on the normal precipitation of the selected region.

The current weather bonus or penalty and its short cause are shown in the field information panel.

Regional yield
Applies the selected region's overall fertility factor. Its signature crops may receive a small additional bonus.

Regional yield and weather effects work independently and can be enabled together.

Restrict crops by climate
Hides unsuitable crops from the Crop Calendar and from seeder/planter selections, and blocks new planting. Existing planted fields and orchards are not removed and continue to grow.

The region and its settings are stored separately for each savegame. Reset to Vanilla restores the map's original settings. Multiplayer is supported; only the host or an administrator can change the region.

The data is based on NASA POWER climatology and agricultural calendars from USDA, JRC, FAO and national agricultural authorities.

Changelog 1.1.0.2:
- Reworked the calendars for all regions.
- Added regional crop restrictions.
- Added rain, drought and snowmelt effects on yield.
- Added the weather bonus or penalty to the field information panel.
- Added help text for the optional settings.
- Fixed forecast refresh after changing the region.
- Improved multiplayer synchronization.
- Added Italian localization.
- Increased the base drought penalty from -5% to -6% per step; its onset and four-step cap are unchanged.

- The soybeans are now in 30 inch spaced rows, and the plant spacing in the rows looks realistic.
- The growth calendar has been completely remade to allow double cropping of soybeans behind any of the winter crops such as winter wheat, canola, or barley. Soybeans planted in April will be hravest ready by September, and for May and June, October.

- The stubble is also destructible by tires.
- Sizes and widths for each growth period has been adjusted, and some more stages have been added.
- New harvested distance textures featuring the striping often seen in harvested soybean fields.

This prefab also includes custom cutter effects that match the foliage. See readMe for instructions on how to install those.

Also feel free to use these textures and xml in any map you may be making. I would however really appreciate a small mention in the description, if you don't mind. (trying to build up some name recognition for future projects)
I hope you enjoy using these textures to make your game more realistic!

If you have any questions or complaints feel free to reach out to me on the GIANTS official forums or my patreon page.

368560.title: Glenleathann Multifruit
368560.author: CavalierRoy, [Monkey Show Modding]
368560.description:
For most of your late teens early 20's you had been working on a farm helping your friend who's dad sadly passed away, and although you traded that life for the city almost a decade ago you still often find yourself thinking back to those fond day's wondering how your friend is getting on and if he managed to secure more land as he had wished to do and although you had planned to drop in some day you always found yourself been pulled away for various reasons. After one evening sitting talking with your kids and hearing they have no idea where things come from you decided enough is enough. If the schools are not willing to educate your kids on simple things of where food comes from then you will.
Upon arriving at the place you called home for all your childhood up until your mid 20's you are taken aback by the scale of the land and the memories you have, the smell of the countryside, freshly cut grass the fresh air none of this smog you have been breathing in all these years in the city. You drive down the dirt road to your friends farm with a flurry of excitement, for you are home, you are back in Glenleathann.

- Alien Jim's cuttable hedges allow you to expand, connect fields or open land up.
- All the base game productions spread across the map.
- The map is precision farming ready and uses a custom soil map.
- There are some forest areas spread around the map.
- All base game and DLC products can be sold at multiple outlets.
- 108 fields of all shapes and sizes.
- 5 farms for those who like to spread out or play multiplayer.
- Lots of paint options in the terrain paint tool
- AI splines on dirt tracks.
- MissyB's UK calendar.
- New crops, winter Wheat, winter Barley, winter Oats, Green Rye aka whole crop silage, Rye, Spelt, Triticale and Clover, Summer Wheat, Summer Oats and Summer Barley.
- AI stopped from planting Cotton, Sorghum, Sunflowers and Long grain Rice however you can plant these crop types if you wish.
- Crop yields adjusted to match UK average tonnes per hectare.
- Prices adjsuted to match UK prices per tonne.
- All new crops added to animal feed.
- Animal changes to producion values of milk, eggs, wool (cows, chickens and goats will slow down on production at certain ages and at certain ages they will stop producing. Sheep will produce less wool after a certain age. This is done to better simulate IRL).

368565.title: Adjustable Engine Brake Force
368565.author: AgrarKadabra
368565.description:
Many vehicles behave very differently when it comes to engine braking—as soon as you take your foot off the throttle, some vehicles brake very hard, while others only brake very slightly.
With this mod, you can adjust the engine braking force individually for each vehicle.

The script adds a shop configuration to each vehicle that allows you to customize the engine braking force.
By default, the engine braking force is set to 100%, which corresponds to the vehicle’s original value.
In the shop, you can adjust the engine braking force using a percentage value from 10% up to 400%.

Only the engine braking force is adjusted — meaning the deceleration that occurs when you stop accelerating but are not braking.
Normal braking force via the brake pedal remains unchanged.

The engine braking force setting is saved together with the vehicle and is restored when a save game is loaded again.
The modification is fully multiplayer compatible.

368629.title: Soil Compaction
368629.author: moji
368629.description:
Soil Compaction adds realistic soil compaction. Heavy machinery compacts the ground beneath its wheels and tracks, reducing yield.

Compaction is shown on a dedicated map layer and in the field information panel. Ploughs, subsoilers, cultivators, harrows, seeders and planters gradually loosen the soil. Slow natural recovery also applies.

Multiplayer supported.

368812.author: Max Games
368812.description: Standing trees that can be cut with a chainsaw are felled when contacted by a moving farm vehicle or attached implement. Dedicated forestry machines are excluded. 369002.description:
"Fun Plates" Custom Deco Plates for FS25!

Does this sound familiar? You’re sitting in your brand-new, obscenely expensive high-tech tractor, looking out over your virtual fields, and thinking to yourself: “Man, my 300-HP beast looks just as boring as my neighbor’s.”

# Well, those days are officially over! #

Give your fleet the personality it truly deserves. Whether it's "Crop King", "Hectare Sheriff", or simply your own name — with the Deco License Plates (Fun Plates), you can bring that authentic trucker vibe straight to your windshield! Show everyone in the multiplayer lobby who is actually running the show.

# Unbelievable Features That Will Leave You Speechless:
Limitless Creativity: Use any and all official license plate types and designs from the base game. Your text? Completely customizable! Write whatever you want (or at least, whatever actually fits on the plate).

The "Fits Like a Glove" Guarantee: For all base game vehicles, official DLCs, and official ModHub vehicles, our engineers have spent sleepless nights pre-configuring the absolute perfect positions on the windshield. No clipping, no blocked vision!

The Magic of Dynamic Integration: Do you use other modded vehicles? No problem! Thanks to our revolutionary, state-of-the-art technology, these deco plates work in ALL other mod vehicles. Completely plug-and-play, with zero additional modifications required! It’s practically magic!

# But Wait... There’s More! The Ultimate 3D Precision Tool!
We’re not stopping there! Is the pre-configured position too mainstream for you? Want the plate lying sideways on the passenger seat or hovering right above the steering wheel? You have absolute control!

With our built-in editor, you can adjust the plate live in-game:
- X, Y, Z Axis: Slide it smoothly left-to-right, up-and-down, or back-and-forth.
- Rotation on All Axes: Tilt it, spin it, flip it—until the angle is just right.
- Scaling: Make it ginormous or tiny.
- Individual Auto-Save: The game remembers your exact settings for each individual vehicle! Once set, it stays put.

# And if you're still wearing your socks, here's what you can expect in the future:
- More license plate designs (who knows, maybe even glowing ones?)
- Icons and logos on the license plates
- Better support for automatic placement in unknown Mod vehicles
- Fleet license plates (customize all decorative license plate texts for your fleet in a single step)
- ...and whatever else crazy ideas we come up with.

# Download Now!
Why drive around like a nameless, generic farmer when you could be the undisputed King of the Road? Download the Deco Plates Mod today and give your FS25 fleet the upgrade your tractors secretly dream about at night!

# Procedure:
- Equip the vehicle in the shop with a decorative license plate
- If the decorative license plate is not visible, enter the vehicle
- Press the F9 key to activate adjustment mode
- Now the following keys work to position the decorative license plate:
- Ctrl + Cursor/Arrow keys (left, right, up, down) => Move on X/Y axis
- Page Up/Down => Move forward/backward
- Ctrl + Shift + Cursor/Arrow keys => Turn/rotate the license plate
- Ctrl + Shift + Page Up/Down => Tilt the license plate
- Shift + 1 => Reset position
- Shift + 2 => Reset rotation
- Enter => Save position

369241.title: Farmland Marketplace
369241.author: Fraazy
369241.description:
MULTIPLAYER ONLY

This mod only works in multiplayer.

Turn land into real business between farms! Become your server's estate agent: sell your own farmland to other players, lease it out for recurring rent, or ask for the land you have your eye on.

Everything runs fairly through offer and acceptance - the other farm has to actively agree before any money, ownership or usage rights change hands. And if the price is not right, you negotiate: counter offers go back and forth until both sides agree.

- Sale: ownership and the purchase price change farms.
- Lease: the lessee fully works the field (plough, sow, fertilise, harvest) while ownership stays with the lessor. Rent is settled automatically each period.
- Requests: you can approach the owner with a purchase or lease request instead of waiting for an offer.
- Bundles: several parcels can be offered for one total price - accepted only as a whole.

Fully menu-driven, no hotkeys:
- Select a parcel on the map and start an offer right there via the context action "Market" or "Request". The info box shows lease status, open offers and ongoing negotiations.
- Parcels are picked on a full screen map - with ownership overlay and multi-selection for bundles.
- Leased parcels are shown on the map in the lessee's colour, while the field number stays in the owner's colour.
- Menu > Statistics > "Farmland Marketplace": all incoming and outgoing deals plus active leases - accept, decline, counter, withdraw or cancel.

Changelog:

1.0.5.0:
- Price negotiation: every offer can be countered - as often as needed until both sides agree.
- Purchase and lease requests: interested farms can now approach the owner instead of only waiting for an offer.
- Bundle offers: several parcels can be combined into one total price or total rent. It is accepted all or nothing, with a single booking.
- New full screen map for picking parcels: multi-selection by click, ownership overlay and highlighting of the selected parcels.
- Map context action: "Market", "Request" and "Counter" directly on the selected parcel.
- Leased parcels are drawn on the map in the lessee's colour, the field number stays in the owner's colour.
- The map info box shows the number of ongoing negotiations for a parcel.
- The offer dialog now shows the land value and size of the selection as a price reference.
- Several interested farms can negotiate for the same parcel at the same time.
- The dialog's confirm button is now labelled "Send offer", "Send request" or "Send counter offer".
- Fixed: negative prices were not caught and could credit money to the buyer. Amounts are now clamped in all code paths.
- Amounts are transferred as integers in multiplayer. Very large prices were displayed inaccurately on clients.
- If a lessee buys the parcel they are leasing, the lease contract is ended cleanly before ownership changes.
- When a parcel changes owner, only the deals that actually become invalid are dropped.

1.0.4.0:
- A lessee can no longer sell the leased, foreign parcel through the regular map menu. Selling is now restricted to the owner on the server side.

1.0.3.0:
- Rent is no longer booked if lessee or lessor no longer exist, or if the lessor no longer owns the parcel. The contract is ended instead. This prevents income out of nowhere.
- When accepting a sale offer, buyer and seller are strictly validated. If either is invalid the offer is dropped instead of creating money.
- Cancelling a lease repeatedly no longer resets the notice period, so the contract now reliably ends.

1.0.2.0:
- Important fix: open offers stayed alive when a parcel changed owner outside of the mod, for example through a sale in the regular map menu. That allowed the same parcel to be cashed in twice. Offers and leases are now checked on every ownership change and ended if needed.
- Description reworked, the multiplayer requirement is now clearly stated.

1.0.1.0:
- Description and usage instructions extended.
- Log output during normal operation removed.
- The mod's money categories (lease income, lease expense, land purchase, land sale) now show their name instead of "(Missing)".

1.0.0.0:
- First release: sell or lease farmland between farms, offer and acceptance model, automatic rent booking each period, overview in the statistics menu and lease info on the map.

369342.title: Meadow Trails
369342.author: plutogaming91
369342.description:
Repeated vehicle traffic through map-generated wild grass and woodland-style ground foliage slowly creates visible wheel paths.

Each tire uses a real rectangular wheel footprint. Nearby repeated tire areas accumulate into the same trail, gradually wearing wild grass and decorative foliage into wheel paths and then dirt tracks. Hard surfaces such as asphalt, gravel, concrete, cobblestone, plates, and roads are ignored so trails stay limited to grass, meadow, and woodland-style ground.

Crop fields use a separate gradual damage system. Owned and unowned fields are handled the same way, and the crop damage setting controls how many repeated passes are needed before the native crop-destruction effect is allowed. Planted grass fields are protected so they are not treated as meadow trails. Fully damaged crop tracks now regrow through visible growth stages over three in-game months instead of returning to the original crop stage on the next month.

Settings are available in ESC > Game Settings:
- Grass Wear Passes
- Crop Damage Per Pass
- Trail Recovery Time

Trail recovery defaults to 1 Month. When enabled, unused wild grass or woodland trail areas remove their saved wear progress and attempt to grow back. No hotkeys are required.

369544.author: Reddog
369544.description:
Dynamic Dealership replaces the vehicle shop's unlimited machinery supply with a dealer inventory and ordering system.

At the start of each new savegame, a dealership is created with its own primary and secondary brands. Map makers may include a configuration file with their map to define these brands, providing consistent brand representation instead of a randomly generated selection.

The dealership also has a notional size that determines its stock capacity and stock-ordering budget. Vehicles and equipment from represented brands may be held in stock and available immediately. Vehicles and equipment that are not currently in stock, including those from unrepresented brands, remain available but must be ordered and are subject to a delivery lead time.

Dealer stock changes throughout the game as vehicles are sold and replacement machinery is ordered.

Vehicles may be:
- In Stock - available to buy or lease immediately.
- Back Order - an unreserved vehicle is already on its way to the dealership and can be reserved.
- Factory Order - no suitable stock is available, so a new vehicle must be ordered.

A deposit is taken when an order is placed, with the remaining balance charged automatically when the vehicle is delivered. Delivery times vary according to brand representation, vehicle weight or value, and the number of days in each period.

The Dealership page in the vehicle shop displays the dealership's details and the pending orders for your farm.

If a required vehicle mod is removed before delivery, the order is cancelled and the deposit refunded when the delivery becomes due.

Multiplayer is supported.

369642.title: Vehicle Tab Sorting
369642.author: Helfer B.
369642.description:
# Say Goodbye to Tab Chaos
You know the drill: You want to quickly hop into the combine harvester to empty a full grain tank. You hit Tab. And end up... in the skid steer loader on the other side of the map. You hit Tab again—and find yourself in a tractor that’s just sitting idle. After what feels like 40 clicks, you finally reach your target, but in the meantime, your hired worker has already taken out the fence.

Put an end to virtual travel roulette! This mod gives you total control over the Tab sequence of your vehicles.

# What the mod does (and why you need it):
- Your order, your rules:
Sort your vehicles exactly the way that makes sense for your workflow. From the farm tractor straight to the harvester? One click, instead of frantic, endless tabbing.

- The "Leave Me Alone" list:
Got vehicles that are just sitting around for decoration or working the same field for weeks? Simply remove them from the Tab loop entirely. They’ll be ignored until you decide to bring them back in.

- Plug & Play (No exceptions!):
The real highlight? The mod works automatically with absolutely every enterable vehicle—whether it’s from the base game, an official DLC, or the craziest mod creation from your favorite modders. No manual configuration required.

# The true next-level feature: Full multiplayer support & strict savegame separation!
This is where the wheat is separated from the chaff: The mod is smart and doesn't lump everything together. Everything is saved separately with precision.

- Each single-player savegame is separate:
Running a livestock farm on Map A and a dedicated contracting business on Map B? No problem. The sorting order is saved individually for every single-player savegame. When you switch savegames, the mod loads the exact sequence you set up for that specific game. - Full multiplayer support (independent of single-player):
Your single-player settings aren't overwritten when you go online. On servers, the mod runs completely independently and saves your personal settings specifically for you.

- Per player, per server:
On a multiplayer server, everyone does their own thing. Each player can set their own custom Tab order and choose which of their vehicles to ignore. Nothing gets overwritten. Does your farm partner love perfect organization while your buddy prefers chaos? No problem—settings are saved per server and per player. Got three multiplayer servers? Then you have three different sets of settings. Perfect!


The bottom line: Waste less time searching and spend more time harvesting. Take back control of your vehicle fleet—no matter the save game, where you play, or who you play with!

1. Open the wardrobe and configure the player appearance.

3. Enter a unique Preset ID and an optional Display Name.
4. Select an existing category or enter a new category, then select Save.

370142.title: Production Advisor
370142.author: NYKK3
370142.description:
Production Advisor is a complete management assistant for products, production chains, farmland and animals. It uses the data loaded by the current map and active mods to help you plan work and make more informed economic decisions.

PRODUCTS
Check all stock owned by your farm, including silos, productions, animal pens, vehicles, trailers, pallets, bales and object storage. Compare current and estimated maximum selling values, find the best selling point and month, inspect storage locations and set custom price alerts. Recipe advice compares direct selling with processing through productions you own, productions for sale on the map and placeable productions available from the shop.

PRODUCTIONS
Compare recipes by input cost, output value, profit per 1000 liters and estimated monthly profit. Filter owned, for-sale or purchasable productions, inspect detailed recipes and visit existing facilities. For owned productions you can review their condition, missing ingredients and output mode, then prepare and save recipe activation and output-mode changes.

FARMLAND
Review owned fields progressively without slowing down the menu. See farmland value, usable field area, crop, growth state, estimated yield and useful work still to do according to the active gameplay settings. Compare potential crop yields and values, exclude fields from the overview and plan a crop so the mod can remind you when its sowing period begins.

ANIMALS
View every animal group in the pens owned by your farm, with age, health, supplies, production and sale advice. Dedicated pages explain monthly feed requirements, food groups, current and potential output, reproduction, real sale value and the most profitable sale age based on the runtime animal curves.

THIS MONTH WINDOW
The movable in-game window keeps urgent tasks visible while you play: product alerts, crops ready to harvest, planned crops ready to sow, bales or loose material to collect, full vehicles, low animal food or water, low production inputs and full stored outputs. Its contents, warning thresholds, number of rows and rotation can be customized in the mod settings.

Default controls:
Left Ctrl + N: expand or collapse the This Month window.
Left Ctrl + M: release or capture the mouse cursor, allowing you to move the window and interact with its entries.
Both controls can be reassigned in the game controls menu.

Additional multiplayer-synchronized game settings include optional grape and olive yield multipliers, automatic horse riding, automatic sale of excess newborn animals and configurable value multipliers for horses, pigs and beef cattle. Personal display and calculation preferences are saved separately for each player.
