370216.title: Loose Load
370216.author: Razor Modding Team
370216.description:
Loose bulk cargo no longer stays magically in place. Careless handling now has a price.

Your load spills onto the ground as a real heap when:
- a vehicle or trailer tips over — onto any side, the front, the back or even upside down;
- you keep filling a trailer that is already full — the overflow pours out along its sides;
- you load a trailer whose cover is closed — there is nowhere for the crop to go, so it spills.

Details:
- Only loose bulk spills: grain, seeds, fertilizer, lime, sand, silage, woodchips and the like. Liquids, fuel, milk and electric charge stay in their tanks.
- A closed cover holds the load in a rollover, but blocks loading — filling a covered trailer spills.
- A short delay before the overflow starts, so you have time to react and pull away.
- A dust cloud tinted to the cargo and a pouring sound.
- Fully configurable in the in-game Settings menu, and multiplayer ready.

Drive carefully, cover up and don't overfill.

370596.title: Husbandry Fence Manager
370596.author: NorthForge
370596.description:
Singleplayer only!

Choose your style and build animal pastures that fit your farm.

Husbandry Fence Manager allows you to choose a compatible base-game fence for animal husbandries and edit their pastures after placement.

The mod works with both new and existing husbandries. There is no need to sell or replace a husbandry to change its fence or adjust the pasture layout.

Features:
- Choose a fence from the Customize menu when placing a new husbandry
- Browse compatible base-game fences in the graphical Fence Browser
- Change the fence style of an existing husbandry
- Edit, redraw and resize pastures after placement
- Animal capacity changes according to the size of the pasture
- Supports compatible base-game husbandries
- Supports compatible mod husbandries that use the standard Farming Simulator 25 pasture fence system

How to use:

New husbandry:
- Select a compatible animal husbandry from the construction menu
- Open Customize and select Fence
- Choose a fence style from the Fence Browser
- Continue placing the husbandry and build the pasture using the normal in-game fence tools

Existing husbandry:
- Open the husbandry information window
- Select Edit Pasture to redraw or resize the pasture using its current fence style
- Select Change Fence to choose a different fence style before redrawing the pasture

The size of the pasture determines how many animals the husbandry can hold. Enlarging the pasture increases its capacity, while making it smaller reduces it.

Helpful tip:
- Different fence styles use different segment lengths
- If the fence does not connect correctly to the final anchor point, adjust or redraw only the last few fence sections until it connects
- Some fence styles may fit certain husbandries and pasture layouts better than others

Compatibility:
Using Husbandry Fence Manager together with other mods that edit or rebuild pasture fences after placement is not recommended. Different editing and anchor systems may conflict and create incorrect fence layouts.

The mod supports compatible base-game husbandries and mod husbandries that use the standard Farming Simulator 25 pasture fence system.

Husbandries with fixed fences built directly into the building model cannot be edited.

Only fence styles included in the base game are available in this release.

Please note:
Open gates do not allow animals to escape. Animal containment is handled by the husbandry system, so gates can be left open for vehicle access.

Husbandry Fence Manager is currently singleplayer only. Multiplayer support is planned for a future update.

370819.title: Fertilizer WorkWidth
370819.author: Bgnak05
370819.description:
Keeps the section width you selected by hand, instead of resetting it to the implement's maximum when work is started.

Set a spreader or sprayer to 12 m, hand the job to the AI helper or to Courseplay, and the game reopens every section: you are back to 48 m and working well outside the field. This mod stops that.

How it works: the game already has a flag for this, aiKeepCurrentWidth, which it checks before resetting the sections. It is off by default and no vehicle sets it. The mod simply raises it. No game function is replaced and no behaviour is rewritten, so it does not fight Courseplay or other script mods.

Safety net: if you start work with every section closed, the mod lets the game reopen them, because an implement at zero width would produce a degenerate course. It reports this in the log.

Note: Courseplay reads the working width when it GENERATES the course. Set your width first, then generate.

Works with any implement that has variable work width sections.

Working width and the built-in AI helper: when you hand over the job, the helper does not read your section setting, it offers the implement's full width. Set the Working Width field in the AI settings screen to the width you selected, and the mod keeps the sections there for the whole job. With Courseplay the selected width is picked up when the course is generated, so no extra step is needed. Having the built-in helper read it automatically is planned for the next update.

Courseplay compatible: the mod only appends to the vanilla functions, it never replaces them, so Courseplay and other script mods keep working alongside it. Tested with Courseplay 8.1.0.3.

371122.title: Hide Player Positions
371122.author: Herr_Franke / ODGEE
371122.description:
PURPOSE
Hides other players' positions (and occupied vehicles) on the minimap and world map. Ideal for roleplay, realism, and multiplayer servers where players should communicate over radio/chat instead of just looking at the map.

MODES (selectable in Game Settings)
• All – default behavior, everyone sees everyone
• Own Farm – only members of your own farm are visible
• Own Position Only – everyone sees only themselves

HOW IT WORKS
Only administrators can change the mode. The setting takes effect immediately on all maps, is synced to every connected player, and is stored permanently in the savegame — it survives a server restart.

371189.title: Double Cropping System
371189.author: NovaVoro Interactive
371189.description:
Increase the productivity of your farm with realistic U.S.-style double
cropping.

This mod reworks the seasonal crop calendar, allowing you to harvest
select winter crops and plant a second crop in the same field during the
same growing season. Plan your crop rotations carefully to maximize the
use of every acre while maintaining a realistic farming schedule.

Features:
- Realistic double-cropping crop calendar
- Revised planting and harvest windows for Wheat, Barley, Canola,
Soybeans, Sorghum, and Corn
- Harvest winter crops in late spring and early summer before planting a
second crop
- Soybeans and Sorghum are optimized for double-crop rotations following
Wheat, Barley, or Canola
- Corn follows a traditional full-season spring planting schedule
- Built entirely on Farming Simulator 25's existing crop system without
adding new crop types

Crop Calendar:

Winter Crops
- Wheat - Harvest: June
- Barley - Harvest: May-June
- Canola - Harvest: May-June

Summer Crops
- Soybeans - Plant: June-July | Harvest: October-November
- Sorghum - Plant: June-July | Harvest: October-November
- Corn - Plant: April-May | Harvest: September-October

Whether you're looking for increased realism or simply want to get more
out of every field, Double Cropping adds new strategic opportunities
while preserving the familiar Farming Simulator 25 gameplay experience.

Notes:
- Supports Singleplayer and Multiplayer
- Compatible with existing savegames
- New savegames automatically begin in June to match the revised crop
calendar
- No new crops or fill types are added
- Not compatible with other mods that change the seasonal crop calendar
(e.g. Regional Crop Calendar) - both mods edit the same crop growth
data and will conflict

371897.title: Helpers On Credit
371897.author: Nalathan
371897.description:
Tired of your AI helper quitting on you just because your account isn't exactly overflowing right now? This mod fixes that: helpers (field work and more) keep working even when the farm balance is negative or too low to cover their running cost, right up to an overdraft limit of -50000 €. In the base game, a helper job stops immediately with an "out of money" error the moment the balance can't cover it anymore.

Buying vehicles and equipment works the same way: if your balance is too low but your balance plus your already-accepted, running contracts would cover the price, the purchase goes through instead of being blocked. That includes picking extra options that raise the price while you're still in the configuration screen, as long as it wouldn't push you past the same overdraft limit.

Server-side logic only, works fine in singleplayer and multiplayer, and also applies to AI job types added by other mods, such as Courseplay.

GitHub: https://github.com/Nalathan01/FS25_HelpersOnCredit/issues

372725.title: Additional Vehicle Info
372725.author: Helfer B.
372725.description:
Extends the vehicle/implement info box shown near a vehicle with lots of additional information - cleanly grouped into sections that can each be shown/hidden individually in the settings menu.

Always visible:
- Shop categor(y/ies) of the vehicle/implement
- Diesel/methane tank: current fill level AND capacity (instead of just the fill level)

Section "Condition":
- Damage (%)
- Paint wear (%)
- Net weight and total weight (including attached implements)

Section "Operating data":
- Age
- Operating hours
- Odometer

Section "Capacity":
- Every tank, numbered, with its capacity
- The currently loaded good shown directly under its tank (useful for implements with several differently filled tanks)
- Bale net/twine rolls on balers shown as a count (current/maximum)

Section "Performance data":
- Motor power and max. speed (on motorized vehicles)
- Power required, working width and working speed (on implements)

Section "Weights":
- Wheel weights required (yes/no)
- Ballast weight required

Section "Tab info":
- Whether the vehicle can be cycled through with Tab (yes/no)
- Whether it is excluded from the Tab order (yes/no, requires the mod "FS25_SortableVehicleTabbing")

Settings (Game settings > General):
- Show headers on/off (global)
- Show separators on/off (global)
- Each of the five sections above can be switched on/off individually

Compatibility:
- Automatically detects the mod "Info Display Extension" and hides its overlapping lines to avoid duplicates

373115.title: Exhaust Color Configurations
373115.author: [Weekend Farmers]
373115.description:
Want more smoke? Darker smoke? Or something completely your own?

With Exhaust Color Configurations, you can change the exhaust smoke of many vehicles
right in the shop or later in the workshop.

Standard – Keeps the original exhaust settings.
Level 1 – Darker and stronger.
Level 2 – Adds a little more.
Level 3 – For when you want some serious smoke.
Custom – Set your own color, transparency and smoke size.

The three preset levels and up to ten custom slots can be adjusted through the automatically
created FS25_exhaustColorConfigurations.xml file.
The file is located in the corresponding modSettings subfolder.
A German/English README with explanations of color, alpha, scale and the Min/Max behavior is also placed there.

Want to use different values later? Vehicles you already own keep their saved settings.
To apply new values, select a different exhaust level in the workshop and then select the desired
level or Custom again.
